reviews[0].comments: I had a great time staying in NY with Jack! He was so responsive to my messages and made sure to be available when I came into town. He had everything set up for me and both he and his girlfriend were so welcoming and friendly; I felt really comfortable with them and in the apartment :) The room was small but he made that very clear before accepting my reservation so there were no surprises. Anyway, the bed was so comfortable it hardly mattered. Small room, big city, cute dog (Miko)...what more do you need!! I would totally stay there again.
reviews[1].comments:
Great visit,  great host. Jack was so helpful and clear in his first e-mails that the room was exactly what i had expected: this is a long 'railway car apartment' - so you go through two sleeping areas and a living area to get to the private room - which has a door and no one going through. Imagine the  nicest train roomet you have seen - tiny, tiny room but with a firm beautiful bed.
 The host was exceptionally helpful and friendly, as was Miko the pug. The apartment was clean and the great cereal and English muffins for breakfast were an added bonus. The place is on the ground floor and sitting in the backyard  in the morning and at nightfall was a treat.
 I do not walk well and crucial for me was that three good bus lines are right outside (bx19 one block to connect to the m4 and m5, and the m101) and the subway is five minutes away. I often came home late after concerts and felt safe: enjoyed the people I met daily on the buses.

thanks darcy, constance and miko for such a great visit. Highly recommended.
reviews[2].comments: Thanks Jack for a very nice time there in NY, you both helped us to have a much more cozy and enjoyable stay in NY :)) apt was very nice, kitchen and terrace and everything, of course the room is really tiny it probably was a wardrobe sometime ago but we got used to it and in the end it was a very cozy room :) \nThe apartment is in a very good place its just few minutes walk from both the local and express trains 145th station so everything is very easily reachable. \nThanks once more :)
reviews[3].comments: Jack was very nice, he helped me during my time in his house, for family is sus i couldnt stay any longer. The place was exactly how he describes it and its a very good neighboor hood and you have 2 metro station very very close. \r\nTHANK u for a lovely stay jack!!!
reviews[4].comments: Loved the tiny room! I was warmly welcomed with some great conversation. The homes ambiance is one of immediate feel "good'n home"as soon as you walk in the door and for the time, you are lucky enough to spend there.\nEven amidst all the hustle and bustle of the town, this is a place of peace and contentment for you to come home too, the quiet tasteful music and Mikos loving presence just rounded my stay up perfect. Did I mention the strong shower head that just feels wonderful after lugging your rucksack around all day? If you want to be social, you can, the host is also very respectful of solitude needs.\nWould love to stay again when in the neighborhood.
reviews[5].comments: I spent a wonderful week in this apartment! Jack is so nice and Miko as well!! The apt is warm and welcoming :) the neighborhood is safe and close by there is the 1 train and A express! Amazing the sweet from the cart next to st nicholas street ;)
reviews[6].comments: what can i say. we had such fun!!!....i felt welcomed immediately, the room was as described, tiny but nice. the breadfast-station introduced me in real american breakfast ;)Jacks girlfriend was great, the dog was amazing! to jack, i really had a great time and couldnt have had a better accomodation. he helped me out whenever i had questions, wether about the City or where to get bargains to shop.... also very good tipps for hooking up ;) it wasnt an accomodation at all, it was my home for two weeks ....and i found real friends which i hopefully can Keep contact with...big hugs
reviews[7].comments:
Jack nous a très bien accueilli et nous a permis de nous sentir alaise et chez nous très vite !
Il a fait beaucoup d'efforts pour parler un Anglais simple et compréhensible, ainsi que quelques mots en français.
La chambre est certes petite mais vraiment confortable : endroit silencieux et calme, pas de fenêtre donc obscurité totale pour dormir, température idéale, matelas, couette et oreillers bien dodus ! Nous avons vraiment bien dormi dans cette pièce ! 
En plus le petit déjeuné est super : Fruits frais et variés (pamplemousses, bananes, kiwis, oranges, pommes, poires, ...), thé ou café, pains, miel, confitures, Nutella. C'est agréable de se lever et de pouvoir prendre un petit-déjeuné tout de suite, sans sortir de l'appartement.

Le chien est vraiment très sage, adorable ! Il n'aboie qu'un peu lorsqu'on rentre à la maison, et après on ne l'entend plus du tout. Il est discret et ne se fait pas remarquer. Nous, on l'a adoré, mais si vous n'aimez pas les chiens, vous ne remarquerez même pas sa présence !

Séjour génial, grâce aux conseils et discutions avec Jack. Il est à la fois présent et disponible en cas de questions ou problèmes, mais peut aussi être très discret et vous laissez vivre votre voyage seul si c'est ce que vous préférez...

Un grand merci à lui pour son accueil !
reviews[8].comments: J'ai passé un excellent séjour chez Jack. Il arrive à être à la fois parfaitement rôdé à l'accueil d'hôtes, de sorte que tout est prévu dans son appartement pour les visiteurs, et en même temps à ne pas être désabusé d'avoir vu passer tant de monde – il est très chaleureux et toujours prompte à aider. Idéalement situé entre l'arrêt du métro 1 et des lignes A B C D, on est rapidement partout dans manhattan. Le quartier est agréable et assez safe. Très bon plan pour ceux qui veulent se loger à moindre frais dans la ville.
reviews[9].comments:
Staying at Jack's was SO AWESOME! He was such an amazing host! It was almost as if I was just visiting friends!

He and his girlfriend had organised she would be able to be there to welcome me initially as he was at work...from the moment I was greeted I knew it would be a great stay! They were even worried for me as I was late arriving and they hoped nothing had happened!
 
Their little pug is THE most adorable, chilled out and intelligent dog EVER! Super friendly, but not really demanding, loves attention but also her own time! She knows heaps of tricks too!

Brilliant apartment, used the space well; the room you will stay in (most likely) appears small but more than enough space for sleeping and loads of very cleverly arranged storage (I was able to fully unpack my huge suitcase into the drawers and wall shelves); if that were not enough, you're made to feel very welcome in the lounge/kitchen all the time!

Great variety of food for breakfast with Jack specially paying attention to things I may have been preferring to ensure he didn't run out!!! (How legendary is that?!!)

Location - seemed safe and civilized enough! I guess always just exercise caution as you usually would being out late etc! 
VERY easy to get to anywhere from here - I was so surprised (I made it to the Brooklyn Bridge in 35 mins!), and the 'subway'/trains are very good!

They are very organised (they even have a crib sheet for guests so you can easily understand the tv, the wifi etc etc with ease!), caring and just generally awesome! 
You'd be missing out if you didn't stay here!
reviews[10].comments: Jack is a wonderful host and the pug is adorable. The backyard is a really good place to chill at!
reviews[11].comments: Jack nous a accueillis très chaleureusement chez lui. Nous sommes enchantés d'avoir fait sa connaissance ainsi que celle de son amie. Et leur chien est adorable! Nous avons apprécié de discuter avec eux chaque jour.\r\n Situé à proximité des transports publics (station de métro express notamment), l'appartement est agencé de manière originale mais il est très confortable et spacieux.\r\nNous vous recommandons vivement cet appartement.
reviews[12].comments:
Jack is a wonderful host and it was amazing to stay in his house during our trip in New-York! We had a lot of fun with him, talking and drinking French wine on the evening ! His girlfriend is very nice and Miko, his pug, is adorable !

This room is tiny but it corresponds exactly of what you can see on the pictures so no bad surprises ! We are two friends and we slept in this room for 5 nights without any problems so it's good enough for a short stay ! Besides, you could stay in the living room and use the kitchen as much as you want and Jack's house is very cozy ! There is a breakfast station with everything you need to start a long day of visits in New-York !

Location - this room is very close to subway stations and it's very easy to reach the center of Manhattan from here.

I definitely recommend you this place, if you want to spend a great time in NY !
Thank you very much Jack, I hope we could keep in touch and see you again, may be in a Paris' theater !
reviews[13].comments: Staying at Jack's was exactly what my best friend and I needed for our visit at NYC: a private room in a friendly and clean house in close proximity to a subway station. Jack was super nice and offered us plenty of tips on how to get around and what to see. Extra bonus was the lovely breakfast station he has setup for his guests, and Miko (his pug). It was overall a very positive experience and I would definitely recommend a stay at his. Thank you Jack!\r\n
reviews[14].comments:
This was my first airbnb experience, and I'm glad it was!
The description given is very accurate, or, to be honest, less flattering than the real thing.
Jack welcomed me warmly, gave me many pointers about what to do or how it works around.
Miko (his dog) is adorable.
I'm bad with comments, just note that, shall I go back to NY, I'll ask Jack for his room before looking elsewhere.
reviews[15].comments: Awesome spot to stay! Very close to the subway which made traveling around easy. The hosts were great, very welcoming and accommodating to my schedule. I stayed in the private room and it was perfect for my stay - lots of storage for all my stuff and the bed was comfortable. The layout was not an issue at all. I'd highly recommend this place!
reviews[16].comments: Jack has a lovely place with a really positive atmosphere and plenty of places to check out nearby (along with convenient subway station locations if you want to explore more). 10/10 hosts, pets, and Airbnb, you'll feel right at home! Book if you like good conversation, pizza (literally a 10 second walk away), wine, piano, and/or Netflix.
reviews[17].comments:
Location! Location! Location! 

Did I mention location? Anyhow, my stay at Jack's was a dream. I loved the layout of the apartment. I chose the front room, as it better suited my wants. The apartment was a block away from Bikram Yoga Harlem and a laundromat, Super convenient to multiple subway lines, and the garden was a perfect spot to enjoy a morning cup of coffee/tea or some dinner. 

Jack was an excellent host and catered to any question or concern I had... which were few as I am in the city often for work. 

Highly recommend this spot! 

Also, Miko and Saki are so much fun to play with, if you are a dog person.
reviews[18].comments: Jack and Constance are amazing hosts. They gave tons of tips about NY, helped me save money and it was really nice to have evening conversations. Location is really good for those using the subway and there is everything you need within a block or two.
reviews[19].comments: My stay at Jack's was comfortable, and he's a very flexible and available host. I had to make changes to my reservation and he was very accommodating. The description of the room here is accurate (no windows, the door doesn't fully close, no access to A/C unless the door is open) but I found it cozy. The dogs are very rambunctious (but sweet) and shed a fair amount, but this wasn't a problem for me. The location is amazing, super close to multiple subway lines and in a great neighborhood. Overall, I would totally recommend Jack's place to a tight-budget traveler looking to explore NYC.
reviews[20].comments: Jack and Constance were incredibly welcoming. Their tiny room really was tiny, but it was exactly as described. The apartment was close to multiple subways lines, a supermarket, and various other food options. Sake and Miko were also excellent furry hosts. I can't recommend this tiny but welcoming room enough.
reviews[21].comments: I had an amazing time! Jack is a great host, always available to have a great talk or to help you out!! Thank you for everything! Also the location is really great!!!
reviews[22].comments: Jack was the best host!  super attentive, funny,nice and pleasant to hang around. The atmosphere is chill with the 2 dogs and patio where I spent much of my time. I sure will miss him and would recommend to others.
reviews[23].comments: Jack, and his wife Constance made me feel like home! It was my first time abroad and they were very nice to me, gave me very good recommendations and made my experience friendlier, I'm very glad I met them! They're always available for any questions you have  and for a little chat about your day, it was  great! The apartment was nice and the room is tiny but very cozy and the bed is confortable, there are many subway lines close and some buses so it's very easy to move around Manhattan, and to get to Queens and Brooklyn. It's great they offer breakfast for you, you can use the TV, like I said before, it was like home! I totally recommend staying here! And the dogs are very sweet and very good company!
reviews[24].comments: Jack and his wife are amazing people! I’d recommend this place to anyone! I already miss the two puppies and the tiny room was perfect for me, a young girl who came by herself to NYC.
reviews[25].comments:
Okay, The only thing that I can say is..that it is very very very extremely rare to enter a strangers house and feel so warm and welcomed! Constance and Jack are phenomenal people, incredibly nice and I couldn’t have imagined staying somewhere else. They were very considerate and communicative. I am beyond lucky and happy that I got the chance to have met you and spent time in your apartment. 
The location is literally perfect for anyone travelling to midtown or wherever you wanna go. The neighborhood is pretty nice and i won’t forget to mention the pups.. they are incredibly sweet and i fell in love with both of them. 
The room is small but it’s sooooo cozy! And really comfortable!! 
I honestly couldn’t have imagined living somewhere else in my time in the city, i loved the talks at night and the kidness and i highly appreciate all of that. If you‘re ever in Germany, please let me know, i would love to see you again!!!
reviews[26].comments: Very convenient  location and safe neighborhood, I had I great time at Jack’s place. He gave me a lot of good advices about what to do in the city and has adorable dogs. I would recommend his apartment for a single traveler who wants to discover  New York.
reviews[27].comments: Jack is an awesome host. He give very good advice for travelers. I recommended him to everybody :)

reviews[7].comments: I stayed with Doe for 2 weeks while working in NYC.  This was a great location and she was an amazing host!

reviews[11].comments: Tobi was very friendly and helpful. His accommodation was pretty central and close to the subway station. We enjoyed our stay a lot!
reviews[12].comments: Buen piso para una pareja que quiere pasar unos días en NY. Cerca del metro y se tarda 20min en llegar al centro. Tobi es muy simpático
reviews[13].comments: Tobi was a fantastic host. He was very helpful with suggestions on where to get things in his neighborhood. He was also very flexible and accommodating with my check-in/check-out times. Highly recommended!!
reviews[14].comments: The apartment was Ok. What you see in the pictures is what you get. The location is convenient, close to some subway stations in a walking distance, even though you make about 30-40 min to get midtown or downtown Manhattan. \nEven the apparent has a nice look, there were lots of dust everywhere, some parts of the apartment seam to not being cleaned since a very long time. The floors and carpets were dirty and there were stains on it (my partner stuck himself a needle in his foot left on the carpet), particularly in the kitchen, where there were dirty dishes, even the sink had grease and dirt. The dish washer had stagnant stinky water in it. It was home of the cockroaches we found all over the kitchen, food left there and dishes. That’s why we needed to clean up the entire apartment so we could stand for the long of our stay. Tobi offered us to find a cleaner as soon as possible but never appeared. That’s something he needs to look up before anyone comes into the apartment. \nOther than that the communication was ok, even when we were not able to meet each other during our stay as he was out of town.
reviews[15].comments: Absolutely perfect for the non fussy traveller that wants value for money and an awesome location. Tobi is an excellent host and will make you feel at home and comfortable, he offers tips and ideas so you wont feel lost. I really enjoyed the location and local amenities are perfect. Always had hot water for showers, the bedroom is nice and clean, plus theres netflix and nice big tv in there so you can relax if you need to. I was always out most of the time and loved the location and felt very safe and secure. Its a lovely neighbourhood, with a lot of character. If i go to NYC again i'd defo consider Tobi again.
reviews[16].comments: La casa di Tobi è molto carina e confortevole. La posizione è comoda, infatti si trova a pochi passi dalla fermata della metro e in 20 minuti si raggiunge midtown. La zona è molto tranquilla, anche la sera dopo cena, noi siamo sempre tornati a piedi senza nessun problema. Tobi è un host molto simpatico e disponibile, ci ha aiutato ad ambientarci nella zona ed è sempre stato molto gentile. Sicuramente ritorneremo nel suo appartamento alla prossima visita a New York. Lo consiglio a tutti!

reviews[1].comments: Marinas place was a great place to get the head down for a few nights, great price and perfect area right beside subways which brings yu right down the west side of the city, would suggest this to any people traveling for few days as the price is great and room was comfortable and air con was great :) marina and daughter and friends are very nice love a good chat so use will enjoy your stay,\r\n
reviews[2].comments:
Marina and Anuki are the best hosts ever!! My experience at their home was totally perfect. 
The apartment: very cozy, nice, colorful, comfortable, clean and quiet
The building: safe, huge, with elevator, with nice people
The room: very clean, beautiful!
Anuki and Marina have been like a family to me, even if for a few days, helping me with any problem I could have. They are sweet and always available, even by phone or mail.
The internet is really fast, and the location is perfect, just beside the subway!
I surely recommend their room to anyone, and I'd surely come back here!
reviews[3].comments: We've spent a wonderful time at Marina's appartment! The place was clean, the bed was comfortable even though the street was a bit noisy. Marina and her lovely daughter Anuki have been very helpful to my boyfriend and I during our stay in New York. It was our very first time in NYC. Marina's flat place was ideally located, in beautiful Harlem, above Central Park. Tne underground station is very closed, at the corner of the street. Thank you Marina and Anuki, we loved staying at your place and we love New York!
reviews[4].comments: The room and the apartment was exactly same as listed. Very clean and convenient. There are lots of fast food joints, super markets just around the corner and that was really convenient. Next time if i go to NY, would definitely go again :)
reviews[5].comments: Staying with Marina was great. The room was bigger than many hotel rooms I've had in Manhattan, the bed was comfy, and the location was great. Marina and her daughter were extremely helpful, but not at all invasive. The whole apartment was very clean and comfortable and I'm really glad I stayed there. I'd definitely stay again.
reviews[6].comments:
It was our first time using Airbnb and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. The room was exactly as pictured, the apartment was super-clean and the building was well located -- half a block from the subway (and close to some great places to eat including soul food joints, value-for-money Senegalese restaurants and -- our favourite -- the fantastic Taco Mix at 234 East 116th St). 

Perhaps most importantly, though, Marina and her daughter were really friendly and helpful. They weren't always around, so we had plenty of privacy, but when we did see Marina she was full of ideas about how to make the most of our time in New York City. We probably wouldn't have made it to Zabar's deli without her encouragement, for example.

All-in-all we'd recommend this room to anyone looking for an affordable and friendly place to stay in NYC. Being there felt more like staying with a family member than paying for a room. The only problem for us is wondering whether our next Airbnb experience will live up to the standards of the first one!
reviews[7].comments: Very nice and comfy room, in a quiet location just a 5 min walk from the 2 and 3 subway station. The hosts were really friendly and helpful, and made our stay really enjoyable.
reviews[8].comments: Marina and Anuki were really friendly and warmly welcomed us in their apartment. We did not get to see them a lot since we were there for only two days, but the times we saw them, they were always trying to make our stay the best possible. Also the bed was very comfortable, and the room was just like the pictures. We recommend anyone who wants to enjoy their stay in NY. Thank you Marina and Anuki. Best wishes.
reviews[9].comments: We had an amazing experience in Marina's apartment. Very clean room and restroom, confortable bed. Near to the subway. Marina is very friendly and she doesn't mind to help us with everything we need. We hope to come back soon. Thank you Marina and Anuki :-)
reviews[10].comments: Marina and Anuki were very gracious hosts. They made themselves available for any questions or help getting around the city. They ensured I had everything I needed during my stay with them. The room was immaculate and the restroom was always spotless. The nearest subway stop was a 2 minute walk away. If theyd have me, I would definitely stay there again. A great bargain in a great city!
reviews[11].comments: The place is secure and nicely located 3-4 blocks north of Central Park which only took 15min to walk to. Being so close to Harlem you get some 'characters' around the neighborhood but we didn't feel threatened in anyway walking to & from the metro. The flat itself is nice and modern and all you need if you are planning on being in the city most of the time as we were. There is no communal area as such other than a kitchen in the flat but there is a large complex room on the bottom floor if you wanted a bit more space. Great having high-speed internet and maps & guides provided by Marina. We would be back to stay again.
reviews[12].comments: Excellent location (15 min from Time Square with express subway). Thanks to the welcome and to the kindness of Marina and her daughter. Very nice place for a trip in NYC.
reviews[13].comments: We have been to NYC for the first time and also thanks to Marina´s Blue Cosy Private, we really enjoyed our time. The environment was nice, the place is situated really good, near to the subway and close to the Central Park. We were really happy there.
reviews[14].comments: Although I didn't meet Marina personally, I had a wonderful experience as her guest. The room was exactly as it looks and the neighborhood easy to access and convenient to the subway. I had a snafu that forced me to check in later than I had expected but Marina was patient and flexible. I would highly recommend her to any prospective guests.
reviews[15].comments: Great place, very clean and comfy. Marina is really friendly. =)\r\nrecommand this place to anyone who is gonna travel to NYC.
reviews[16].comments: Marina is the best. Anuki and Marina are so helpful and friendly. I ended up going day early due to time difference confusion and my other host couldn't accommodate me late in the evening. Marina responded so quickly and kindly she managed everything in 20minute and she also came with me to takeaway dinner late at night. Anuki is also very nice person and she was very helpful. Place is closely, clean and very good.Thank you for everything.
reviews[17].comments: Um bom lugar. Vizinhança não tao boa, mas e perto da estacão de metro.
reviews[18].comments: I only stayed 4 days but I luved it @ Marina's ...I hardly saw her as she was very busy but she made me feel welcome right from the start ..she's a lovely host ..
reviews[19].comments: Marina made us feel welcome and was very helpful. The room was nice and clean and the AC was great. The subway is only 2 minutes away. I recommend this place!
reviews[20].comments: Mariana was very pleasant, though we only saw her briefly when we arrived, she was sure to let us know where things were and point out some brochures and maps she had for the city which was very nice. The room was clean and the AC was great. Parking in the area was a bit challenging if you want to try and save money and park on the street to avoid paying high parking garage fees, we ended up not being able to find a place on the street and had to use the parking garage in the neighbourhood. Close to transit which is great as well!
reviews[21].comments: Everything worked perfectly. The place was just perfect for my about four weeks stay. Location and room and whole place.  Thank you so much for this!
reviews[22].comments:
The apartment location is very convenient, only one block away from the metro (2 and 3) making it very fast and easy to get to downtown. Marina and Anuki were also very helpful for us to check in and out, and we were able to leave our luggage until late in the afternoon on our last. 
However, I cannot rate this place more than 2 stars, and here is why. When we got to the apartment, Anuki welcomed us and told us that she opened the window in the room because the heater was broken and we would be too warm to sleep. But when we went to bed, the noise from the street was too loud and we couldn't sleep, so we tried to close the window, and it turns out the window was broken too and could not be closed. So we basically slept in a hot and noisy room for 3 nights... Also, the oven isn't working in the kitchen and there is no microwave, which would have been nice to have instead of using the stove to warm our food up.
Hopefully, these will be fixed for the next people staying there...
Thank you both anyway, we still got to enjoy the Big Apple!
reviews[23].comments: I stayed in the apartment for almost five weeks while visiting a university in NYC. Anuki and Marina are both very nice and sweet persons. They carefully listened to my needs and brought a big desk into the room, so I could work, although I guess this is not a typical wish of their guests. The apartment is nice and tidy. I felt comfortable there. The neighborhood is safe, the Central park is very close. There are two subway stations nearby, so going downtown is not a problem at all. I am glad I can fully recommend staying with these two kind persons. I am grateful for their hospitality and I wish I could stay with them again when visiting NYC next time.
reviews[24].comments: Marina and her daughter Anuki are excellent hosts. They provide everything I needed. The room was big and everything was clean and neat. The building is so close (only 1 block away) to the subway 2 and 3 lines. I recommend this place to everyone.
reviews[25].comments: The Room is very nice and cozy, I really enjoyed living there for few days. The house is small but clean and comfortable.  Privacy guaranteed.
reviews[26].comments: She is a really long person and help me a lot when I was living there. Room is clean and environment is quite.
reviews[27].comments:
This was my first airbnb experience and it was great. 
The apartment was very welcoming and I had a great time with staying at Anuki's and Marina's home. Very nice apartment, very clean,comfortable and sunny during the day.
The apartment is very well located, just 3-5 min away from the subway. 
I highly recommend this place for people willing to discover New York.
reviews[28].comments: I had a very good experience. The apartment was very clean. The location is very close to a subway station. The host was helpful in providing info for reaching the place from the airport. Towels, bedsheets and hairdryer were provided. I recommend this host.
reviews[29].comments:
I had a very nice stay in Anuki's apartment, it was easy to find, nice building, nice area, practical in many ways and it felt warm and welcoming.
I was actually greeted by Anuki's mother Marina, who takes over when Anuki is busy. Both of them are very nice and thoughtful. They care about the place being clean, about being hospitable and making everything very clear and easy for you.
I didn't see much of Anuki as she gets up early for work and I often got back late... as a tourist in Manhattan you definitely don't stay in all that much, but if you do, you're sure to feel at ease here.
The bathroom is absolutely fine, the kitchen too, everything is clean, and practical. The bedroom was a nice size and had storage to put your things away, a desk to sit at, a very comfortable bed, and in the daytime it gets the sun and you have a nice view over the street and a church.
I got a little cold one evening when the temperature went down, but there were plenty of duvets and quilts to be cosy under.
Another minor glitch, I did have some work to do one evening and the wifi was not all that reactive. I actually had to abandon trying to send some files, the signal was just not strong enough.
However if anything had been a real problem I'm 100% sure that Marina or Anuki would have found a solution, but I didn't actually get the chance to talk about it! Too busy running around New York and trying desperately to get as much input as possible :)

I was visiting for just under a week and found Anuki's place to be practical for all the things I wanted to do and see. Very easy access to subway and possible to get down to Times Square in 20 minutes on lines 2/3. And when you've had too much of the action down in the south, it's nice to come back "home" and grab a bite at the Red Rooster or Amy Ruth's. I also tried and loved BLVD Bistro, not far at all. 
If you're into gospel, this place is great for getting up on a Sunday morning and going to church, loads of choice.
Also a short walk to Central Park which I actually walked all the way through, down to the bottom, it was such a beautiful day.
Thank you Anuki and Marina for your welcome and for opening your home to us visitors :)
reviews[30].comments: I had a wonderful stay in Anuki and Marina's apartment, can highly recommend it!
reviews[31].comments: Highly recommend the hosts Marina and Anuki who were 100% accommodating for arriving guests.  The location is extremely convenient for anywhere - the 2/3 is at the end of the block, and the 4/5/6 or Harlem-125th Station within short walks, plus kitchen facilities, and a laundry room in the building. The neighbourhood has everything needed, including a decent café across the street at Harlem Mist.  My thanks to the hosts for an excellent stay.
reviews[32].comments: When I arrived, the room pictured was no longer available and I was put in another room which I was told was "better" but it was cluttered and dirty and I felt like I was  living in a storage bin. The was a camera mounted in the ceiling directly across from my door which filmed me every time I went to the bathroom. Also, the bathroom was dirty when I arrived and never cleaned while I was there. The garbage was overflowing. The photos show the shared areas (kitchen, bathroom) as uncluttered but there were mops, bags, and cleaning supplies around.  Sorry but I can't recommend this place.
reviews[33].comments: The flat has a good location which is close to subway station and the room is clean and warm. The host is nice and prepared several quilts for me and told me if one quilt was not enough, then I could use others as well. The bed is comfortable and I really enjoyed this trip and the experience in this room.
reviews[34].comments: 房东非常和善,耐心｡东西很齐全,走时候还有小礼物
reviews[35].comments: The listing was as advertised.\r\nMarina was flexible and I had a pleasant stay at their place.
reviews[36].comments: Just what I needed
reviews[37].comments: The Manhattan Cozy Room was a terrific place for my six week-working stay in NYC.  The apartment is convenient - one block from the 2 & 3 subway, and four blocks from the 6. As a solo female I always felt safe in this lively East Harlem neighborhood. I often was coming home late - after 10 PM - and always felt safe walking from the train to the apartment. There was usually an open restaurant or food truck available for a late night meal. There's a very nice neighborhood coffee shop & restaurant across the street. The apartment is cozy; and as Marina stated. It faces the main street, which can get a little noisy, but wasn't that bothersome for me; If you're a very light sleeper, earplugs were provided. Whenever I asked for something - an extension cord, a lamp... Marina supplied it quickly. \r\n\r\nSince I stayed for 6 weeks, I took yoga classes one block away. I walked to the Apollo Theatre on a Saturday night; had dinner as a local restaurant, and did all my grocery shopping in the area.  It was great to have a laundry room in the building! There's no 'commom area,' in the apartment. There is a building yard, but I didn't have time to use it. Having a kitchen was a major pluse for me. Coffee in the AM, and the microwave for heating up food came in super handy.  A shared bathroom for three roomies, wasn't inconvenient, since I was on an early schedule. Bottom Line - Manhattan Cozy Room worked well for me! I'd recommend it!
reviews[38].comments: Good experience, safe building! They were easy to get ahold of when I needed to drop my luggage off earlier than check in time!
reviews[39].comments: Great place! Marina and George (her brother who lived in the apartment) were both very friendly, and I had good experiences with the neighbors. I stayed here for a little over ten weeks, and this location was not only convenient (2/3 and 4/5/6 trains, not to mention lots of bus lines), but also safe for when I returned late at night. The wireless access was reliable, and Marina responded quickly whenever I had questions. Would definitely recommend staying at this place!
reviews[40].comments:
If you value privacy and cleanliness do not stay here. This was a very disappointing stay.

Privacy: the host asked me for a photocopy if my ID, my personal email address, films all the comings and goings with a camera in the flats hallway.

Cleanliness: imagine what you see on the pictures, only the run down unkempt version of that. Everything is kind of cluttered, the place is not especially clean and I also did not notice substantial cleaning while I was there.

Other than that the place kind of offers what's in the add.
reviews[41].comments:
Marina is a really nice host. The building is located in a safe area in Harlem neighbourhood. You can find a good supermarket and a CVS pharmacy just around the corner, what is pretty useful for daily life. Also, subway is 2 minutes walking from the building and you can get to Times Square in 20 minutes, maybe a little far away for some other central places (30 minutes) because of the train changes needed.

In the flat, you can find basic stuff in the kitchen and in the bathroom. The room has a large wardrobe and storage stuff which helped me to keep all in order.

The main point I think it could be better was the cleaning. The flat wasn’t particularly clean a couple of weeks but Marina explained me the cleaning service had a problem and it couldn’t work, so she came and tidied up the common areas.

Apart from that, everything was OK.

Thank you!
reviews[42].comments: Marina's place is near to the train station and bus station. Easy to get around. There's a CVS store 2 mins away so you can get your grocery done easily. The bedroom is similar to the pictures on Airbnb. Overall, would recommend this place if you are in newyork.
reviews[43].comments: Good place to stay if you want to be down and out in Harlem. Easy enough to park and just two minutes away from the world famous Apollo Theater. Nice restaurants and bars close enough to make the hectic NY life, slow down a bit and enjoyable.
reviews[44].comments: Good place to spend some days in NYC
reviews[45].comments: Good location, you get what you see. Late check in might was a bit challenging, otherwise free of hassles. Thanks to Marina
reviews[46].comments: Great place to stay, great location, very safe. Only 2 minutes from the metro, 14 minutes ride from times square on metro. \nMarina was very nice. She did  everything she can to make sure i can check in early and put my bags in the apartment, even though no body was home. Marina was always available for any question. I will defently stay here again next time im in ny.
reviews[47].comments: This was a great place. The room(and apartment) was comfortable and suitable for long term stays(I stayed here for almost 4 months). It is very close to subway and groceries. The building is very safe. Marina is always helpful and showed great effort to make me feel comfortable. Her brother George who was staying in the apartment was also very friendly. I found bathroom and kitchen pretty clean. The neighborhood is quite interesting as well.  I found it a little noisy at the beginning but got used to it. It took me about 20-25 min by walk to reach to other side of Columbia campus(Mathematics hall), this is probably a reasonable time for NYC.
reviews[48].comments: Whether you're looking for a short term or long term stay in New York, this is the place for you. Marina is an incredible host and was very responsive. The spot couldn't be more convenient with the 2&3 subway right on the block. I would 10/10 recommend this spot!!
reviews[49].comments: The room was cozy with a comfortable bed. Location is excellent... just half a block from the subway. Marina was very responsive to my questions/messages and she made check-in and check-out very simple and convenient.
reviews[50].comments: O imóvel é muito bem localizado, próximo da entrada norte do Central Park, do metrô e de lojas e mercados, em rua muito tranquila. A cama é bastante confortável e a host disponibilizou lençol, cobertor e toalhas. Não está exatamente como nas fotos, mas as alterações não são significaticas. A limpeza do quarto e da cozinha e a organização da cozinha deixam a desejar se o hóspede estiver acostumado com ambientes limpos, organizados e arejados, mas não é algo que inviabiliza o uso dos espaços e a estada.
reviews[51].comments: vety nice room and service. only problem is the noise outside.
reviews[52].comments: It was a great place to stay. Really comfortable and close to the subway. \nMarina gave us clear instructions and recommend us some things as well. \nI would definitely repeat this booking.
reviews[53].comments: Marina’s room is a great value for anyone wanting to visit NYC. The room is less than a block from the subway, so getting anywhere throughout the city is extremely easy. It’s also less than a 10 minute walk from Central Park. The area around the room is incredibly diverse and cool to visit. So many cultures in one area. I never felt unsafe, even walking back several blocks after midnight. Marina allows you to use the fridge and any eating utensils you need. There is street parking near the apartment, but it might be difficult to find a spot depending on what time you arrive and you might have to move your car on certain days for street cleaning in order to avoid tickets. There is a parking garage behind the apartment that charges about $20 per day if you use SpotHero. Marina is incredibly friendly and she was very flexible with us for our check in. She is knowledgeable about the area if you need suggestions. I would highly recommend this apartment.
reviews[54].comments: Marina is a great host and the apartment is in a safe area. The 2/3 trains stop at the corner of the block and you can walk a couple of blocks in either direction for other lines. There is a gym right next to the apartment which was extremely convenient. Marina gets back to you quickly and addresses your concerns. Overall a wonderful experience.
reviews[55].comments: The room was exactly as shown, very comfortable for a single person or a couple. The location is as good as you can get for the price, the subway is very close (3mins walk) and you can take the express trains 2 and 3, so you can get to Lower Manhattan in 30mins or less.
reviews[56].comments: It is convenient place to go to Manhattans. A train station is near from the place. But a little bit loud at night.

reviews[7].comments:
Mon séjour à NY était super ! Je suis ravie. 
De plus, Wayne est un hôte génial. Il est hospitalier, chaleureux, disponible pour répondre aux questions, discret pour ceux qui préfèrent rester dans leur coin, amical avec ceux qui préfèrent discuter et partager leurs expériences. N'hésitez pas à lui poser des questions ou à lui demander des tuyaux.  La maison est propre, ainsi que la salle de bains, avec une cuisine spacieuse et équipée. 
J'espère que vous aurez la chance de croiser d'autres locataires chez lui qui soient aussi sympathiques que ceux que j'ai rencontrés moi-même. 
Le quartier peut donner une première impression de dangerosité mais en réalité, il n'y en a pas. Il est juste moins animé que le centre ville et moins éclairé. Les gens sont sympathiques et respectueux. 
La ligne de métro est à 5 minutes de marche et vous êtes à Times Square en 20 minutes.  
Amusez-vous bien !

reviews[41].comments:
I went to New York on holidays, and found this airbnb on really short notice, so I was glad it worked out that quickly and that easily. 
Wayne is a super accomodating host, although I didn't see him much as he he also super busy. However, his team helped me out, whenever I had a question. 
The area of this room is a beautiful, family-friendly area in Harlem, about 4 blocks from the next subway, which was very handy. Safety concerns were completely out of place, even at night I never saw any sketchy people around. 
The semi-private room is a bed in the general living room that is hidden behind screens in the corner. I didn't find it too loud at all to sleep there, if anything, it was the nearby staircase into the living room that made some noise. I didn't mind that, though, as it was always only early evening and morning, when there was some noise (and obviously I didn't come to NYC to sleep in till noon). 
The house itself is a gorgious brick house with lots of floors and rooms, the kitchen is huge (and you can use that, too) and it even has a backyard. 
All in all I found it a pleasant stay at Wayne's place, the price is very reasonable for New York standards (don't forget you're in Manhattan!). I can absolutely recommend it!

reviews[101].comments: Das war meine erste Airbnb Erfahrung überhaupt, und ich war deshalb zu Beginn ein wenig nervös, ob alles gut klappen würde. Vom JFK bin ich mit der Bahn angereist und weil ich aufgrund einer Verspätung meinen Anschlussflieger verpasst habe, bin ich erst um 3 Uhr Nachts bei Wayne abgenommen. Ich hatte ihm das aber von London aus geschrieben und er hat mir auch sofort geantwortet, das er den Schlüssel in einer Schlüsselbox für mich hinterlegt, und hat mir zu dieser den Code gegeben. Fand ich super. In der Nacht ist er dann sogar aufgestanden, als ich angekommen bin, und hat mir mein Bett gezeigt. Ich habe dann den Schlüssel für das Haus bekommen und konnte mich auf meine Entdeckungstour von New York begeben. Das war vom Haus aus auch sehr gut zu erledigen, da 2 Subway Stationen in der unmittelbaren Nähe sind mit denen man in nur wenigen Minuten direkt am Times Square sein kann, was ein immenser Vorteil ist. Das Internet bei ihm ist sehr schnell, was mir geholfen hat Mithilfe des Internets meine Tripps gut zu planen. Ich habe mich im Haus von Wayne sehr wohl gefühlt. Man kommt sich vor, als ob man bei einem guten alten Freund übernachtet. Er ist hilfsbereit wenn man Hilfe braucht, aber sonst sehr diskret. Ab und an mal, habe ich andere Gäste in der grossen Küche gesehen, die man auch benutzen kann, und wir haben uns gegenseitig über New York ausgetauscht, was man am besten wie besichtigt, aber da das Haus sehr groß ist, ist man sich sonst kaum über den Weg gelaufen. Es ist alles sehr sauber, was für mich mit am wichtigsten war. Das Bett was ich hatte, war in keinem abgetrennten separaten Zimmer, sondern in der hinteren Ecke des Wohnzimmers, das sollte man vor der Buchung wissen. Aber das hat mich persönlich nicht besonders gestört, weil ich eh den ganzen Tag unterwegs war. Dafür war mein Aufenthalt dort auch unheimlich günstig. Für wen das aber nichts ist, der kann bei Wayne aber auch ein normales Zimmer buchen, da er noch einige anbietet. Für den Zeitraum, für den ich gebucht hatte, waren die anderen Zimmer aber schon vermietet, so das mir nur dieses angeboten wurde. Was wie gesagt für mich voll in Ordnung ging, da ich immer sehr spät abends erst zurück gekommen bin von meinen Trips und morgens immer früh raus, da ich meine Zeit gut nutzen wollte. In der Nähe gibt es einen Supermarkt wo ihr alles einkaufen könnt was ihr braucht, falls ihr Zuhause frühstücken oder essen wollt. Die Sachen könnt ihr im Kühlschrank aufbewahren und auch wenn ihr mal Zuhause Verschnaufen wollt könnt ihr das im Wohnzimmer von Wayne bei guter Musik tun, alles kein Problem. Ich kann die Unterkunft nur wärmstens empfehlen. Wayne ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber, der einen sofort das Gefühl gibt, willkommen zu sein. Wir hatten uns auch einige male unterhalten und er ist ein wirklich netter, intelligenter und sozialer Mensch mit den Herzen an richtig Fleck. Wenn ihr ein Zimmer...

reviews[6].comments:
My partner and I stayed here for two nights on a recent trip to NYC, and we couldn't have been happier. This place is the stuff AirBnB dreams are made of. 

The peaceful vibe throughout the Harlem Flophouse was a welcome respite from a chaotic week of trip planning. We arrived with just enough time to get ready and make a show we had tickets for, but I would have been happy to have dropped our bags and wandered around the house.

The room was much bigger than I expected, with beautiful polished wood floors and large windows that allowed the natural light to showcase all of the interesting and quirky details that made this place so memorable. 

My favorite little detail (that I never would have noticed had René not pointed it out) were the cigarette burn marks in the wood mantle over the decorative fireplace-remnants of the house's rich history, lovingly and respectfully preserved.

As far as the actual logistics, we left our car in a garage just around the corner. The subway was a short walk away, and a quick ride into Times Square. The bed was super comfy (oh god, the comforter!). The bathroom was beautiful, with a claw foot tub and incredible water pressure (there's another cool little detail in the ceiling above the toilet-don't forget to look!). There's also an additional sink in the room, which is great. René was easy to get in touch with and very responsive. Oh, one thing to note- if you're a lover of makeup, bring a little travel mirror and take advantage of the light by the windows.

At the risk of sounding like the most touristy tourist ever, it was great to feel like we were getting a taste of the "real" New York City, without the flashy corporate packaging of the "Times Square Experience."

Anyway, we loved it, and will certainly be back. Thanks for a great stay, René!

reviews[12].comments:
We loved this place. The common areas are gorgeous, the room is spacious and well-decorated and comfortable. René was a great host; not much interaction with him (but we like to just do our own thing, generally) but he was very friendly and accommodating. Check-in was a breeze and we even had help from his friendly cat Phoebe.

Note that this is a heritage building with mostly period decor and amenities. We had no issues whatsoever with this, but others may be looking for something more modern. Temperature control, for instance, may be an issue for some. We were there during a cool, rainy week so it was not an issue but it seemed like the 3rd-floor room might be a bit hot in the heat of summer. Can't be sure, though.

I've stayed in close to half a dozen NYC airbnbs now, and this was the closest I've been to the subway. The nearest station is just a 2-minute walk away and the A, B, C, and D trains stop there. The next nearest is a 5-minute walk away and the 2 and 3 trains stop there. Plus, if you're considering using the M60 bus to/from LaGuardia, it stops at the aforementioned stations as well. You are very connected to all of Manhattan and NYC in general at this location, despite not being anywhere near midtown or lower Manhattan.

As for proximity to food/nightlife/sightseeing, we didn't check out much in the area since we had visited Harlem before and checked out some other stuff around NYC instead. That said, we grabbed breakfast at Bo's Bagels on nearby 116th st. every morning (highly recommended!) and there seemed to be a number of other dining options around there. And there is certainly fun and food to be had in the greater Harlem area.

We felt relatively safe in the neighbourhood and had no trouble. Ignore what you hear about Harlem's reputation esp. from those who haven't been to NY in years (or at all). Although 125th st. is often filled with activity (and not all of it on the up-and-up) at all hours of the night, the rest of the area is just a residential neighbourhood, full of families and people of all ages just going about their lives. I mean, as with anywhere you're thinking of staying in a city like NY, do your research and make sure that the area is for you.

Overall, if you want a historic Harlem/New York experience, you simply must check this place out, but be aware of what is offered and what you're looking for in a stay.

reviews[26].comments:
A quirky place located within an easy walk to the subway and historic locations.   The neighborhood was much quieter than I expected. 

Be ready to walk some stairs, and take slippers or socks with grips on them because the stairs inside are both steep, and narrow. The curved landing is especially tricky if you aren't very careful.

The bathroom on each floor is shared, which was fine because there was a sink in my room making things more private and convenient. In keeping with the decor, the sinks had separate hot and cold taps which is very cute, if a bit annoying for those used to more modern plumbing.

Parking was an issue as it is everywhere else in Manhattan, so be aware of this if you are driving in.
reviews[27].comments: This is a unique lodging experience.  The neighborhood is quiet at night and the house is a classic Brownstone. Steps creak, soft jazz plays in the reception area and the bathrooms are generous in size.  For subway riders, the stop is less than three blocks away and it is an easy trip down Manhattan on either the local or express trains.  Not too many restaurants in the immediate vicinity but several in walking distance. Great music nearby.  I felt very safe walking the area at night and in the day.  Whole Foods Market is nearby. Erika's place is a great find and an almost unbeatable value for its price.
You're close to the 125th street subway station, which is important because you'll have to use it a lot if you want to discover anything else than Harlem or the Columbia University area.
It takes about 30 - 40 minutes to get to the city center.

The place itself was as described: a room that accommodates two with nothing of note.
It was airconditioned, roomy and quiet at night... so perfectly adequate!
Don't expect too much from the common areas though, it's an older building with its blemishes and a private room in a shared appartement.

We didn't get to meet Erika in person, but we got a very hospitable welcome from her roommate Ellen.
In fact, her roommates were a real added value because they weren't only super welcoming, they also were our window into the twenty-something lifestyle in this wonderful city.

Sarah was a very nice host. The bedroom was clean and the bed was very comfortable. The distance to the subway is 4 minutes by foot and the ride to Times Square is only 10 minutes with the express subway. We never felt insecure in the neighborhood so please forget about the Harlem Story’s. These are so 1990. It was my third stay in Harlem and every time was great. 

The problem is that the walls of the apartment are very thin, so you hear all the noise. Whether the conversations of the neighbours, the barking dog and crying baby of them or if someone in the apartment turns on the stove or is making any other noise. 
Since Sarah works in the evening and comes home late at night, you really hear every step when she prepares something to eat then. We bought ear plugs, so it was okay. We therefore really recommend that anyone who does not sleep like a stone should take ear plugs. We were around Helloween and Sarah had a very tight schedule so we barely saw her. It was absolutely no problem for us because we like being independent. Unfortunately, you also saw the absence in the cleanliness of the bathroom and the kitchen. There are dust and dirt in the corners. I do not want to say that it was absolutely bad, but it was not really clean either.

The fact that Sarah works at night you should be very considerate in the morning, so it is better to get the breakfast away from home, otherwise she will notice everything and her sleep will be interrupted and since you are good guests you don‘t want that to happen ;-)

You have to live out of the suitcase. It would be great to have a little rack or closet in the room to store the luggage. Also a small mirror on the wall would be perfect, so one could get ready in the bathroom and the other in the bedroom. But these are only little suggestions no real big problems. 

Considering the price for a New York accommodation, I'd like to point out that you can not expect a 5 star hotel but a solid place to stay if you're in NYC all day.

Therefore the following points:
Price: 5 out of 5 points
Cleanliness: 2,5 out of 5 points
Noise: 1,5 out of 5 points
Host: 4 out of 5 points
Neighborhood: 4,5 out of 5 points
Equipment: 2,5 out of 5 points

Total: 3,5 out of 5 points

Les deux seuls petits bémols :
- La chambre qui ne peut être verrouillée à clé (le verrou est usé et s'ouvre sans trop forcé même lorsque la poignée est bloquée par la clé). Néanmoins, Chikie semble être un hôte responsable et de confiance, il n'est jamais venu ne serait-ce que toquer à la porte pendant le séjour.
- Ma femme a vu un petit cafard dans la cuisine (à deux reprises). L'appartement est pourtant très propre, entretenu et épuré, cela provient surement du voisinage.

L'appartement est très bien situé, dans le quartier de Harlem, à trois minutes à pied de la station 137th street sur la ligne 1 du métro. On peut se rendre en 15-20 min à Times Square et en 10 min à Central Park. Il y a également un bus juste devant le bâtiment sur Amsterdam avenue.

Le voisinage est vraiment sympathique, nous n'avons pas eu de sentiment d'insécurité. Ambiance portoricaine au rendez-vous ! Le quartier est très vivant durant la soirée.

Pour conclure, je ne peux que vous recommander de choisir Chikie comme hôte, notamment pour le rapport qualité/prix qu'il propose. Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour !

Excelente anfitrião. 

Desde o contato antes da viagem até o último momento em New York, Chikie foi muito prestativo e simpático. Divertido, amigável, pronto para ajudar a qualquer momento, eu me senti em casa lá. 

O bairro no Harlem fica bem localizado, próximo a duas linhas do mêtro (A/B/C são juntas e 1), sendo que o mais próximo fica a uma distância de uns 100 metros (137 St - Linha 1). Próximo a mercado, lavanderia, restaurantes regionais e parques. 

O apartamento deve apresentar uns 60 m2, o que é considerado grande para NY. Todos os cômodos estavam sempre limpos e organizados. Na minha estadia (última semana do ano de 2015), Chikie recebeu amigos e familiares em seu apartamento, portanto sempre havia pessoas por lá e todas prestativas e amigas. Principalmente o amigo George, que todas as vezes perguntava a minha mãe ou a mim como estavámos e como tinha sido o dia em NY, muito simpatico. 

O quarto é privativo e muito aconchegante, o Chikie entrega a chave do quarto para maior privacidade, além do mais ele disponilizou um Ipad para maior comodidade. O quarto tem uma cama de casal, televisão, um armário com gavetas e alguns folhetos com guia de NY. Deve apresentar uns 12 a 16 m2.  

A próxima viagem a NY tenho a certeza que voltarei ao apartamento do Chikie, ele é um anfitrião perfeito. No último dia me ajudou inclusive com as malas até o mêtro. 

Todos os valores de metragem do apartamento e quarto não são precisos, porém, devem se aproximar da realidade. 

Lugar ideal para quem quer se sentir em casa! 

I hope see you soon again Chikie!

reviews[0].comments:
Great place! The neighborhood is lively. The supermarket and subway stop is literally right around the corner. Laundromat is a block and half away. Central Park is really close as well! It's really such a convenient place to be. The apartment was really nice. The bed was comfortable. Everything in David's description was spot on. 

We did run into a few problems. There were cat or dog hairs in the space. The ad said no pets allowed but somehow the hairs were there and it set off my husband's allergies a bit. In addition to the animal hairs, the space could have been a tad bit cleaner overall. It wasn't too big of an issue though. We just did a wipe down ourselves. Also, the heater was CRAZY hot and we were unable to adjust it. We had to leave the window wide open or have the AC running most times. 

Overall though, if we had to stay there again, we would. Great convenient place to be.
reviews[1].comments: The apartment is very modern and clean. The apartment looks the same as in the pictures and the description of david fits perfectly. An enormous advantage is the subway connection. With the 6 train you can get everywhere in manhattan. There are also very much restaurants & shops close by. \nThe house is relatively quiet and the neighbors are friendly. David was always to be reached if there were problems or I had questions.\nI would recommend the apartment to anyone and i really enjoyed my stay :-)
reviews[2].comments: I stayed at David's place for a month in September 2017. It is a nicely furnished, small studio. Besides bathroom, it has only a common space where all the living/sleeping furniture is placed together with the kitchen cabinets. So, I would not recommend this apartment for more than 2 people. However, if you are 1-2 people, this apartment can be a perfectly affordable and convenient accommodation for you. \nThe apartment is equipped with all the basic stuff one might need for a few-weeks stay. Small grocery items (e.g. pepper, oil etc.) were the only thing that was missing compared to other airbnbs I stayed in. So if you want to cook anything at home, you would have to either bring these items with you or buy them in a local store (which is just around the corner). \nA Subway stop is just around the corner (train 6) and a ride to Midtown takes about 20 minutes.
reviews[3].comments: David's place was exactly as pictured and described. It's nicely furnished with high ceilings and all appliances in working order. The neighborhood has some good spots to eat/drink, along with good subway access and proximity to the park.\n\nDavid himself was a pleasure to deal with. Would stay again!

reviews[46].comments:

neighborhood_overview: This neighborhood is very unique with a mix of Dominican, Cuban, Greek, Jewish and Russian cultures in an authentic NYC style. As one of our guests put it, "It feels like you're in another country--only in New York!" Don't let the bigness of this neighborhood deter you from appreciating it for what it is: pure New York City! Washington Heights as a whole has been known to be the haven of old-school artists (unlike the emerging young artists populating Williamsburg). Many painters, writers, opera singers and dancers have called this place their home since the early 20th century, including Lin-Manuel Miranda, creator of the critically-acclaimed Hamilton musical. Some of our local fave eateries include... Saggio's--revel in the divine roasted fennel Tampopo Ramen--dig into the yummy Bao buns with a Japanese beer  Mambi--try the tasty Latin rotisserie chicken, rice & beans, sweet plantains Pick n' Eat--chomp away at the gluten-free pizza  Burger Heights--get the classic + sweet potato frie

host.host_about:
Welcome home! 

As someone who loves traveling, I can appreciate when wanderlust hits. Some of my special voyages include: my first solo overseas trip to Paris; backcountry trips to Glacier National Park in Montana; Gongga Shan in Sichuan, China; a tango excursion in Buenos Aires; 8 months living in a village in Madagascar; a summer in Costa Rica next to Corcovado National Park. 

Now, I am planting roots in the Big Apple because its eclectic energy makes it a daily adventure every time I step out my door. We are thrilled to be able to share our vibrant city and our lovely space with people from all over the planet. We are excited to meet you!

***NEW HOSTS*** 
If you desire some pointers in successfully getting started as a host, I would be delighted to refer you as well as share my insights and strategies.

Isabella and her family are most gracious, welcoming and warm. They truly made me feel at home while still having my privacy. I felt pampered with the lovely space, the luxurious amenities and beautiful ambiance. It is peaceful, especially gazing out the window last night while it was snowing. Great time for my journaling. The heater can get the room quite toasty and you have the option to turn it off. I enjoyed great rest in this mini paradise. Isabella goes beyond the call of duty in wanting to make her guests feel comfortable. I am very grateful. The listing was described accurately and the room was even better than expected. It is immaculate, cozy and stylish. Isabella really anticipates the needs of her guests--like an international outlet charger. 
The neighborhood bustles with NYC energy.  I hear it's a true NY community. Cool to be away from the routine tourist traps, yet I was still close enough to get my fill. The subway is right outside the apartment--especially neat as it was cold and blustery during my stay. I was in TSquare and WTC in a jippy on the 1 train--a perfect train line that took me everywhere and anywhere. Super convenient to get an int'l data plan from T-Mobile downstairs from the apartment. Isabella recommended great eateries in the immediate area and the really cool Cloisters museum in the Tryon park that is 15 minutes from apartment. I even traveled to Brooklyn to see a friend and the 24hr train system is safe and filled with endless shows by street performers. The A train is close when needed to get to the airports, but I got the 1 train and transferred 1 stop to A to get me to port authority. neighborhood_overview: The Upper East Side has it all. There's the UES of Edith Wharton and Gossip Girl -- the grand museums of Museum Mile, elegant shops, Park Avenue promenades. But Yorkville, where I live, has both easy access to this UES (the m86 is 30 seconds from the apartment), has a bohemian character all its own. Tons of independent bookstores, coffee shops with local poetry reading series, vintage and consignment shopping, great food. One of the few Manhattan neighborhoods to have "mom and pop" shops (you can find a local baker, fishmonger, 3 butchers, and produce shops within a 3-block radius!). One block from Carl Schurz Park and the riverside promenade.
notes: It's a lovely building -- incredibly quiet.
transit: The M86 is a half-block away -- you can look online from home to see when the bus is approaching and still make it out the door in time to get onboard. We're five minutes from the new Q-train which connects you to midtown in 15 minutes or less. The bus connects to all major train lines on the East and West sides, or it's a 5-10 minute walk to the express 4/5 and local 6 trains at 86th street.
