reviews[19].comments: Great and convenient location to stay to explore beautiful New York. This place has the basic necessities to stay and a comfortable bed to sleep in. Sufficient and safe enough for me to stay and explore NY.
reviews[20].comments:
The place was tidy and exactly as described. Definitely served my needs of being centrally located to times square and the theatre district. Only saw other houseguest once or twice in 3 days. 

Reed was polite and communicated well, and he was very understanding when I got my check out time confused with the check in time! 

I only used the shower once, it's definitely small and incredibly sensitive on the temp adjustments. The bathroom light wasn't working,  but Reed said they were waiting on the Super to fix it shop there's not much that can be done other than the small lamp they'd placed in there in the interim. Apartment lock was a pain sometimes,  and the steps up inside the building were step and seemed in need of repair. Just watch your step though, and you'll be fine.
reviews[21].comments: Great location, close to Times Square and easy for public transport. Room was cozy. Reed was friendly, helpful and easy to communicate with. There was a bit of confusion around check in when I arrived but they were able to look after me and make sure everything was sorted when I returned. Thanks Reed!
reviews[22].comments: Reed delivered everything as promised but it would have been nice to chat a bit with him.\n\nThe apartment is pretty small (by NZ  standards) with no sitting area, only your bedroom....but the location was fantastic. Just a short walkbto Times Square, all the Broadway theatres, Central Park and tge Subway so you can get around Manhatten very quickly.
reviews[23].comments: Thanks for a great stay! It is the perfect location to stay in as a tourist who wants to explore! So close to Times Square, it's only a short walk away. The bedroom was perfect for me, and the hosts did not disturb me, however were there if I needed to ask anything. Would stay here in the future and recommend to others.
reviews[24].comments:
la chambre louée par Reed est bien située non loin de Times Square. Le quartier est animé , pas mal de restaus. Reed m'a attendu sans problème alors que j'avais pris du retard pour arriver chez lui. Très accueillant.
Par contre la salle de bain est vraiment pour moi inhospitalière, petite, fonctionnant mal..... 
c'est vrai que lorsqu'on visite New York on est plus souvent à l'extérieur et sa chambre m'a bien dépannée.
Je le remercie
reviews[25].comments: Reed ha sido muy amable en todo momento! Tiempo antes de mi llegada recibió cosas por mí y contestó cada inquietud previa al viaje. Estuvo personalmente para mi llegada y me ayudó a subir las valijas por las escaleras (que no eran nada livianas).\r\nSu hermana también ha sido muy amable. Situado en un lugar privilegiado de NY, lo recomiendo fuertemente. Gracias Reed por haberme hecho sentir como en casa... Cheers! :)
reviews[26].comments: Really great host, was very kind and considerate when i showed up late. The room is small and the bathroom could be cleaner but it was very affordable and in a good area.
reviews[27].comments: Reed was very accommodating and helpful. I arrived early so he helped me store my bags before check in. The place was very small, but perfect if you're just looking for a bed. I would definitely stay with Reed again.
reviews[28].comments: A nice, simple, clean room in Hell's Kitchen with plenty of restaurants, delis and supermarkets nearby. Reed was very helpful and responsive if I needed anything, but also hands-off and happy to give you your privacy. The bathroom and kitchen are quite small so really not the sort of place I'd spend long hanging out/relaxing or cooking in, it's more about having a place to crash when you're exploring lovely NYC.
reviews[29].comments:
Reed's place is a great base for exploring manhattan. Less than ten minutes from times square, and within easy walking distance of the subway for trains to bring you uptown, downtown and into Queens or brooklyn. Ninth avenue is also bustling all day and night with plenty of great bars and restaurants, really great location. 

The room was as expected, comfortable bed, a handy well-rounded rail to hang clothes or towels, and the ac was very quiet. I didn't use the kitchen facilities, as cheap eats are so plentiful just outside, but the surfaces looked clean, and the fridge was large enough for your own food. 

It was touch and go with the hot water in the shower, sometimes really hot very quickly, or sometimes it took a while to get warm water. Nothing major though, and there was plenty of space in the shower.

You can come and go as you please at any time, very handy for the city that never sleeps! Overall a great stay, I would recommend Reed's place.
reviews[30].comments: 房主在了解我的行程好非常热心的给出了建议与入住安排,由于第一天我到的时间较晚,还特意安排了其他人帮助我check in,非常感谢｡房子所处的地点相当好,在市中心,去哪都很方便,楼下就是超市,酒吧,餐馆,但屋子里却很安静,实在是非常棒
reviews[31].comments: Perfect room. Quiet and confortable. I wouldn't mind to repeat at this apartment
reviews[32].comments: Fabulous location!!!! The street is lined with restaurants & bars & only a few blocks away from Times Square/theater district. The room was super basic, nothing fancy for sure, but the bed was bigger than I expected & super comfy. Reed was there to help me check in & answer any questions.  The place is very small, but had everything I needed for my 2 night stay. Would definitely recommend!!
reviews[33].comments: Me encanto este departamento!!! la zona donde esta es increíble, cerca a todo, al Subterráneo, a las tiendas,  Reed no se encontraba pero su hermana es de las mejores anfitrionas, estaba pendiente de lo que necesitaba, me ayudaba y era muy servicial. cuando regrese a NYC volveré a este lugar.
reviews[34].comments: The bed is actually larger than it appears in the photo and the room is fairly dark, which was great for sleeping.  The location is right in the middle of Hell's Kitchen and really great for those looking to be in midtown or close to the theatres.  Noise was not an issue either.  Check in and out were easy.  There was a very strong stench while I was there, but I could not locate the source.
reviews[35].comments:
Reed welcomed my very nicely, thanks for carrying my 24kg suitcase up. I stayed in the appartment were his sisters lives, she was very nice and helpful and very considerate.
The room is small, but that was clear, no complaints about that.
For a musical fan like me the location was perfect. No long train rides like the last years make this place great.
Grat lunch special for ca. $10 in Hells Kitchen make this another reason to come back
reviews[36].comments:
Reed nos contestó todas las preguntas que le hicimos a través de los mensajes de airbnb. Siempre fue muy amable.

La hermana de Reed, Fame fue muy amable durante toda nuestra estadía.
El departamento es justo para turistas que solo necesitan una cama y un baño. Nosotros alquilamos la habitación más chica y estuvo perfecto. El baño y la cocina son compartidos con los huéspedes de otra habitación y con Fame, pero nunca tuvimos problemas para usar alguno de estos ambientes. 
El departamento tiene una ubicación excelente, a unas pocas cuadras de Times Square y sobre una avenida con muchas opciones de bares y restaurates. Cerca de varias líneas de subte.

Sin duda, volveríamos al departamento de Reed!!  =)
reviews[37].comments: Everything was described at it was. Overall its a room with good wifi and good location. I was looking for those things. Nothing luxurious but it does the job and at good value and location too.
reviews[38].comments: small, but big enough, room in a good location for a couple days of NYC.
reviews[39].comments: Excellent place! Reed and Jan are really nice people, and they are now my friends in NYC. Im glad to make a reservation with them. Very polite people, the place had everything they anounced in the description. The place is really close to the Times squares, and only 1 block away from the metro, excellent location. I would make a reservation with them again the next time in NYC.
reviews[40].comments:
Fame was polite and helpful and helped me out when I lost my phone which I am grateful for. 
The location is brilliant, the space itself was tiny and cramped. There were other guests staying there so there was 5 adults using one tiny grotty bathroom. The kitchen was simple unusable.
The bedroom had no where to put clothes, two hangers only were provided and there was no curtain on the window. 
This is basic at best.
reviews[41].comments: Great location and host is super accommadating.
reviews[42].comments: Reed is a great host! Though I only met him once I could reach him\nthrough texts at anytime. The apartment's location was super great! It was in the middle of many nice restaurants and supermarkets and very close to subway station. Though the room that i booked was small, but it was enough for me. I surely will stay here again next time!
reviews[43].comments: The location is excellent, room is small but all you need. The apartment space is very small and you will be sharing with two others on the same floor. Only gripe would be the need for basic cleaning of the bathroom and toilet would have been nice as it was quite unclean. If you want a cheap stay in New York this is for you, if you have high standards of cleanliness and want a bit of space probably not for you. I enjoyed my stay due to the great proximity to Times Square.
reviews[44].comments: Jan was there to check me in when I arrive, she explained everything and offer help with everything. The location is perfect, it's close to lots of restaurants and bars, Times Square, subway. The room is small but very comfy to just sleep (a little bit too hot cause of the heater), the other facilities are fine to. I would definitely recommend for who is looking for a BB.
reviews[45].comments: Tolle Lage (Musicals, Subway, Bus...). Freundliche Kommunikation. Alles lief sehr zuverlässig.Das Zimmer selbst ist klein, das Bett ist für eine Person optimal. Zimmer sauber.Heizung ließ sich leider nicht regulieren, lief tagsüber voll Power und nachts garnicht.Eigentlich kein Tageslicht,Fenster führt in Schacht zwischen 2 Häuser.Küche nicht überbewerten. Es ist alles da,was man für ein paar Tage NYC braucht.Leute total nett.1a-Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.Ich würde es weiterempfehlen. Wer allesdings etwas Ansprüche an Bad und Küche hat oder auch an Tageslicht oder z.B. Heizung, der ist hier nicht richtig. Dafür ist es preiswert. Das Bett war gut, roch frisch und man schlief gut. Viel Spaß allen, die nach mir kommen! Und viele Grüße an Reed und seine Schwester - beides sehr hilfsbereite Menschen!!
reviews[46].comments: Room small and greasy. Bed smells. No one does the cleaning through my whole stay. No sunlight in the room. Weird and loud noises from upper and down floors come occasionally. Host didn't respond to my texts or airbnb messages until I knocked at the door. Great location and great food around, but I'm simply very disappointed at the cleanliness and the service.\nIn addition to that, you are expected to share the bathroom with 4 other people.
reviews[47].comments: I surely recommend this room if you are going to visit midtown NYC. Room is pretty small but it fits the case, and hosts are really kind .
reviews[48].comments: Great location, 5 min walking distance to times square
reviews[49].comments: Location is perfect
reviews[50].comments:
Stayed 10 days.

Very good location.  Metro, Broadway, Restaurants and markets are near

Affordable cost.

Very very comfortable bed.


Downside
1. Small bathroom
reviews[51].comments: Good place if you want to be near Times square. Small, as stated in the ad but good enough for people who just wants a place to sleep.
reviews[52].comments:
In general you get what you "ordered". The room was small (about 2x3 meters), enough space for the bed and your luggage. While the bed is very soft (some might find it too soft) the only problem is the radiator, which cannot be controlled and is a little bit noisy (hissing and clanging). Since it was cold outside, I didn't mind the heat, though it was really warm.
The bathroom and kitchen are very tiny, just enough space to stand. It's good enough if you stay out all day and just need a place to sleep. The area is perfect, you have different food places nearby and it's close to Times Square. Just don't expect much for that price.
I had fresh towels and beddings, the room was clean. Kitchen had washed up dishes, bathroom was ok. Fame herself is clean, depends a little bit on the other guest staying there.
I only saw Fame when I checked in and when I left. But via airbnb messages she was always available (not that I needed it).
If you don't have US mobile connections like I did, the check-in can be tricky. Fame wasn't in the aparment when I got there, but at her mothers place one floor above. The doorbell is supposed to ring there, too, however it didn't. Fortunatly the neighboor knew that her mother lives upstairs so I wen't there and knocked to finally get inside. 
All in all, good place to stay for a short visit to NYC especially if you plan on visiting the city most of the time. For sleeping its perfectly fine.
reviews[53].comments: Great location, privacy, comfortable bed (that is bigger than it seems in the pictures). I would definitely stay there again. No complaints at all. :)
reviews[54].comments: je bent midden in het centrum
reviews[55].comments: Very good location! Close to Times Square. The room felt a bit bigger than in looks on the pictures.\nOn the other side of the room you will finde enough space to hang your clothes. The room is very clean. Thanks Reed, I recommended you to my friends already.
reviews[56].comments: Very good location, lovely guests and nice price. I totally recommend it to everyone!!!!!
reviews[57].comments: Great location. Friendly amazing host
reviews[58].comments: Perfect ubication near Times Square & public transportation. Small room but perfect for my stay. Totally would return...
reviews[59].comments: Logement très bien situé proche de Times Square, central park... Dans une rue très vivante, et pourtant l'appartement reste assez calme. Le séjour a été très agréable. Les occupant sont assez discrets et laissent à libre disposition les équipements de l'appartement. Merci pour l'accueil ce fut des vacances inoubliables
reviews[60].comments: Amazing place! It's small but cozy, and the bed is really comfortable. There's a place to hang your clothes, hair dryer, window AC and fan. It's very clean and I hope I can stay here again next time I visit NY!
reviews[61].comments: A nice place.
reviews[62].comments: Overall, a very good experience. I had a few requests to make for my stay and they were able to accommodate me. I got quick responses to my messages. Checking in/out was easy and quick. My room was quiet and private. Using the shared facilities like the restroom and the kitchen was no issue. I had no problems during my stay and the hosts were very nice and respectful. The experience was beyond my expectations and I'd definitely recommend this place.
reviews[63].comments: O quarto é bom custo e benefício. Porém é um pouco pequeno o apartamento. A água do chuveiro as vezes ficava frio, mas como fui  no verão, isso não foi um problema tão sério. \nVale a pena se for pra ficar o dia todo fora e só usar o local pra dormir.\nA localização é muito boa. Perto da Times e de restaurantes
reviews[64].comments: So great!!
reviews[65].comments: Wonderful location for those who wish to enjoy musicals and the atmosphere in NYC. Great host and very cozy room. Highly recommended!\n
reviews[66].comments: The room is exactly like the photo! Both girls are super welcoming and always available. The best thing about this place is the location, in 10min you are in Times Square. No complaints, all clean & comfortable. I definitely recommend it!
reviews[67].comments: The position of the apartment is really continent for u to enjoy your time in NY and its not expensive.Landlord  is very friendly.
reviews[68].comments:
I was surprised at the size on entering the room. It seemed small, however, it is exactly as pictured and had enough room for my things. The bed was very comfortable. 

I never used the kitchen, as the lone table seemed crowded. There any places to get something eat within a few meters of stepping outside of the building. I preferred the 7 Brothers Deli.

The bathroom was pretty good, having many essentials, like floss and mouthwash. There was a minor lighting issue, but it got fixed during the course of my stay.
 
The hosts were generally responsive. I always got a response on the same day of the question.

It is a good place to crash after exploring New York. The only thing to be wary of is the WiFi speed. It was generally great for giving family and friends Status updates, but it was terrible for streaming video. I suspect that it was due to wireless interference from other apartments, but I can't say for certain. To compensate, I bought an unlimited 4G LTE prepaid plan from T-Mobile ($75 plus tax) for my streaming video needs.

Overall a great place.
reviews[69].comments: Recommended. It's a cozy and clean room where I stayed for one week. Its walkable to several subway stations, close to many different kind of restaurants and bars. The hosts are very nice, always helpful and considerable. I will recommend this place to my friends!
reviews[70].comments: What I liked is how everything in the description was accurate.
reviews[71].comments: The hosts were really nice and kind. Small apartment and small room. Fantastic location! Recommended for tourists who will spent most of the day in the city :)
reviews[72].comments: Very comfortable room (especially the bed) with an amazing location! The hosts are kind and always willing to help. Thanks :)
reviews[73].comments: Nice, comfortable and well localized. I had the best time in NYC and could enjoy Manhattan and it's night life thanks to this place. If I ever go back, that's where I'm staying for sure!
reviews[74].comments: Great Location for the Price! Very friendly Host! Would definitely recommend!
reviews[75].comments:
These hosts are really heart-warming hosts.
Room has comfortable bed and I could have sleep well everyday.
And the location is also best. There are 2 24-hours shops around the room I could my breakfast easily.

I sincerely appreciated their kindness.
reviews[76].comments: Molto gentile è disponibile. Come essere a casa. Distante 5 minuti a piedi da 50street Subway è da Times Square. Lo consiglio a single come me, e per chi va per visitare New York. Se dovessi tornare in nyc ci ritornerei .
reviews[77].comments: Great cosy apartment in an extremely convienent location, so many shops and restaurants around and every major subway line is a short walk away (at time square)
reviews[78].comments: Para aquellos viajeros que requieran un lugar donde dormir y bañarse, es perfecto. Quizás el baño puede ser un poco pequeño, pero del resto todo está bien. El departamento cumple con lo necesario para disfrutar de New York y más; te da la experiencia de vivir y sentir la ciudad desde un angulo diferente y que te inmiscuye en la vida diaria de la urbe. Lo mejor es lo céntrico y conectado que está con algunos de los puntos mas importantes de Manhattan (dos calles de times square). En cuestión de los caseros, tuve la oportunidad de convivir con Jan, y me ayudo en todo lo que necesité, incluyendo ayudarme con la impresión de documentos relacionados al viaje. Sin duda regresaría una y otra vez!
reviews[79].comments:
No bed bugs, Clean room
Near Subway station (walk 3~5min)
Near 24h market(walk 10sec)
Hosts are gentle and kind
I was so glad to stay this house.
reviews[80].comments: Reed family is so great hosts!! so kind, so friendly. I could check in easily. It is so close to Times Square, the access is very good. \nThe building is old, Perhaps you may take a shower a little hard. \nBut I had a great time because of you. Thank you!
reviews[81].comments: The hosts were very kind and accommodating. I left early because I was drugged at a bar down the street and felt very uncomfortable staying there afterward, understandably. I don't recommend this place to a female travelling alone. Not because of the hosts (they're very sweet!) but because I did NOT feel safe alone in the area. It takes a lot for me to say that, as I travel alone quite often. The only negative about the place itself was the fact that they didn't let anyone know that you're not allowed to flush toilet paper in their toilet (until you got there). So there was a bag hanging on nails with everyone's used toilet paper in it. I felt that should have been disclosed.
reviews[82].comments: room is very small and nice for 1 person! i loved the stay and was close to timessquare!
reviews[83].comments: Good place, perfect location,and friendly host.\nIf you need a place to come and sleep at night while you are doing errands during the day, this is the place.
reviews[84].comments: Reed’s place is in an excellent location for discovering NY. The room itself is a good size has a comfortable bed and everything you would need for a stress free stay. The location is the absolute highlight and considering the price is excellent value for money !
reviews[85].comments: The room is small but good for the price. Essentially this room is exactly as advertised, I didn’t see the host or other guests much, but I was quite busy the whole time. Times Square and Broadway theaters are certainly in reasonable walking distance. I didn’t try waking anywhere else. This room is an outstanding value, not fancy, but reasonable.
reviews[86].comments: Buenas tardes, en cuánto a la estadía y la llegada todo bien. Ya habíamos acordado el horario de dejar las maletas así que bien. La comunicación y las indicaciones son muy malas, en realidad no hubo. Ni siquiera se preguntó si en algún momento necesitaba algo o me sentía bien. El baño y la cocina no estaban en buenas condiciones . Un poco sucio. Lo mejor es la ubicación y la habitación y tranquilidad con la que se pudo descansar. Lo peor la comunicación, y la hospitalidad por parte de los anfitriones. Y el último día ni siquiera estaban para dejar la llaves.
reviews[87].comments:
La ubicación del departamento, junto con el precio, fueron lo mejor. Es muy cómodo para moverse en la ciudad, cerca de los subtes, Times Square y las avenidas. La habitación estaba mejor de lo que esperaba, en las fotos parecía más chica de lo que era. Viajé sola con dos valijas y estuve muy cómoda.
La cama era súper cómoda!

Las chicas (Jan y Fame) fueron muy amables, inclusive me permitieron dejar las valijas antes del horario de entrada y también después de dejar la habitación, eso fue de gran ayuda.

Lo único que mejoraría es la limpieza del baño. No era de terror ni mucho menos, pero si podría haber estado un poco más limpio. Aunque puede haber tenido que ver con los otros huéspedes.

Muy agradecida y conforme en general!
reviews[88].comments: Thank you for all ! I had great time in NYC, perfect localization of the accommodation, reactivity and flexibility of the host, quiet place, Thanks ! _^
reviews[89].comments: We wanna to thank Reed, Jan, Fame and Keng for all the kind in receiving us and hospitality that they have shown. Their place is very well located, near of many tourist points in NY and subway stations. The room was really good, following what the photos show. There was a little confusion in the first day - changed rooms - that was rapidly and very well solved by them. We recommend their place! \n
reviews[90].comments: The apartment is quite small but the bedroom is perfect if you are all by yourself. Reed and Jan were super organized with the check-in and the check-out and their welcome was amazing. They were very kind also if I needed any information or had questions about the house.\nThis bedroom is perfect for who, like me, is looking for something simple, close to everything and the main attractions in Manhattan; the position is amazing :)))
reviews[91].comments: This is a very convenient place to stay.  While the room is small there is plenty of room for bags etc. , the air con is great and bed very comfortable.  Communication with host is excellent.
reviews[92].comments: Hey everybody! For my one week trip to NY I was staying at Reed's airbnb. It was very clean and everybody was very friendly to me. The flat is a little bit small, but I think that's normal for NY. For me it was more important, that the flat was clean! It was my first time in the US, so I often had some questions. These guys were very helpful, so I didn't have any problems to find something. I'll recommend Reed's airbnb to my friends, who like to go to the US too!
reviews[94].comments:
Bon séjour chez Reed et Jan ! La chambre se situe dans un autre appartement que le leur, avec la sœur de l’hôte ainsi qu’un autre visiteur Airbnb (un homme pour ma part durant le séjour), il faut donc parfois attendre son tour à la sdb/wc.
Chambre conforme aux photos et descriptif, très bon lit, climatisation dans la chambre ce qui est indispensable lors des grosses chaleurs, draps et serviettes fournies. 
Point noir en revanche concernant la sdb. Exiguë, pas de place pour poser ses affaires, douche et robinetterie vétustes (moisissures, eau chaude très longue à venir résultat beaucoup de douche à l’eau froide).
Cela reste tout de même un bon séjour ! Appartement très bien situé, à 2 blocs de Times Square
reviews[95].comments: I had an amazing stay at Jan and Reed's place! My flight dates changed twice prior to my trip and they were so helpful with changing my reservation dates. Check-in was super simple too as I was able to leave my luggage in the kitchen until my room was ready. The room was bigger than expected, and it was the comfiest bed ever! The location is unbeatable - it's next to so many bars and restaurants in Hell's Kitchen, plus it's 5 mins walk to Times Square. I hope to stay here next time I visit NYC! Also, for people worried about noise, it's in a lively location but my sleep was never disturbed as the room isn't facing the main road :-)
reviews[96].comments: Good value in a great location, just don't expect the Ritz.
reviews[97].comments: Very comfortable room and the apartment location is perfect, especially for people who like to see a lot of Broadway shows. Fame and Jan were very friendly hosts, too. Would definitely stay there again.
reviews[99].comments: The hosts were very nice, communication was smooth, the room was decent size and a bed was very comfy so I could sleep very well. The apartment was really quite, no noise at all. Location is fabulous, 5 mins to Time square and walkable distance to all sites- recommended!
reviews[100].comments: Nickel commr endroit super hôte rien à dire\nHôte très discrets et agréable.
reviews[102].comments: Posizione comoda, a 10 minuti a piedi da Time Square. La camera piccola ma per chi viaggia da solo è l’ideale, molto calda e letto comodissimo
reviews[103].comments: Las fotos no muestran del todo lo que realmente es el departamento, espacialmente el baño y la cocina,
reviews[104].comments: Great locacion! A great place for your first time un NYC
reviews[105].comments: La ubicación es la mejor caminas a paso lento y en 10mins ya estás en time square, es seguro, saliendo del departamento hay varias tiendas para poder comprar despensa, un metro a 5 mins caminando que te lleva hasta el WTC, la habitación es chica pero bastante bien EXCEPTO por la cama la pata de abajo a la izquierda (ya acostado) está floja y una vez se me cayo la cama de lado y por el calefactor hace muchísimo ruido en la noche. El baño igual es chico pero también bien. Y de los anfitriones poco que decir casi no los vi, no estuvieron para recibirme ni darme las llaves personalmente. Mis compañeros de departamentos increíbles muy buena onda, ellos me ayudaron mucho y me dieron consejos, ya que los anfitriones no estaban.\nPero bueno resumido, muy bueno por el precio, excelente ubicación.

host.host_about: Retired, fun-loving, outgoing, compassionate.  Love to entertain and show people the wonderment of Harlem and NYC.\r\nI love to travel and recently went on a yoga retreat to Roatan.  Read the Untethered Mind by Richard Smith as recommended before the retreat.  It was an awesome read. I am also a lover of everything entertaining!\r\nI am a fantastic hostess because I enjoy turning folks on to things most tourist would never see.  One Sunday as I was walking to church a French family asked me for directions to one of the popular churches near City University.  I talked them into coming to my church which has a fantastic a cappella choir and they had so much fun we all went to a jazz brunch afterwards where my good friend is the vocalist.  People often gravitate to my spirit which is always welcoming and receiving.

Le aspettative che avevo al momento della prenotazione riguardo questo soggiorno non sono corrisposte alle reali condizioni in cui mi sono ritrovata.
Nell'appartamento eravamo in tre anziché in due, con la madre di Kristina.
Inizialmente sono riuscita ad adattarmi ad abitudini e usi differenti dai miei, Kristina e sua madre sono state gentili nel permettermi di utilizzare il loro sale, fornirmi asciugamani puliti, prestarmi caricabatterie, sono state carine quando sono stata male, pensavo di aver instaurato un buon rapporto di convivenza, anche accettando situazioni particolari e condizioni diverse da quelle per cui avevo scelto questo alloggio, ma i successivi due mesi sono stati difficili.
Ci sono state pesanti incomprensioni verbali riguardo le condizioni igieniche e pulizie, a mio parere non accettabili e per le quali non mi sono mai lamentata, ma anzi sono stata rimproverata, e sull'utilizzo degli spazi comuni e regole casalinghe. Non mi sono sentita più  libera di muovermi in casa.
Ultima spiacevole sorpresa è stata essere svegliata il giorno del check-out per dover lasciare la stanza in anticipo rispetto a quanto Airbnb mi aveva comunicato.
Credevo Airbnb fosse un buon sistema per viaggiare, conoscere nuove persone, creare scambi culturali e magari rapporti con chi vive e conosce altre città, non è stato così e purtroppo non so se mi fiderò ancora di quel che è scritto negli annunci.
Credo che  per soggiorni lunghi come il mio non sia una buona opzione, ma per vacanze di pochi giorni, stando poco in casa, questo alloggio possa andar bene, è in una buona posizione, vicino alla metro Q, efficientissima, 20 minuti a piedi da Central Park e vicina ad un altro piccolo parco lungo l'East river, adatto per correre e rilassarsi, a starbucks, sempre utile e buoni supermercati.
Buona fortuna e viaggio a chi va a scoprire New York, città da molte sfaccettature, ma sicuro da vivere nella sua palpabile libertà.

reviews[4].comments:
It is all about guests having the right expectations and landlords being honest about what they have to offer. This place is not for everyone and you need to see if it is a suitable for you. I personally this this place is good if you:
-Only stay for a short term and just need a cheap place to crash at
-Do not care much for messiness
-Do not care much for privacy
-Can sleep easily under any circumstances

Below is the pros and cons of this place.
Pros:
- Located in UES with many bars and restaurants around
- Q line is only 5-10 min away on foot
- Mattress is comfortable
- Walk-in closet in the bedroom
- Water pressure isn’t too bad
- Rent is inexpensive (is it worth what it has to offer? It’s up to your expectations)

Cons:
- There is no heating system for this unit; the building controls it. It’s only automatically turned on during the winter. On the chilly nights in spring/fall, they use their gas oven in the kitchen to heat the house. (Isn’t this a safety hazard? (Hidden by Airbnb) says it run the risk of carbon monoxide poisoning but they would probably say it’s been working for them well.)
- There is no air conditioning system in the bedroom. Apparently it’s only in the living room and they were reluctant to turn it on when it was 84 degrees outside (that was 29th April (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) , you can check the weather history).
- It is misleading that they have laundry as the amenities. The building does not have washer/dryer. You’ll need to use a laundromat open for the public outside the building. It is $3 to use a small washer and $6 for a bigger one. To use dryer, it’s a 25 cents for 7 min.
- It is a 1-bedroom apartment. The landlord and her mom sleep on the couch outside. She told me her mom is going to stay there only for a week. I cut my stay short before verifying this is true, but based on the review below written in italian, it seems that the mom stayed there for the whole time. Given that the landlord doesn't know how the laundromat outside works because only her mom has been doing the laundry for her, her remarks are credible.
- Bath tub and bathroom sinks were clogged. But this is easily fixable.
- Bathroom is quite messy but I found it tolerable. It’s really up to the individual. The italian lady down there seemed to have been not OK with that.

I find the description of their listing quite misleading but I do NOT have the evidence that they intentionally try to trick people on purpose. You just need to know what the place has to offer and see if the price you’re paying is worth it. Ask the right questions and have the right expectations and you will be fine.

As for the CONS, I discovered a very old, worn, stained bottom sheet covered with pilling that felt like sandpaper, along with an old lumpy pillow that was covered on both sides by a very stained pillowcase.  The lack of a top sheet increased my concern and discomfort for potential health hazards from countless guests who used the comforter in place of a top sheet. The air conditioner cools the living room, not the guest room (especially when closed for privacy), which only has small fan. The bathroom sink continues to drain very slowly as reported in May 2017 (I did not try the shower for the same reason). If the host secures new, comfortable sheets along with a new pillow for the guest bed and gets the drains cleared, I would definitely give this place more stars! It’s a great location if you want to get some exercise. Be prepared to climb 50+ steps from the street level to the 4th floor!

reviews[5].comments:
Christina and I stayed in the apartment for all of April 2014.
It is very quiet, the neighbourhood very respectable with everything you need within 3 minutes walk.
We spent a lot of time at the Met Museum of Art.  The bus that goes there is 3 minutes walk away.  The subway is about the same; very convenient. 
The natural history museum is 10 minutes walk.
There is also the best cinema in town 6 minutes away.  We live in a rural town; a big superduper cinema is great.
The apartment is clean and light; plenty of cable TV; very usable kitchen.
The bed is just fine.
We would stay again.
reviews[6].comments: Perfect stay.  Keren and Ofer were super helpful in accommodating my schedule to pick up the keys (as well as returning the keys after I accidentally took of with one set).  Their place was clean and exactly what I was hoping for.  As an Airbnb host it was great to see some of the things they do that I could do to make my home more comfortable in the future.  \r\n\r\nIn addition, it turns out Keren is a real estate broker and I was looking for an apartment.  Keren ended up helping me look for a place to stay so I got to know her even more.  I would certainly recommend staying at their place.
reviews[7].comments: Thanks to Karen and this relaxing and cozy apartment, I really enjoyed my stay in a great Upper West Side Location. The apartment was well equipped for this cold winter, but I imagine its natural light in Spring must be sublime. I really appreciated Karen's hospitality and the included amenities.
reviews[8].comments: Nice place, good host.
reviews[9].comments: Apartment and service were great.  I stayed here from Aug 15 - Sep 19, while I was waiting for my permanent place I was moving into to be ready, and then when it got delayed, Karen and Ofer were extremely helpful and able to extend my stay from Sep 19 to Oct 6.  I am moving to the UES, so while in transition I decided to give the UWS side a try.  The apartment is on 89th between West End and Riverside, quiet and beautiful street, right down the block from Riverside Park and the Soldiers and Sailors Memorial.  Dog park and jogging path along the water right down the stairs.  86 Street 1 train is just a few blocks away, and plenty of good eating right down the block (Carmine's, Vino e Cibo, Little Mermaid).   Love the neighborhood, and after staying here I wish I had considered an apartment in this neighborhood...  Karen and Ofer were extremely responsive on AirBNB and text.  The studio faces the back courtyard of the building (no direct access) so it is very quiet, though a little shady during the day (not dark, but you can't quite tell if it is cloudy or not).  Despite being a studio, it is spacious, and is furnished with plenty of cooking tools, dishes, etc if you are cooking.  Overall highly recommend, whether you are looking for temporary housing like I needed, or just visiting the City for a vacation, and want to check out the Upper West Side this is a great place / location / hosts.
reviews[10].comments: Karen was a great host!  Check-in was convenient and she worked with my schedule which I appreciated. Everything about the studio was clean and in good repair.\r\nThe studio is located in a wonderful walking neighborhood.  I was travelling at night to and from school and felt very secure coming and going.  There are also many great restaurants in the area that deliver!\r\nI highly recommend Karen as a host and the studio as a great place to stay.
reviews[11].comments:

We felt home.
Tv and wifi works perfectly.
Location couldn't be better. I would say that this is the best neighborhood in Manhattan. 
And the apartment is in the best block.
It is a family neighborhood I would say. Very quiet and super safe, even at night.
Central park was a short walk and riverside park was just one block away.
I didn't met Karen, but we had a person to walk us in and Ofer, her husband came when we had to leave.
He was super nice. 
And they even helped us with our luggage since we had a flight later on the same day. It helped a lot, so we didn't have to carry those heavy luggages through the city. It was great.
I definitely recommend it.

And it is not too far from center of the Universe: Time Square, Columbus circle, Rockefeller center, Broadway and theatre district, Central Park, are some 20min subway ride away (which is pretty smooth for NYC commuting standards). We are just next to Hudson River, therefore the name Hudson Heights, we are on the cliffs here (George Washington Fort sight) and looking down on the river, yet still in Manhattan! Distinctive architecture, mostly Art Deco, a monumental GW Bridge, Met Cloisters museum and gardens (Medievel art). A Fort Tryon park with the great views of the river and bridge, and beautiful and solemn Palisades across (view of New Jersey), a beautiful garden, anytime od the year, is a great spot for photography. This is a share flat but we rarely saw other people. Both beds were large enough for 2 6'4 Aussie guys and the air con was great on hot NYC nights.

The washing machine and dryer were brand new and very handy also.

We didn't use the kitchen except for a few bottles of water etc but its huge and you could cook big meals if you wanted.

The location is amazing if you like bars, restaurants, shopping etc. Youre right on the number 6 subway train which goes north to south in Manhattan and is easy to catch.

Pros: awesome location! Walking distance to many great restaurants and markets. The house and the room are neat and clean. House rule is ok since the only purpose is to keep everything in order. I had a late checkin, arriving around 10:40pm at night but the host was waiting for me. I really appreciate his waiting.

Cons: The room #F is super super hoooooot! Even when I open the window, still feel the room is like 100F inside, as in winter... There is noice from somewhere (maybe heater) and is louder if you open the window. The bed covering is cheap, no soft touch.

In all, the room is matching its price, no surprise. Good for its location.
reviews[61].comments:
Tom has the perfect location for a stay in NYC. I just happen to love the East Village, it’s my favorite neighborhood. 

I stayed in the F room for one week during winter season. The size of the room was perfect for me, traveling alone. It would be also fine for 2 people, more than that in my opinion would be a little too tight. Only if one really needs to save money.

The temperature of the apartment was fine and no noise from the streets in that room. We can hear bedroom neighboors, but there weren’t many people there during my stay.

The only negative side of the place is that it’s not very friendly... No warm welcomes, charming decoration or NYC guides, maps or books to share with the guests. Traveling alone I Would have enjoyed it, but I guess ”this is NY”, deal with it, and Im sure  Tom has his reasons to put up cameras and several rules written all over the apartment. I can see that some guests have no education or respect for others.  

I got an early check in for a $59 fee. And the day before my check out I got an email requesting that I left the apartment before or at 10am the latest.

Overall my experience was fine and I would definately stay there again. thanks!

reviews[98].comments:
I have stayed all over New York over the last 25 years but never in the East Village. This was by far my favorite neighborhood I’ve ever stayed in, and Joe’s location is outstanding. Affordable restaurants, great super markets, and public transit are all around. Patisserie Florentine on 10th was my favorite place to get coffee and pastries in the morning, but there is also a great place on 11th (Veniero’s) for pastry. Westside Market on 3rd Ave is a nice market for fresh fruit and prepared foods. I loved Beyond Sushi on 14th Street for fast, fresh, affordable Vegan meals (and the people there were super friendly). The Strand Bookstore is a short walk away, and the L train is just two blocks away for a quick ride into Williamsburg/Brooklyn. UCB theater is a few blocks south for cheap, fun stand-up comedy, East Village Cinema is just a couple blocks away for indie/foreign films, and of course Union Square is just right down 14th. There’s also a Trader Joe’s on 14th but it is really crowded. Lots of fun stuff to do in the area. 

I am a female and traveled alone, often returning to the apartment very late at night, and I felt completely safe. The apartment is as represented—not flashy or glamorous, just basic, convenient, and affordable. The trickiest part was the shower—it’s got a mind of it’s own but it’s not a deal breaker. The room next to mine had two guests, and Joe had his own room. There is only one bathroom but I never had to wait more than 10 minutes to use it. At one point there were four other people in the apartment when Joe had a friend staying with him. Everyone was very very quiet and respectful of others when taking time in the bathroom. However, if you are someone who does not like sharing a bathroom with so many people (and it is a small bathroom) and you do not like walking up five flights of stairs, you should probably find another place. 

I could not have been happier with this location and will definitely return to the East Village.

Joe’s appartment is located in the very lively East Village neighborhood (which I love, I stay in that same area each time I come to New York). 
After 5 flights of stairs (Joe warns you about it) and very accurate information on how to enter the place (in case Joe’s not home at that moment), you enter his home, that will become yours for the duration of your stay. 
The appartment is not big, but this is New York! Nevertheless, you have enough space for your room and in the common areas (kitchen, living room, bathroom, and of course the rooftop). 
AC is very convenient on the hot days of the New York summer. There are units in the bedrooms and the living room. 
Kitchen is easy to use, and Joe insists on the fact you can use whatever you need in there. 
Bathroom is shared with Joe, and possibly another guest, but I never had to wait to use it. It’s a little old (but then again, old building) but clean. Be careful to the hot water in the shower: it seems to have a mind on its own ;)
Bedroom is not super big, but you have a large and comfortable bed and a closet to hang your clothes (for the bedroom I was renting, that closet is in the living room, that is not at all an issue). 
And finally, up one last flight of stairs, you have access to a private rooftop over the city. Perfect for the morning coffee or a drink after a day visiting. That was the little plus!
Joe is a very kind guy, that makes everything he can to help you have a nice stay, he’s very quiet and let you a lot of space in his own home. 

Overall a nice stay in a nice appartment with a nice host!

reviews[140].comments: Joe’s place was great. Excellent location, there’s all kinds of good food nearby and it is close to NYU’s School of Medicine which was important for my stay. The room is purely functional - there is a bed with some outlets and place to put your things. It won’t be sparking clean or organized as a hotel is, but for how nice Joe was and the location, it is pretty much a bargain. He also has all kinds of snacks, coffee, and toiletries you can use/have if needed. And lastly, his view from his roof is amazing. Super awesome and would recommend if you need a place to stay near East Village.
reviews[141].comments: The host is nice and the location is great. Joe had plenty of suggestions of places to go to eat or for entertainment. The rooftop deck view had beautiful views of the city. The neighborhood was quiet and we had a good night’s sleep. The room is small for 2 people but would be fine for 1 person
reviews[142].comments: bon emplacement pour navguer sur manhattan, trés belle vue du toit pour se poser apres une journée de marche , le rapport qualité prix est excellent mais il ne faut pas s'attendre a un grand confort dans les chambres ni dans les espaces communs. Joe est trés aimable , trés flexible et trés arrangeant. un endroit ideal pour les petits budgets et pour un sejour de courte durée
reviews[143].comments: The place is great, Joe is great, the roof is great. Book it, enjoy NYC.
reviews[144].comments: I enjoyed staying at Joe's and would go again. Joe was very kind to us, communication was prompt and helpful, and the flat is conveniently located. The room is small and cozy, surprisingly quiet given that it is in downtown NY. I would recommend Joe's place to my friends!
reviews[145].comments: Joe was an amazing host! His hospitality was above and beyond what we expected. Check-in and check-out times were flexible and he offered great tips about seeing the city. The rooftop view of the skyline was unforgettable. The location is great and made subway travel very convenient. Overall, a great place to stay!
reviews[146].comments: Joe's place was a great base for a visit to New York. The room is comfy, clean, and great value for the location, and the roof terrace was wonderful. Joe was also very helpful when it came to coordinating my arrival, even when transportation issues meant I ended up arriving much later than planned. Thoroughly recommended - I hope to be back!
reviews[147].comments: Joe is a super nice guy, and went out of his way to accommodate me when I ran to into a snag. But if I’m being honest, I have to share that the place is very grimy. It’s not his fault, but the stairs and stair well look like they have never been mopped or scrubbed since the building has existed, and the rooms themselves are quite grimy and cluttery...bring Lysol wipes.
reviews[148].comments: Awesome location and great host! Joe was very easy to get in contact with and very personable during my stay. Incredibly close to the subway and all sorts of food. The open rooftop also as cute as I pictured it to be and great for taking in the view after a long day of sightseeing.
reviews[149].comments: This room is perfect for setting your belongings down in a safe space and getting out to explore the city. It's in a wonderful location on the lower east side and is close to so many amazing restaurants. Joe was very accommodating and an incredibly kind person. There is not a lot of space in the room so if you're looking for somewhere to sprawl out this may not be the best option, but for me and my purposes it was perfect. I didn't want to spend a whole lot of time in my room anyways, for the large majority of my stay I was out exploring the city. At night it's the perfect place to retire to after a long day of walking Manhattan. I'll definitely try to stay here again if I come back to NY. Thanks Joe!
reviews[150].comments: Joe was great host. 5 flights up was rough but expected. Great area too!
reviews[152].comments: Great place and host. 100% recommended. Thank you!
reviews[153].comments: Joe is a really cool guy with a load of local knowledge, his place is in a fantastic location for the Subway, places to eat and drink, plus the view from the roof terrace is awesome.
reviews[154].comments: Joe's instructions are clear and it is easy to get to his place. As he mentioned,  you definitely have to climb up 5 flights of stairs. I was winded by the third floor with a heavy suitcase, but consider it a nice workout. There is a room set aside where the bed takes up most of the space and you can put your belongings in another room. The bed is comfy and he provides 3 pillows and enough blankets to stay warm. The shower is ok; I couldn't quite figure out the temperature because it kept shifting. He provides a plethora of shampoo and one kind of conditioner. I'm a stickler when it comes to my hair so I'd suggest bringing your conditioner if you are too. He provides coffee and various breakfast foods. It can be a bit loud in the room - the outside noise seeps in. I heard a lot of construction, people singing, talking. I'm a deep sleeper however so I got through it. Thanks Joe!
reviews[155].comments: There’s stairs to negotiate. The toilet flush lever is problematic, and the old style radiator heater hissed me to sleep. Otherwise a gem of an AirBnB and I’ll definitely stay here again if I can. Joe was super friendly and very considerate. The place has mad style with a nice rooftop access. Totally worth it!
reviews[156].comments: A cosy little nook in the city! Great views from the roof terrace. Friendly host. Nice location. Could just do with a bit of tidying and fixing up...
reviews[157].comments: Overall conveniently located & good place to stay if you’ll be out exploring the city all day!
reviews[158].comments: Small room in a really nice and fun neighbourhood, easy to get around. Hence a perfect location if you are planning to explore the city all day long!
reviews[159].comments: il recommend strongly a stay at Joe :).
reviews[160].comments: Pros: Host seems super nice, and very accommodating.  The place is nicely located, and as someone who just needed somewhere to crash while dealing with foreign consulates in NYC, it was exactly what I needed.\nCons: Grimy building, lots of broken decor and a very noisy (though comfortably warm) radiator. I'm a bit spoiled from using AirBnB in smaller/cheaper cities and abroad, so I may have had inflated expectations; it's probably par for the course for the area.
reviews[161].comments: This was my first trip alone and I couldn't have felt any safer. Plus his place is close to everything. Joe was incredibly responsive and available at all times. Definitely recommend!
reviews[163].comments: Joe is super nice and the place is really convenient!
reviews[164].comments: A super pleasant and hospitable host who goes the extra mile - even washed my bed linens in fragrance free detergent when I asked. A comfortable, cozy, casual place in a fantastic location with great restaurants, movie theaters, etc. Great value!
reviews[165].comments: Great spot, Joe was a great host and was very respectful. Room was exactly as advertised.
reviews[166].comments: It’s all about location location location. two blocks from the subway and bus lines. Friendly safe neighborhood to walk around and the best bagels right around the corner. Joe was quick with responses to any questions I had and check in was easy.
reviews[167].comments: Joe was a great host! The place is as advertised.
reviews[168].comments: Great location, excellent host. Recommend this place.
reviews[169].comments: Joe is brilliant, as is his apartment. Great location, easy to get to from Penn etc. - highly recommend staying here.
reviews[170].comments: La descripción es real, la ubicación es muy buena, el barrio es muy seguro y tiene estación de tren subterráneo a dos cuadras de distancia. El dormitorio es pequeño, recomiendo solo para una persona, con dos personas en el dormitorio se vuelve incómoda la estadía. el dormitorio tiene muebles algo viejos y poco funcionales. Joe entrega instrucciones reales y muy precisas de cómo llegar y lo que ofrece y cómo funciona su departamento. En resumen: buena ubicación, Joe no miente en la descripción pero podría mejorar mucho con sólo modernizar el aspecto del pequeño dormitorio que ofrece.
reviews[171].comments: Accomodated all of my last minute requests, couldnt have asked for a better host in NYC. Best for anyone super low maintenance just needing a comfortable place to stay. Felt like staying at a friend's house which may sound plain to some but i cant think of a higher way to praise my guy Joe.
reviews[172].comments: Absolutely would try and stay here again.
reviews[173].comments: Joe was an excellent host. He made everything extremely easy and wanted to make sure I was taken care of. While I didn’t stay in the apartment much during my trip, it was still made to be everything I hoped for. Would recommend this place to anyone.
reviews[174].comments: Great apartment in an amazing location.
reviews[175].comments: Very nice stay in a neat part of the city
reviews[176].comments: Joe's place is fabulous. Easy to get to and accessible. Very cozy set up and I thought was of great value. Thank you Joe!
reviews[177].comments: Joe was an extremely accommodating host. Awesome apartment on the top floor with a roof top patio that is perfect for morning and night views of the city. Apartment and bedroom were very comfortable and made me feel right at home. Amenities beyond what I was expecting. Amazing location, right in the middle of all the best restaurants. Momofuku Noodle Bar and milk bar are just a couple minute walk. Lots of night life. Just a couple blocks from the subway, very easy to get around. Will def be staying here again!
reviews[178].comments: Joe is a nice and easy going host. The place is a very typical stay in NY. It works well for me because of the location and all amenities Joe offered. He even let me leave my bag there to pick up later due to my business schedule. Good experience!

reviews[0].comments: Le séjour chez Agnès était parfait: la chambre, les petites attentions ( serviettes, draps, chocolats, bons plans....)  grâce aux bons plans d'Agnès nous avons même assisté à un concert rare à NYC ! En conclusion un vrai bon plan et un accueil vraiment très chaleureux ..... N'hésitez pas !
reviews[1].comments: For my trip to New York I used airbnb for the first time, and Agnes as a host was a perfect representative. I really enjoyed my stay in her flat. The room was quiet, private and clean, and Agnes was very helpful with everything else, even freshly prepared breakfast was included. Moreover, the flexible check-in and out times were great to enjoy the city without luggage on the day of departure. I highly recommend staying with Agnes, and if I am in New York again I would definitely stay with her again.
reviews[2].comments: Conocimos NYC por primera vez y nuestra estadía con Agnes fue genial! No solo nos hizo sentir como en casa, sino que además disfrutamos de sus increibles desayunos. Nos fue de mucha ayuda cada consejo y guía que nos brindo para conocer mejor la ciudad y aprovechar nuestro viaje. Por sobre todas las cosas Agnes con su humildad y sencillez nos enseñó que hay un mundo nuevo afuera que necesita ser recorrido!\r\n\r\nDejamos NYC habrientos de futuro!!!!!
reviews[3].comments:
This was our first time using AirBnB and Agnes had the best reviews in NYC. Agnes deserves perfect scores across the board for hospitality and helpfulness. She was very knowledgeable about the area and goes above and beyond our initial expectations for any type of host. Dianne and I were in a tough situation looking for apartments, and Agnes was more than understanding. She even offered to hold our luggage for us while we searched for apartments for the weekend. Such a sweet, sweet person. I' d list all the extra things she's done for us, but I recommend you just visit yourself! =)

Pros: Everything! (Rooms are big, clean, cooled. Host is as accommodating as anyone. Location is perfect! Right by the subway and a few stops from Times Square.)

Cons: Nothing at all!
reviews[4].comments: This was my cousin's first time coming to New York, she loved the location of the place... a couple of blocks from the subway entrance. When we arrived Agnes offered to upgrade us to her larger room which was really nice... we weren't in the room very much but it was a very nice room and she deserves the top rating!
reviews[5].comments: Breakfast cooked by Agnes was great. The food was delicious and the fruits were fresh. The bed was very comfortable and the bed sheets were very clean. Agnes is extremely helpful. Whenever I needed help on how to get to places or advise on things to do at New York, she was always willing to explain to me and send me information about different places in New York through email. The subway is really nearby her house, making it really convenient for traveling downtown to the different attractions in Manhattan. Definitely a very good place to stay!:)
reviews[6].comments: Staying at Agnes' place was just great. The appartment is clean, comfortable and very close to the subway station, which is just aroud the corner. We also enjoyed swimming in the -free - swimming pool in the park just accross the street. Agnes herself  is a fabulous host, always very friendly and ready to help. Every morning she served a delicious breakfast that kept us going all day, with bagels, pancakes, eggs, cooked meat, vegetables, cheese and fresh fruits. We would certainly recommend this place to others, and we will absolutely stay there again when we go back to New York.
reviews[7].comments: This was our first time in the US and NYC. Agnes is a great host, she is very kind and helpful. Her apartment is very nice and clean. The subway is just a 2 minutes walk from the apartment, it was very good.\r\nThe breakfast was very delicious.\r\n
reviews[8].comments:
Agnes is a wonderful host, my sister and me spent a great time in her apartment!! 
We had our own private room and as soon as we arrive she provided us with clean towels. The room and the home are clean.
The location is perfect, it`s one block away from the subway, that will take you to anywhere in a few minutes.
Agnes is a kind person, and she provided you any information you need about the city. 
I definitely recommend Agnes to who plan to visit New York.
reviews[9].comments: We had a great time at Agnes place, the apt was beautiful and at good location. Agnes was very nice and helpfull all the time we spent in New York.Thank you for making our NY trip better :)
reviews[10].comments: grazie agnes,sei stata molto (Website hidden by Airbnb) tua casa e'tranquilla e in una posizione davvero (Website hidden by Airbnb) camera per 4 era un po' piccola ma quando tornero' magari me ne dai una un po'piu'grande.sei stata gentile,ci hai anche prenotato la navetta per il ritorno!a presto cara.Elisa
reviews[11].comments: Agnes was awesome for giving me a place to stay on such short notice! Definitely an excellent host to have on my very first airbnb. It was quite convenient that her place is so close to the subway! Thanks again!
reviews[12].comments: Agnes was extremely nice and helpful. She was very friendly and was easy to communicate with and flexible with our schedule. When the hurricane hit she was extremely helpful in making sure that we were ok. Thank you!
reviews[13].comments:
Great accomadation in an affordable price in Manhattan.
The place is super clean,quite, spacious and comfortable.
Full cable TV, Fast WIFI service and comfy bed\sheets.
The room is well seperated and you get a complete privacy. The location is perfect as around the corner you have an access to 4 subway lines 2 of them which are express and will take you to midtown in about 7 mins.
The neighberhood is safe -plus - starbucks and the supermarket half block away. 
Defiantly best value in Manhattan - beats any hotel and less than half the price.
Thank you Agnes :)
reviews[14].comments: nice host, convenient transportation,clean room&bathroom!
reviews[15].comments:
Agnes is a great gal! Her place is clean & comfortable. I came & went as I pleased. She helped me navigate the city- she knows this place like the back of her hand. This was my 1st time using airbnb. I was nervous, but she made me feel at home. 

She's genuinely friendly & super accomidating. I had brought my dog with me, who's a total gentleman (normally). He was having anxiety because of the travel. The first time I went out he started crying after I left. Agnes comforted him & didn't give me a hard time about it or anything. Don't get me wrong, Marty's a charmer, but that was definitely above & beyond.

So, yeah, no bs- She's friendly, honest & screens her guests well (no creepers here hahaha). :)
reviews[16].comments: My first time in this part of Manhattan and it was a truly rewarding experience.  Wonderful neighborhood, easy access to the subway which was less than a block away and an absolutely quiet couple of nights in the room.  The quiet was definitely a new experience for me in Manhattan.  Room was clean, the bed comfortable and a gallon of water with toothbrush was a nice touch to complete a great experience.  The internet was very slow but the overall experience more than made up for that small inconvenience.  I highly recommend.
reviews[17].comments: I really enjoyed staying here with Agnes.  She was very nice and hospitable.  the room was clean and quiet.  The bathroom was clean and efficient.  she provided the necessary amenities.  Agnes was always available to answer questions though texts, calls, or in person.  Thanks for that.  The neighborhood had everything you needed -  coffee, food, the pizza shop at the end of the block was terrific!!!  The apartment was a short walk to the metro station and the trains ran express to Manhattan.  I loved that.  \r\nI will definitely be contacting Agnes when I return to NYC.
reviews[18].comments: I had  nice stay with Agnes. The room was clean, bed comfortable, wifi worked and the subway was less than a minute walk around the corner.
reviews[19].comments: The reservation was canceled 24 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[20].comments: Agnes was a very nice host! She provided us with all the necessary information and some nice add ons we didn't expected. Everything was clean. The room is at the end of the floor so you also have your privacy. \r\nWe had some problems with the internet but maybe it was just our laptops and in fact we didn't need it that much since we were in New York!\r\nI really can recommend this room in Agnes' apartment!
reviews[21].comments: We're happy we met Agnes - she was a wonderful and friendly host. The room and the whole house were very clean and quiet. The Subway station is even closer than it appears on the map. The WiFi worked okay.\r\nWe hope that next time we visit New York we'll be able to book again with Agnes.\r\nThank you VERY MUCH !
reviews[22].comments: Agnes é uma excelente anfitriã. O apartamento é muito bem localizado e silencioso. Esta perto de supermercado, farmácia e o melhor uma quadra do metro! \r\nAlém disso ela sempre surpresas gostosas no quarto como chocolate e bolachas! Adorei!
reviews[23].comments: Agnes was most helpful in suggesting sites to visit in NYC. The location was near an express A Train Subway to mid town and down town. The rooms were quite small, big enough for the bed and our luggage, but not much more. There was no space to just sit and relax, so we did not spend much time in our room there.
reviews[24].comments: The room is large with a spacious wardrobe, the bathroom has a perfect shower and there's also a kitchen available for the guests. This part of Harlem is quite and very nice, especially Convent  Avenue and the surrounding area, with pub, bars and the Metro, two minute walk from the apartment. Agnes is very nice and helpful, and she cleans the room every two or three days. Perfect staying. Thanks Agnes, arrivederci!
reviews[25].comments: Agnes is an exceptional host: welcoming, friendly, communicative and attentive. Everything in the apartment is exactly as described and wonderfully maintained. The location is fantastic. You are literally around the corner from the subway and the express train means you can be downtown in less than 20 minutes -- and home after a night out in less than 20 minutes too! I very much enjoyed my stay and would welcome the opportunity to stay again in the future. Thanks Agnes!
reviews[26].comments: I love Agnes' hospitality! Everything was set on the table, the area was great (Harlem), and no curfews! Such a wonderful host. Definitely recommend Agnes as your host if you're looking to stay somewhere in New York. Me and my friend enjoyed our stay here, and will be back in the future!
reviews[27].comments: Very nice room, quiet and clean. You are the feeling to be in an hotel (better and cheaper)
reviews[28].comments:
I had a really nice stay with Agnes. Her appartment is superconvenient and close to te centre of manhattan. 
The neighbourhood was really safe.
I couldn't have wished for anything more. A super clean and nice room, inclusing bathroom.
I would stay definitly again with her. Thank you for making are trip so easy!
reviews[29].comments: Je huurt bij Agnes echt een kamer in een groot appartement.
