Agnes verschoont handdoeken en kamer op tijd en overlaad je met chocola, mondwater en frisdrank.
reviews[30].comments:
Generally We had a good stay at Agnes place.
Pros : nice area, well connected, 15 minutes to go to time square, the room was kind of quiet. Many internation TV channels. Bathroom clean and convinient. Nice attention, she leaves water and candies in the room.
Cons : this place is more like an hostal, Agnes open the door gives you the keys and thats all. It is ok for the price but dont expect tips or  advices on the city. The bed quality was quite bad, the matress seems very warn out and old, the room was not very clean (stains on the floor and dust on the lamps) overall the place need more maintenance. We had no internet connection in the room but for the price it's fine.
reviews[31].comments: Agnès est un hôte très agréable et serviable. L'appartement est vaste et très bien situé à proximité de la station de la 145th rue qui est desservie par tous les métros express et locaux. Le prix de la chambre est très correct en rapport des prestations proposées.\r\nA recommander donc :) !
reviews[32].comments: We had a very good time there and enjoyed the nice atmosphere. it´s a good location and near the subway which takes you easy to the center.
reviews[33].comments: Agnes was a great host, who was very accommodating with her house. The kitchen was replenished on a regular basis for breakfast foods, she upgraded our room for free, and the location was quiet, cozy, and convenient to get anywhere in Manhattan on the subway.\r\nThanks Agnes!
reviews[34].comments: I had a fantastic week staying at Agnes' apartment, she was very friendly and accomodating, she was always on call to answer any questions about the area.\r\nThe room was spacious, clean and quiet.\r\nI would definitely recommend and would love to stay again when I return to the US.
reviews[35].comments:
We had a wonderful stay with Agnes! We initially booked the smaller room, and was offered to switch to the bigger room. There was a mix-up when we reached and we had to stay in the smaller room on our first night, but Agnes was really nice about everything and even helped us to shift our belongings to the other room on the second day!

After the online booking was done, Agnes sent us extremely detailed information, including directions. The apartment s literally round the corner from the subway! Super convenient!

Both rooms were really nice, and we were greeted with biscuits, chocolates, bottled water etc. The smaller room is really cosy, albeit a little cramp; the bigger room is extremely spacious and comfortable, however the wifi signal was weaker in the bigger room.

The kitchen was literally brimming with stuff! There's yoghurt, bread, cereals, coffee, tea etc that you can help yourself to!

It was a really enjoyable stay and we would definitely recommend her apartment to our friends.
reviews[36].comments:
The house is in good location, close to subway station A, B, C and D. Room has enough space and amenities for two persons.
Agnes was very helpful in finding information about New York. 
She do efforts to satisfy the guests and successful. She was changing sheets, also providing soft-drink, biscuits and nuts.
reviews[37].comments: I booked with Agnes to send my in-laws who were visiting from Germany for a few days. Agnes was excellent in communication and very open; she offered outstanding assistant in planning the trip in advance and there. Her place is conveniently located and easily accessible for arriving by car. Overall, my in-laws had a good experience at her place, all essentials were present as described. The bed was a little worn out and the room overall small, but it did it's duty. Thank you!
reviews[38].comments: Nous avons passe 3 jours a Montréal dans le studio de Patrick au cœur du quartier du plateau. Le studio de Patrick est très fonctionnel et idéal pour visiter Montréal pour une courte durée. Je recommande vivement ce studio et remercie encore Patrick qui a été très arrangeant pour le Check in et Check out.
reviews[39].comments: We had a pleasant stay at Agnes's place. The place was good for the price and met most of our expectations.Agnes is wonderful though - she was very detailed in her instructions and the  information about the places of interest I requested from her. She was very generous in providing us with breakfast items and snacks - more than we required or expected :-). She made sure the room was cleaned and bed sheet/towels changed. She is a very pleasant hostess and I would recommend her if you are looking for a reasonably priced place to stay. the location was in Harlem - not the best -  but we did not face any problems. The proximity to the subway was a great plus. It was great to get to know Agnes and the opportunity to stay at her place.
reviews[40].comments: Agnes was very helpful and an interesting person to share living space with. She helped me locate places I wanted to visit and gave accurate info on how best to use New York's public transport in order to get there. Agnes took her role as a host with a sense of responsibility and tried hard to make my stay accomplish what I was wanting to achieve during my visit. The photos of the lounge and balcony area weren't quite what I saw when I got there, but Agnes was true to her word as far as the amount of organic yogurt, milk and cereal available. The aircon kept the room very cool during the hot New York summer. Perhaps a bit too cool seeing it was situated right above the bed head of where I slept. Although some people would think that great, if I stayed again with Agnes, I would ask that the bed be moved away to a different wall as it kept me awake through the night.
reviews[41].comments: Agnes was relly nice and helpful. We had a perfect stay in NY
reviews[42].comments: Agnes è molto gentile e disponibile, lascia sempre fuori dalla porta un gallone d'acqua.Dentro la stanza, spazzolini e dentifricio, saponetta, gel igienizzante, dolci a volontà, collutorio. In cucina vari tipi di cereali, latte e uova, frutta fresca e vari prodotti per la colazione oltre che caffè espresso con moka gigante. Unico difetto riguardante l'uso della cucina è l'orario, limitato dalle 9am in poi; Perciò noi la usavamo verso le 6am per non uscire tardi di casa. Ottime indicazioni per arrivare a casa dal JFK date da Agnes . Ottima posizione della casa: metro a un minuto a piedi (10 minuti per Rockfeller Center con metro express) oppure autobus per Central Park in 30 min. Bagno pulito, così come la cucina. Cambio delle lenzuola e degli asciugamani ogni tre giorni circa. Ci sono altri due coinquilini fissi, per cui bisogna stare attenti agli orari in cui si usa il bagno, anche se Agnes ti informa dei loro orari, quindi è facile regolarsi. La stanza è molto grande per due persone; Noi eravamo in tre perciò con il mega materasso gonfiabile aggiuntivo, le dimensioni della stanza si sono ridotte (le valigie stavano chiuse nell'armadio). Aria condizionata praticamente sempre azionata (siamo stati ad agosto) e la finestra non apribile: aperta sono in bagno e in cucina.
reviews[43].comments: We stayed at Agnes' place for 3 nights and we were very satisfied with her place. It was clean, calm and Agnes is very friendly. She provided us additional information about transport and places in neighborhood. The subway station is very close, and gives a great connection to whole city.
reviews[44].comments:
Agnes è molto pulita, cambia lenzuola e asciugamani tutti i giorni (anche più del necessario), il bagno è lindo nonostante venga utilizzato da lei, il suo inquilino fisso e dagli inquilini delle due stanze che affitta su airbnb. Puoi utilizzare il frigo e i fornelli, ha il CAFFE' LAVAZZA E LA MOKA grande. Inoltre ti riempe la camera di schifezzine che personalmente non ho apprezzato ma lei credeva di farci un favore, quindi è solo una questione di gusti! :D
Difetti? Nelle regole della casa c'era scritto che si poteva fumare alla finestra e invece per fumare devi scendere le scale e attraversare le scale per andare alla panchina (maledetti USA).
Forse per colpa nostra ma avevamo comunicato l'orario dell'arrivo (due/tre di notte) e per diversi minuti NON CI HA APERTO NESSUNO!!! Stravolte da 28 ore di viaggio volevamo solo farci una doccia!! Poi si è svegliato l'inquilino che ci ha aperto e ci ha fatto accomodare in salotto, dato che Agnes dormiva e lui non aveva le chiavi di camera nostra. Dopo una mezzora, si è svegliata e tra mille scuse ci ha accompagnato in camera nostra!! 
Complessivamente l'arrivo è stato disastroso ma l'accoglienza è molto buona (tranne che per i fumatori!) e complessivamente la permanenza in casa di Agnes è stata un'esperienza molto positiva.
reviews[45].comments: Si notre séjour à N.Y fut réussi, notre hébergement chez Agnès y a beaucoup contribué : Accueil parfait,  plein de petites attentions de la part d'Agnès (gâteaux, bonbons, boissons dans la chambre ainsi que les affaires de toilettes), toujours prête à donner des infos, des conseils (merci pour cette soirée au Blue Note à très bon prix !!) mais en sachant être discrète. Appartement très calme et très propre. Très bien situé avec une station de métro juste à côté avec une ligne Express qui nous emmenait dans le centre en moins d'une demi-heure ! Pleins de magasins, banques, restos dans le quartier. Merci pour votre rire, chère Agnès. Nous reviendrons, c'est sûr. Et nous conseillerons votre appartement à nos amis et connaissances. \r\nJacqueline et Bruno
reviews[46].comments: Great room, even if it's near the front door. You may hear people go in and out the appartment.\r\nAgnes was very kind with us and made our stay as confortable as possible.\r\n
reviews[47].comments: Agnes is a very friendly host. Very helpful and informative. As a traveller visiting New York for the first time it can be very daunting and confusing, but Agnes was a great help with her guidance  and knowledge of the city. Her apartment was perfectly positioned above an express subway station, so it was only 10 to 15 min into town. Had a great time in New York and will miss it dearly.
reviews[48].comments: Great value, great location, great host.  I spent two nights there and would surely return. Agnes is kind, generous, and very interesting.
reviews[49].comments: Notre 1ère expérience a eu lieu chez Agnes et c'est vraiment sans regret! L'accueil a été très sympathique, nous nous sommes sentis très à l'aise et très vite. Nous recommandons fortement ce logement pour plusieurs raisons: son hôte, son emplacement, sa propreté, son calme.....\r\n\r\nNous espérons y retourner
reviews[50].comments: Appartement situé à deux minutes du métro qui dessert plusieurs lignes, quartier situé à 15 minutes du Midtown et à trois stations de Central Park, petit déj inclus, et Agnès, une hôte passionnée de jazz attentive et disponible. Parfait pour visiter NYC en quelques jours !
reviews[51].comments:
Agnes was very nice and forthcoming and replied to my messages almost immediately.

The appartment is less than 5 minutes walk from the 145th street subway station which is served by local and express trains so you can get downtown conveniently and speedily.

The room was clean and comfortable, the bathroom was also clean, and the shower was hot and had enough water coming out (so better than in most US hotel rooms I have stayed in).

Towels and toothbrush were provided as well as cookies, chocolates and some non-alcoholic drinks.

I left early in the morning and did not take breakfast. So I can't say anything about that.

The only thing that was not so great was the noise from the airconditioning. I turned off the one in my room (it is directly next to the bed), but I still heard a not very loud but constant humming from nearby fans. Most US hotels are much worse in that respect. Still, I would advise to bring ear plugs if you have a light sleep or are likely to suffer from jetlag.
reviews[52].comments:
Die Bewertungen, die ich zuvor über Agnes gelesen hatte, trafen genau zu. Sie ist sehr hilfsbereit (Tipps für NYC, für U-Bahn, Weg zum Flughafen, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten etc.)
Wohnung per U-Bahn sehr gut zu erreichen (um die Ecke). Sichere, ruhige Gegend.
Verwirrend: Wohnungsnummer 7 F ist im 6. Stock! (wenn man in den 7. Stock geht=Dachgeschoss, geht sofort die Alarmanlage an!!!)
Wohnung sehr sauber, viel Essensvorräte (Küche sehr klein)
I agree all feedbacks, which I have read before.
I would choose this room again!
reviews[53].comments:
Nice place, clean and comfortable. Good options for breakfast and free access to the items for shower.
Agnes is very kind and gave lots of information about good thing to do in the city.
Nice neighborhood, cheap options to eat.
I highly recommend staying in her apartment. I had a great first experience booking with Airbnb!
reviews[54].comments: We stayed 2 nights with Agnes and it was perfect ! Agnes is a fantastic host, everything was here to be sure that our trip was good : towels, guides, juices, water, candy... \r\nIf you have to go to NYC, go with Agnes !!! She's very considerate and you feel welcome with her !
reviews[55].comments:
My partner, my son and myself stayed with Agnes for a whole week and would thoroughly recommend Agnes as a gracious host. The space met our expectations and the transport was exceptional with the A express around the corner. The bathroom was clean and our beds were made every two days with fresh linen and towels. We even were able to have our laundry done and breakfast was available every day. Staying for an extended time allowed us to get to know Agnes and her love of Jazz music. I am sure we will meet again either socially or on another visit to New York where we would stay with her again in a heartbeat. 
The area was no problem even when returning back late at night. I found Agnes to be very friendly and prompt in answering all correspondence. 
The money we saved by not staying in hotels allowed us to treat our son to many more New York experiences. 
We love Agnes
reviews[56].comments: Only one word: Perfect!!
reviews[57].comments:
Agnes has been a friendy host for us. Good location, very close to entrance of metro 145th street and an excellent fall out for exporing the wonderful city of New York. Breakfast was included as well as a nice amount of snacks. 

Location: 4/5
Friendlyness: 4/5
Hospitality: 4/5
Cleanliness: 3/5
reviews[58].comments:
Agnes was a wonderful hostess.  Our room was clean and light, with a big closet and all necessary furniture.  Agnes provided delicious snacks and breakfast ingredients.  We much appreciate that she had organic products (e.g. tea, oatmeal).  The apartment building is renovated and clean, with elevator.
Thank you.

Birgitte
reviews[59].comments: I had the best time staying with Agnes in November. Agnes is a generous host with a wealth of "local" knowledge which she was happy to share with me. My room was perfectly clean & comfortable & was supplied with a huge array of snacks & drinks. Her assortment of breakfast food was more than adequate & I`ve been converted to some of her organic choices now that I`m home. I felt safe to walk in the area day & night & enjoyed many walks around the neighbourhood. The locals were polite & friendly. The underground station is an easy 10 minute stroll which makes mid town Manhattan only 20 minutes away. This was my 4th stay in N.Y. & normally I stay in top class international hotels but this time wanted something "different". I will be back in N.Y .next year & definitely looking forward to staying with Agnes again. I will be 70 next year! Sandra
reviews[60].comments: Agnes was a very helpful host guiding us and supplying information on the area.  She is very knowledgeable and we ended up visiting the Abyssinian Gospel choir which was a highlight of our visit.  We walked about 20 blocks to a party and home again through a lovely neighborhood.  I would love to go back and stay with Agnes again and get to know more about the area.  There was lots of food supplied for breakfast and we were made to feel at home. Agnes knows the history of this part of Harlem and opens it up to visitors so you gain far more than just staying at a hotel.
reviews[61].comments: Agnes is a sweetheart. She provided wonderful snacks in the room and was so kind to both my pups. She actually walked them for me and was always attentive. Always gave advice on getting anywhere and the NY subway is just around the corner from her building. I hope we can visit again.
reviews[62].comments: We stayed at Agnes' for 3 nights. Place very well linked, with buses and subways. She was very nice and polite, the bathroom was clean, the room was cozy but not very clean. Little bit of dust and sleeping by the heater is not very comfortable, mostly because it caused lots of vibrations and noises. Perfect for few days.
reviews[63].comments: Agnes is super sweet and the apartment was very easy to find! She provided us with an abundant amount of information on what to do in the city, since this was our first time, provided housekeeping, was very flexible with checking in and out, and even left us complimentary drinks and snacks. When we return to NYC we will definitely stay with Agnes again. Great host!
reviews[64].comments: Agnes was a superb hostess! She really took care of us and was agreeable when we didn't show up quite on time (thank you, Agnes!).  We were pampered and it was great to be able to prepare meals as needed. In addition to the wonderful dining suggestions she made for the area. I recommend her as a hostess and her place as a b and b option. Great location close to the Metro, building elevator, security, and quiet inner courtyard facing room. Great space for 2 or 4 (with air mattress).
reviews[65].comments: Agnes was a kind and generous host.  The apartment was clean, well stocked and convenient to public transportation.  I would recommend her to future guests.
reviews[66].comments:
La chambre (et l’ensemble de l’appartement) correspond bien aux photos, elle est spacieuse, meublée simplement avec tout le nécessaire, un grand placard avec des cintres et des tiroirs pour ranger vos affaires. Le lit est bien moelleux et le chauffage fonctionne très bien (mais nous vous recommandons de l’éteindre la nuit).
En ce moment le salon n'est plus disponible et il n’y a pas de table dans la cuisine. L’appartement perd de sa convivialité mais renseignez-vous c'est une situation temporaire.  Un bémol, la propreté est approximative, maniaques s’abstenir.

L’appartement est bien situé, à l’ouest de Harlem dans un quartier calme, populaire et sans danger. A proximité, il y a tous les commerces nécessaires (supermarché, starbuck, Dunkin’Donuts, pharmacie, cafétéria Jacob soul food) 
Le métro express (A et D) est à quelques pas de l’appartement, c’est vraiment appréciable, il faut compter 40mn pour rejoindre Manhattan Sud. L’idéal est de prendre une carte de métro 7 jours illimitées à 31$. A une station de métro, il y a de très bons restaurants (ne ratez pas Red Rooster) et des magasins à prix intéressants sur la 125ème rue.

L’ultime point fort c’est la gentillesse et la disponibilité d’Agnès qui vous donnera un maximum de renseignements, de bonnes adresses et qui s’assurera toujours que vous ne manquerez de rien.
reviews[67].comments: Agnes was phenomenal. She is a wealth of information. I felt right at home. It was like staying with an old friend.
reviews[68].comments: Agnes was a great host. She was Very friendly and helpful. I would recommend Agnes to future Airbnb guests. The room was exactly what I needed during my short stay in New York. only 2min from the subway, restaurants, and convenience stores. Clean room. Safe neighborhood.
reviews[69].comments: We stayed with Agnes for three nights while we were having some work done on our apartment. Agnes is a fantastic host! She will make sure you have everything you need to be comfortable, including toiletries and towels, coffee, tea and breakfast items. The apartment is clean and big enough to give you a sense of personal space. We really felt at home, and you can't beat how close to the subway it is! You've got everything you need in the neighborhood, including a 24 hour grocery store just down the street. You will feel safe coming and going, even at night, just use common sense. I would recommend Agnes to any friends or family coming in from out of town!
reviews[70].comments: Agnes was a gracious host. The space was very clean and welcoming. I highly recommend her space.
reviews[71].comments: We had a great time in NYC at Agnes place. She is a very nice, helpful and kind person. The place was clean and comfortable. It close to a Supermarket and the public transit. We recommend this place:)\r\n
reviews[72].comments:
Staying at Agnes' place was a real pleasure. Not only because of the apartment itself but also and mostly because of Agnes. 
She is a very warm host. The room was prepared nicely and we felt very welcome there. Agnes prepared Snacks, chocolate, juice and small bottles of water (very useful for a day in the city) for us. Breakfast was also included. Agnes offered different cereals, bread, coffee, tea and everything you need.We really felt at home at Agnes' place.
Agnes gave a lot of information how to reach her place and was very open for all questions.
Furthermore, which is also very important for getting around in the city, the apartment is located only 5 minutes away from the next metro station.
I highly recommend this place!!
reviews[73].comments: Agnes is an AMAZING host!!! The location is great, very convenient, very close to both bus and subway station. There are many stores around, and the neighborhood is nice, clean and safe. The room is cozy and clean, the bed is comfortable, and Agnes prepared water, juice, and so many snacks for us which we didn't expect. Thank you Agnes! Agnes offered almost all her kitchen for us to have breakfast. Also, the bathroom is clean and we were able to use the shampoos, body washes and even body lotion! Agnes is very friendly, nice and considerate. In addition, the price is very reasonable! I highly recommend Agnes and her apartment, and I will definitely choose her place again if I went to NYC in the future! \r\nThank you for making our visit more joyful and hope to see you again!\r\nThank you for sending me music too!
reviews[74].comments: Delightful host, clean, comfortable space, very close to public transit and a very interesting neighborhood.  Highly recommend it!
reviews[75].comments: the apartment is a bit messy and there was a funky smell in the entrance and stairways. it was still being cleaned when we arrived due to the last tenants checking out late so we had to wait for like an hour in another room. location is right in harlem, a bit farther than i expected outside of manhattan though quite close to the metro lines which can take you into the city. there aren't very many common spaces available so you mostly have to stay in your room. \r\n\r\non the plus side, agnes provides some nice touches like water and snacks and breakfast (though we only found out about it after we left) as well as some good music files.
reviews[76].comments: Agnes was a WONDERFUL host! She was very detailed with her instructions on how to get to her place, and she was available for any questions we had while we were staying with her. The room was clean, organized, and cozy :)\r\n\r\nShe even had several amenities that were quite useful to have in the room, which made our stay even more special. We highly recommend anyone stay with her if they ever have the opportunity to do so!
reviews[77].comments: Me and my boyfriend were traveling to NYC for business and a few days of having fun in city.  We stayed two nights with Agnes and it was a perfect choice.  The building is easy to find, right near the subway, has free street parking, is very clean and has an elevator. Agnes was there to meet us and is a very warm and welcoming host.  The room is clean and spacious.  The bed was comfortable.  The towels were nice and big and fluffy and the bathroom is very clean and all of the fixtures are modern.  Agnes kept us well stocked with refreshments in our room!  There was bottled water, sodas, juice, snacks, and chocolate!  The kitchen is stocked with cereal and beverages and fruits for breakfast. It is very clean and the selection of organic and even vegan options was extremely thoughtful!  Agnes also sent us a list of places to go and see music and eateries that she recommends.  The neighborhood is perfectly nice, with a walking park that goes up one side of the street where the building is located.  You'll need to travel a bit on the subway to get to your mid- and downtown destinations, but it is a super easy subway ride away.  We found the location to be very convenient and our stay enjoyable.  We hope to return soon!
reviews[78].comments: Agnes is a very nice host, kind and helpfull. I got sick during the stay and she was conserned and helpfull. The room is great, the bed if very confortable and big enought for 2 friends to sleep in. Agnes gives you access to her full equiped kitchen and all sorts of food. It's very close from the 145th street subway (take the express train and you're in Manhattan quite quickly. Also a big supermarket and deli, chinese, restaurant around the building. The tv has more than 200 chanels and HBO on demand, I really apreciated that. Thanks Agnes for the great hospitality :-)
reviews[79].comments: We had a really great stay with Agnes! The apartment is located very close to a subway stop, with several different lines, which take you downtown fast. Can totally recommend staying with her during a NYC trip.
reviews[80].comments: Super appartement ! Très bonne localisation (juste a côté d'un métro) Agnès a été très accueillante et nous a beaucoup aidé c'est une femme très disponible. Tout s'est très bien passé :)
reviews[81].comments: Agnes was an absolutely amazing host. She was flexible with check-in/check-out times and was cordial/friendly upon arrival. Agnes gave us far more than I ever have experienced from an airbnb experience. She provided all toiletries, snacks, wifi, cellphone chargers, kitchen & food items ton make breakfast at our disposal, etc. I was thoroughly blown away by her hospitality. She even sent my friend and I some great jazz music as well as tunes we wanted ourselves. The best part was that with fees, we only paid $82 for that single night stay (in MANHATTAN). I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Thank you Agnes!!
reviews[82].comments: We had a lovely experience in New York with Agnes.  She is a friendly host, welcoming us with a smile and a desk full of juices, water bottles and snacks.  The room is exactly as expected, the apartment was very clean, and we shared the apartment also with a family from Germany.  Agness was quite gracious in allowing us to cook in her kitchen to accommodate my special dietary needs and helped us find our way around the city's public transit system.  The buses and the subway are only a block away, and the neighborhood is quiet.  We had a great time.\r\nThank you, Agnes, for hosting us so well.
reviews[83].comments: L'accueil a été agréable. Agnès est disponible pour donner des infos : lieux à visiter, musique, shopping, restaurants...\r\nL'appartement est très bien situé par rapport au métro (5 min à pieds) pour aller directement dans le centre de Manhattan (10-15 min) et pour accéder à Harlem.\r\nLe quartier est calme, résidentiel et bénéficie de quelques commerces d'alimentation.
reviews[84].comments:
El piso esta en un zona accesible,  tranquila y bien comunicada. Puedes notar la vida en el barrio desde el primero momento. El piso es de fácil acceso desde el metro y a poca distancia. Agnes nos trato como más que huéspedes abriendo su casa y ofreciéndonos su abundante hospitalidad.  
La habitación y la casa disponen de todas comodidades descritas en la web, además de estar bien cuidada y  nosotros lo encontramos todo excelente. 
Volveremos a la gran manzana y nos quedáramos con Agnes Seguro !!
Great Stay!!!
reviews[85].comments: Agnes puts me to shame as a hostess.  Her place was so clean that I knew that if there was any dirt, I had carried it in.  I slept very well in her home.  And everything was great: directions, amenities, neighborhood.  I really enjoyed my stay with Agnes and appreciated her love of New York.
reviews[86].comments:
Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Agnès dès notre arrivée.
Des petites choses a grignoter et à boire sont mis à disposition dans la chambre. 
Appartement calme.
Nous ne parlions pas beaucoup anglais ce qui a un peu compliqué les choses pour nous. 
Agnès héberge un ami à elle qui n'est pas forcément très agréable mais ce détail est vite oublié de par sa disponibilité et sa gentillesse.
Appartement à 15 minutes en métro de Times square
Si nous avions a revenir a NYC nous n hésiterions pas a revenir au même endroit.
reviews[87].comments: Agnes apartment was very nice and spacious. Overall as a host she was extremely accommodating. She gave us everything we needed included towels and refreshments. The apartment is in a great location in uptown manhattan and the nearest train station is about a 2 min walk. The apartment was very clean and was easy to go in and out of. Would definitely recommend her.
reviews[88].comments: We had a lovely stay, a brill end location. The room house was very clean. And we had a lovely supply in the room of water and snacks. Would highly recommend It to any one.
reviews[89].comments: Agnes was a wonderful host for our one week trip to New York! She sent extensive emails and tips to get around in New York. The flat is situated in a nice area, very close to multiple subway routes, so it is very easy to reach other destinations in Manhattan.\r\n\r\nAgnes was of great help and she made us feel very welcome, definitely would go back! Her hospitality made this experience even better!
reviews[90].comments: We were visiting New York for one weekend, and very much enjoyed the city as well as the stay with Agnes. She was very kind, the room was clean, and: Everything (!) was provided. Linen, towels, toothbrushes, and even water, beverages, chips and chocolate. That was terrific! We were allowed to use Agnes' Kitchen and help ourself to coffee and cereals, which was perfect for a one-night-trip. The apartment was very close to the subway, and the area felt very safe, also at night. Consider that it will take about 20-30 minutes to get to Manhattan - if that doesn't bother you, we can recommend Agnes and her room.
reviews[91].comments: Agnes was a very attentive host and the room was spacious and quiet. Agnes had provided lots of extra amenities such as various snacks and bottled water as well. The air conditioner worked well and the shared bathroom was clean. Agnes was also very kind and attentive about providing information about lots of things to see in New York City. Agnes also did not yell at us when we mistakenly went to the 7th floor (the roof) in trying to find her apartment and an enormously loud alarm sounded--at 2 am. I personally felt somewhat bad about having to wake Agnes up since we got in to NYC quite late, but she was gracious about it. As promised, the area was convenient to the subway and the express train made travel down to the main tourist areas quite quick.
reviews[92].comments: This was my first time experience airbnb. Agnes was a great host for these three reasons. First, she gave us a special discount rate for 3 people. Secondly, it was midnight when we checked in, but Agnes gave us a warm welcome. She detailly showed us around the house. Lastly, the guest can have a full access to her kitchen, which is fully stock of food. We saved a couple bucks for a long trip by eating breakfast at her house. Also, there is a park with a pool outside the apartment, which played music every weekend in the summer. Very safe, exciting, and convenient area. You would love it.
reviews[93].comments: Friendly and nice, she will overwhelm you with so many stuffs that will help your stay more comfort and also touring in NY.
reviews[94].comments:
Agnes was great! Provided everything we needed, and offered answers to our questions about sights to see in New York. Left us to ourselves, but was around if we needed something. And gave some nice goodies like water and snacks, along with lots of breakfast options! 
The area was nice, and the place was very conveniently right next to the subway.
reviews[95].comments: My friend and I arrived around 1 PM, and we were greeted by Agnes who was simply lovely! She had already given us directions how to get to her apartment via private message as well as directions to popular attractions in town, and I was really reassured by her knowledge of the city. Her neighbourhood was really quiet and peaceful for NYC and we definitely felt safe when we returned late at night. Our bed was comfortable and we were provided all the amenities that was listed, and not to mention the apartment was clean and immaculate. In the morning it was lovely to have access to her kitchen to make a hot breakfast. Thank you so much Agnes for the wonderful experience!
reviews[96].comments: We had a great night in NYC. The host was very accommodating and allowed us to keep our stuff in our room the next day while we ran around the city instead of having to check out first thing. Our room was very clean along with the bathroom as well. The food available in the kitchen is a nice touch to the overall amenities provided by the host.
reviews[97].comments: I spent 4 days in Agnes' home and it was a great experience, she was lovely, lots of advice to give about NYC, her place is perfect and really close to the metro station ;-) I recommend her at 100% :)
reviews[98].comments: We enjoyed our stay at Agnes' place very much. The location is very convenient & Agnes is very helpful & kind. She provides every information you ask for as well as a very large selection of breakfast utilities, snacks & drinks. Thank you very much, Agnes!
reviews[99].comments: Our stay with Agnes was great. Her apartment  is located in a very convenient location. Sehr sichere, ziemlich ruhige und verkehrstechnisch prima Gegend, mit der Express Subway ist man zu jeder Zeit schnell zuhause. Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis perfekt.
Es gibt (mindestens) zwei zu vermietende Zimmer in der Wohnung, eines größer, das andere etwas kleiner. Wir hatten das erste, etwas größere Zimmer am Eingang, zum ruhigen Hinterhof. Das Foto stimmt nicht mehr bzgl des Bettes. Das jetzt dort stehende Bett hat keinen Nachttisch, es gibt auch keine Nachttischlampen, nur eine Deckenlampe. Fernseher war angeblich gerade kaputt gegangen. Fehlte uns aber nicht. Zimmer nüchtern, aber praktisch. Der lichte Charakter des Fotos etwas irreführend. Eher Zimmer zum unbelebten Hinterhof, es guckt aber keiner rein, Jalousie.
Heizung springt bei etwas kühleren Temperaturen automatisch an und lässt sich nicht regulieren, pfeift. Zum Abkühlen gibt es mobilen Ventilator und Klimaanlage im Fenster. Mmm. Nicht sehr umweltfreundlich, aber wohl standard.
Wohnung gepflegt und Badezimmer mit Dusch-Badewanne sehr sauber. Gute und reichlich Handtücher. Auf Wunsch haben wir auch zweites Laken und Decke fürs Doppelbett bekommen.
In kleiner Küche alles vorhanden, um sich selbst Frühstück zuzubereiten. Sehr praktisch. Im Wohnzimmer zwei abgesessene Couchs und kleine Klapptische, herrliche Aussicht über Harlem vom Podest der Feuerleiter aus, auf dem wir morgens unseren Kaffee getrunken haben.
Beim Ankommen statt eines "Hello" erstmal Hinweis, dass in der Wohnung keine Schuhe getragen werden dürfen. Also Hausschuhe oder dicke Strümpfe mitbringen. Schuhe draußen im Hausflur ausziehen. Begrüßung dadurch etwas kurios:-)
Für uns etwas undurchsichtig, wer uns eigentlich begrüßt hat. Agnes haben wir wohl nicht getroffen. Die uns Empfangende hat auch nicht klar gestellt, wer sie eigentlich ist... 
Insgesamt trotz ein paar marginaler Häkchen bzw. Fragezeichen prima Quartier, sauber, praktisch, preiswert und verkehrstechnisch super angebunden. Durchaus zu empfehlen:-)

This was my first experience with staying at an AirBnB and I was a little nervous as to what to expect. First I will address the actual apartment. 

Very very clean! I can not stress this enough. Yes, you must take off your shoes before entering. House rules. I stayed in the first bedroom for 10 nights. I was provided 6 towels (3 per person) and our sheets were washed twice during our stay. On the table in the bedroom was a supply of beverages, snacks, and toothpaste/mouthwash/toothbrushes. Some of these drinks were very nice and definitely above what you will get anywhere else. Agnes also provided a gallon of water at the start, and actually kept replacing it as we used the water. 

Every day I noticed the bathroom being cleaned. By the way, Agnes provides a host of shampoos/body washes/bar soap. 

The kitchen has a supply of breakfast foods, some very very nice, for guests. This was such a treat to have some fruit and the option of bagels and eggs and organic foods there. 

I have seen some reviews mention that Agnes was not very friendly. I don't know how they could have gotten that impression at all, unless perhaps they were not used to the New York briskness that some people there have. She was an incredible host, very accommodating with check in Times. She constantly provided us with ideas and suggestions of places to see and restaurants to visit and even gave us some of the history/trivia of the areas around the city. I was genuinely welcomed and happy to stay in her home. 

For a neat freak like me, I was thrilled with how clean the apartment was. I was so happy to have a taste of the real 'New Yorker' experience. 

I would completely recommend this place to anyone wanting a safe place to stay. I was nervous about staying in Harlem but truly to neighborhood was incredible. I felt safe and completely comfortable, even as a small town gal from Alaska. 

Ten out of ten, would stay here again!! I highly recommend this place to everyone!!

This was my very first Airbnb experience, so I have nothing to judge this against. However, the two big points are:  

1) that I stayed one night at the end of January and the room was sweltering hot and barely cooled down in the 12 hours I was there. The heating unit was a radiator, which I've never had experience with. The Airbnb app delayed my messages to the host or something because she didn't see them until much later, after which she did adjust the heating. 

And 2) The room is in an apartment building in Washington Heights. Having never been to New York, it was a personal lack of knowledge/experience that meant I didn't know distances between things or where all the action is or which are touristy places. But three Uber drivers and several personal friends made me feel really uncomfortable about having to stay there. 

However, neither of these things are really in the host's control. Its more of Airbnb's side on the location and app shortcomings. (And some people might appreciate an 85° room when it's 40 outside)

On the plus side, 1) everything seemed clean, freshly laundered, etc., 2) this host allows you to leave your luggage with her before check-in, which was great and 90% of the reason I chose her, 3) it sounded like she cleaned the bathroom between guests taking showers, 4) there were snacks and drinks available in the personal bedroom, and I believe? the kitchen was there for guests to use freely, 5) the bed is at a height easily accessible to children and the elderly, and 6) the host seemed friendly and ready to accommodate and answer questions.

reviews[26].comments:
This was my first experience in staying in a room in a shared apartment, and also my last. Dominique is a really nice person, communicative and kind, but I'm sorry to say that her place, though functional, is not recommendable for anyone who doesn't fit the young , college student and extremely easygoing or on a budget type. First of all, the apartment has an awful smell of cigarrete all around, even in the sheets and blanket. Worse than that, there's an occasional terrible smell of pot, I don't know from where or whom, so not making any accusations, but it's bad indeed.  The neighbors are extremely noisy, they listen to loud music the whole day and night, and when there's no music there's a girl singing NONSTOP after midnight the same song over and over again (out of tune as hell). It is impossible to sleep due to the noisy old heater, who sounds like a painful flute glissando (and I'm a heavy sleeper). So this is the night routine: when there's no music and people smoking marijuana, there's a loud girl 'singing' and when there's no girl or music at all, the heater makes the night an awaken's hell.
I don't get it. How can this list be entitled " Beautiful room " ? Was it "functional room" or even "convenient location" it'd be more honest. But it is far from beautiful. The building is old, filthy, there's graffitti all around INSIDE THE BUILDING, in the walls and even in the doors of the units. So the feeling is you're entering a really unsafe zone where criminals get easily inside the building to damage the walls and doors and God knows what else. However nothing unusual happened during my four days stay, I didn't see anyone suspicious, in fact the neighborhood is almost entirely composed of young harmless people, and the worst you can see is a bunch of drunk folks screaming and wandering around the streets.
I rented this place because I thought I could save some money after travelling for 3 months with my companion staying only in good hotels or private apartments. Now that I'm alone for a brief period of time I thought some saving would come in handy, but I guess one gets what one pays for, so I'll never stay in a room again and already moved to an apartment.

Anyway, I'm glad to have met Dominique. If you don't mind the lack of hotel-like standards, this is definitely a great option for you.

host.host_about:
I have been home-sharing for about 10 years now and have met many interesting people. I view visitors more as short-term roommates than I do as guests.

Home-sharing truly has been a blessing for me. It's helped me to pay the rent and still given me the flexibility to have the place all to my own when I'd like to do so. That's a huge benefit!

As a guest, I have used Airbnb to travel to Tokyo and spent a few weekends staying at a farmhouse outside New York City. We watched films on the side of a barnhouse. Very cool!

I am a relatively easy-going guy. I drink socially and do not smoke or use drugs. I definitely like to have fun, especially if it involves doing something new and it doesn't cost a ton of money. I love deals!

While I tend to be easy-going, I do have my pet-peeves. For example, a shoes-free home means just that. With that said, I ask that you please review the house "rules" before you book with me.

Either as a host or a guest, I'd be up for hanging out some time. I like to meet new people and explore the city together. If you'd like to hang out during your visit, then let me know in advance. My work schedule is pretty unpredictable and I often do work from home. I can get pretty busy, but if you give me some advance notice I'll make sure we have time to spend together. Otherwise, I generally assume that guests want independence.

If you prefer to do your own thing, then that's totally fine too. Don't worry I won't be offended. I can certainly appreciate that you may have a pretty full itinerary when you come to NYC.

I'm a former journalist, PR guy and worked for a non-profit in the sustainable agriculture / environmental field for many years. I started my own coaching/consulting business a few years ago and would be interested to find out more about what's going on in your life. Perhaps I can help you out in some way?

My guests have included a combination of tourists and business travelers. Whichever category you fall under, you're welcome to stay with me. I have an extra room and I'd be happy to provide you with an opportunity to step into the shoes of a New York City resident for a while. Who knows? Maybe you'll like the East Village so much that you'll want to find your own apartment and never want to leave.

I host singles and couples, but you should note that there is an added fee of $30 per night for all additional guests over one person.

The most common things I hear from guests are:

"The room is so much bigger than I thought based on the photos in your listing,"

"This is a really cool room/place!"

"I love the natural light that comes into this room!"

"It's such a comfy atmosphere in here that I really hate to leave!"

Guests really love the location! location! location!

On the flip side, I sometimes hear people remark that walking up five flights is "telling them that they need to get into better shape."

If nothing else, I hope that you'll find your visit with me to be enlightening (that's a joke because the bedroom is well-lit and I am a life coach ;)

Look forward to meeting you!

Hello! I'm Yara, a born and raised New Yorker from Brooklyn.  After studying and working in the entertainment industry in Los Angeles, I moved back to further my dance studies (I'm an Argentine Tango performer). I'm pretty free spirited and try to enjoy all the perks of living in Inwood! I love to hike difficult trails and like buying clothes to hike in -- although I might like buying the clothes more than hiking sometimes!   : )

I'm a huge fan of Inwood Park. It's not like Central Park at all (not that CP is bad but Inwood Park wasn't man-made). There are fewer people and it's a great place to be alone and think.  You can go to the weekly farmers market which is across the street every Saturday morning and then go on a morning hike, play tennis, basketball or soccer before finally laying out to work on your tan. Later you can watch the sunset over the Hudson River or perhaps go on a sunset hike. It really is nice up here! Come see what I see!! 

I also co-run THRIFTAHOLICS com & NYC GRINDHOUSE com with my boyfriend Michael. If you like thrifting, or want to do things in NYC cheaply, or even for FREE when you get here, you should definitely check out our site. We can get you very cheap tickets to Broadway shows! 

Have a Great Visit to the Big Apple. I hope to hear from you!!!

Si vede che siamo stati i primi ospiti, poichè non c'era tanto spazio per le nostre cose personali (considerate che eravamo solo con il bagaglio a mano), tuttavia la disponibilità sua e di Mike hanno ovviato all'inconveniente. Noi amiamo molto gli animali, tuttavia la presenza della gatta (dolcissima) può essere un problema per gli ospiti (perde molto pelo). Complessivamente comunque è stato un soggiorno molto piacevole.
reviews[1].comments: This place is in a neighborhood where I used to live, and I really enjoyed being back. There weren't many surprises for me. The apartment was clean and filled with sun. The cat is delightful and so is the turtle! Even though we didn't actually meet, Natalia was a gracious and generous hostess via email. The A train is right outside. The gypsy cabs are honking 24/7, but that is New York. I recommend this place!
reviews[2].comments: Inwood is my new favorite place! Natalia's apartment couldn't have been in a better location - close to everything you could possibly need. Her studio is very spacious, with the most comfortable bed ever. Natalia is extremely helpful and caring. She took the time to explain every small detail about the apartment and even bought an iron because I said I needed one! Her pets are adorable and fun to be with. Thank you Natalia, I hope I can stay here another time.
reviews[3].comments: had a great time at Natalia's. She and her boyfriend were very helpful and the check in/out process was smooth. The apt was immaculate and the location of  was perfect in terms of transportation.  All in all, great stay, and a great host!
reviews[4].comments:
The apartment was clean upon arrival and super cozy. Natalia left us a guide to her neighborhood which saved us from having to research where  the basics were. By staying here, I was also introduced to a neighborhood that I had never visited while I lived in NYC. It's awesome.

Emilia is a super friendly cat and Pedro the turtle pretty much keeps to himself.

I'd book Natalia's apartment again!
reviews[5].comments:
Natalia is a great host, she is very friendly and super helpful. She was great with communication and always replied promptly even when I didn't ha ha. She even took the time to gather directions from the airport to her apartment. She also listed nearby locations for shopping and even a laundromat. How's that for going above and beyond?  I also need to point out she did all of this without a single minute of face time. That's right my girlfriend and I were well taken care of and we actually didn't see Natalia once. Which was a shame because she was really nice.

Her place very clean, quiet and in a superb location! Nearly anything you need is withing walking distance. Including transport by train or bus. She has the nicest cat, Emilia which will keep you company if you travel alone. Her turtle Pedro is really fun to watch while dinning at her table. My girlfriend and I cooked nearly every other night of our stay and Natalia's kitchen has all the basics covered. Her internet access is fast, we watched a few shows on Netflix with no problem, and speaking of shows Natalia has great taste in movies her little library has something for everyone.  

I recommend Natalia for being an excellent host, and her wonderful home for all of it's amenities and awesome decor.
reviews[6].comments: My daughter & I stayed at Natalia's apartment this weekend. It was my daughter's first trip to NYC and i was glad we found a place to stay where we could get a quiet night's sleep, away from the horns honking, on the comfiest bed ever. Natalia was super easy to communicate with -- I already felt I trusted her, even before we arrived. The apartment was spacious, secure, warm & cozy...a home away from home. Will stay at Natalia's again & again!
reviews[7].comments: Natalia was a good host. She was personable and friendly.  Her apt is located a block away from a subway station in the upper upper west side. Very safe area just a few minutes walk from the cloisters. He pets are super cute. Especially the cat. She's a riot! :) One thing was the automatic heater. It was a little loud in the dead of the night but we much rather be warm on such cold nights :)- Great stay!!!!
reviews[8].comments: Natalia was responsive and nice.  From the beginning she contacted me and let me know she was there for any questions.  Her boyfriend Mike met us at the apartment and showed us the ropes, and Natalia provided a list of nearby restaurants, etc.  The apartment was clean and great - exactly as advertised on Airbnb.  The turtle and cat are very sweet, too.  The place is convenient to (a few steps away from) the subway, and around good, affordable restaurants & bars.  Inwood is nice, but far out - so waiting on the A train was the only down side.  I would absolutely stay again.  Thank you, Natalia and Mike!
reviews[9].comments: I was in New York for an event, and was looking for a place to stay that felt like home where I could cook my own meals, as well as sleep as late as I wanted without being disturbed.  Natalia of course was nice enough to let me stay at her place, and arranged a really close place to the Port Authority to pick up the keys to the place, which really helped me out.  I was quite happy with where her place was located, especially since it was in a spanish neighborhood and I love authentic spanish food.  Her cat was a good friend to me and enjoyed all the attention I gave her, as well as the company to.  Natalia also left me a list of local restaurants and where they were located, as well as where local grocery stores were which was a big help being from out of town.   I would highly recommend her place to anyone else looking for a place to stay in New York.  I will happily stay here again next time im in New York if her place is available to stay at.  The place looks exactly like the pictures she has taken and posted, but even roomier and tons of light and fresh air come in at all times of the day, and you also get a nice view of the local neighborhood you are staying in.
reviews[10].comments: My sister and I enjoyed our weekend in New York and staying in Natalia's apartment made things so much easier for us with my daughter living only 1 1/2 blocks away.  We spent very little time in the apartment and worried about her pets, but it was quiet and such easy access.  I'm sure we will do it again.
reviews[11].comments:
I agree with the positive opinions of the previous guests--Natalia is a pleasure to deal with and her apartment is priced just right. She communicates effectively and has a welcoming personality. 
We felt secure in the neighborhood and the neighbors were quiet during the two weeknights we were there--only thing were occasional doors closing down the hallway a few times, and as mentioned by another guest, the cab drivers use their horns a lot, evidently to greet each other.  (This is typical throughout NYC, and would make for a potential doctoral dissertation for an ambitious sociology graduate student. Best spin I can put on it.). No, the car horn is everywhere to be heard all over this town. 
Anyway they did tone it down later in the evening. 

Natalia's cat Emilia is a very considerate roommate--she does not romp around the room, pester for food, beg to be let out (she's an indoor cat), or have any disagreeable aspects to her personality, which is friendly.  For a cat owner, you will appreciate this, and if you are new to cats, don't worry. 
This cat is a class act. 
As far as trying to rate the neighborhood goes, with a 5 being a Park Ave. address, or a nice tree-lined street in the Village, etc., near a station, it isn't that, but it doesn't cost 300 per night either. I don't want to be around that type of alien situation, anyway, so I'm not rating by numbers on that. It is not only by one station that has express service, but another subway line is nearby and across the street is a coffee shop that offers varietal coffees--they list it as "pour over" on the menu as opposed to the house coffee and espresso drinks, made by the cup in one of those glass coffee pots. You will taste the "notes" of various berries and fruits, as you do with varietal wines over on the East Side, with these different coffees. I could go on further with this. 

All in all, we left feeling happy and well taken care of. We were so busy, we didn't get around to picking her brains about going thrifting and getting deals on things around town, but maybe next time...
Thank you, Natalia!
reviews[12].comments: Natalia was great at communicating with me ... The neighborhood was fantastic, everything was nearby... The studio was CLEAN .. the bathroom was spotless.. I would stay again and Highly recommend Natalia studio apt.... I almost wanted to take the apt...hahahah..\r\n\r\nThanks Natalia!!!! =]]
reviews[13].comments: Pros:  The apartment is as pictured, a large studio on the fifth floor in an elevator building.  Natalia was very accommodating and told us to help ourselves to anything in the kitchen.  The cat, Emilia, was a delight - friendly and quirky.   The bed is comfortable.  Natalia has Direct TV, HBO, and an extensive collection of movies.   Cons:  It would be nice to have a sofa to sit on; one has to sit on the bed to watch TV or read.  This is a pre-war building; the radiator heat cannot be adjusted, and it was very hot in the evening.  We had to open the window and use the fan to keep it from being too hot.  This seems like a waste of energy, but this seems to be the way it is in any of the pre-war buildings in NYC.
reviews[14].comments: Natalia's place was great!  A nice size studio just steps from the subway.  She was there to greet us and give us some tips for the neighborhood as well as the city. She made us feel very comfortable staying there.  I would recommend it to anyone.
reviews[15].comments: I don't need to say much except that I would definitely stay at Natalia's place again. It's clean, spacious, quiet and 30 seconds away from Isham/Inwood parks. Her and Mike are lovely people and will make your stay comfortable. They even emailed me all the instructions on how to get from JFK to Inwood prior to my arrival. Thanks Natalia & Mike.
reviews[16].comments: We have spent one week at Natalia house's and it was great to leave in this apartment. We have really enjoy the time past in her neighborhood : near of subway , great mexican food (nachos hmmmmm!!!) , a lot of practice market,... \r\nNatalia is a good host , before the travel , during and after the departure. Actually, it was our first time with airbnb and she make us feel confident. By the way these pets are so cool , in particulary pedro the turtle....
reviews[17].comments: We had a wonderful time staying in Inwood this weekend. Natalia was more than helpful, incredibly responsive, and had many great recommendations. The neighborhood is fantastic, the apartment just right for the two of us. We also very much took a liking to Pedro the turtle :). The farmer's market was a serious highlight - being French, it was a real pleasure seeing three different bakers!
reviews[18].comments: We were really safe and comfy here and loved the kittie and turtle as our return hosts after long two days of fun in NYC. The flat was clean, easy to work in on internet, and all communications were smooth and friendly.  Finally we got to go on two great walks in the forest and I can tell you that is awesome. The cafe across the street is yummy and the decor of objects in the flat , so fun to look at . (My Mom wants the fan ! )The A train immediately outside was a gift, and the parking at 15 $ per 24 hr ,  a bargain if you have to garage a car! Recommended ! \r\n
reviews[19].comments:
Dear All!

I stayed at Natalia's place for 4 days in May. I truly can say that I had an amazing time in New York. Natalia also contributed a great part to my stay. She is very communicative and responsive. Whenever you have a question, she is very quick to respond and very concerned about your well-being. I would definitely recommend  her place if you set a high value on a clean, big and tidy room in a cool area. Admittedly it takes a while to get to downtown NYC, but it is worth the ride. In case you are concerned about feeding the cat, please don't worry about it. You feed the cat in the AM and in the PM. The cat food is of course provided by Natalia. The turtle doesn't need to be fed, since it has all been taken care of by Natalia before your arrival. All in all, Natalia (and her boyfriend Mike) are great hosts and I am very happy to know them for my next trip to NYC. You all take care!

Best,

Paul
reviews[20].comments:
It was an absolute pleasure staying at Natalia's place. This being my first time renting at airbnb, I was a bit apprehensive to start with. Natalia ensured that all my doubts were cleared, was very responsive and went out of the way to ensure that I had a comfortable stay in her apartment.

The apartment was of perfect size and was clean and tidy, absolutely no complaints at all. Even the location is pretty good in the sense that there is a grocery store just around the corner, a  thai restaurant in front, a Baskin robins outlet next block and cab service nearby. Moreover, Manhattan was just one train ride away.

Lastly, the cat, Emelia is very quite and docile. I was worried that my family might be a bit perturbed due to its presence, but it turned out in fact to be contrary and my son liked playing with it.

Overall, I had a very comfortable stay and will not hesitate to rent out again from Natalia.
reviews[21].comments:
My stay at Natalia's apartment was great. It's a relatively spacious, convenient apartment right at the end of the A train line. The commute to midtown/downtown takes some time, but it's reasonable. It's decorated with all sorts of cute and quirky curiosities, many turtle-themed. Natalia herself is very friendly, helpful and easy to communicate with.

I thought caring for the cat might be a hassle; actually, having a friendly feline companion was a positive experience (even though she ran out onto the fire escape one time - Natalia returned very quickly and brought Emelia back in.)

Overall, this is a great apartment to stay in and I'd happily come back.
reviews[22].comments:
I loved Natalia's apartment and the Inwood neighborhood. The building is sparkling clean and super quiet. The apt. is directly across the street from one subway line and a few blocks from another. The neighborhood is lively. There are beautiful parks and a wonderful Dominican street scene. I loved coming home at night to the sounds of salsa, fruit vendors, fresh juice and delicious food. I even got my hand henna.designed in a small storefront operated by a woman from India. The hood is super safe. 

Natalia is a great host. A couple of things you may want to know is that the apt is not a one bedroom but has one big room plus kitchen and bathroom. There is no place to unpack. The cat is great company but you will be expected to empty litter box as well as feed and cuddle. 

I was traveling solo and light and had no complaints. Would definitely return and recommend to others, especially for the price.
reviews[23].comments: Natalia è stata un'ospite eccellente, precisa e puntuale, attenta per tutto il periodo della nostra permanenza a verificare che le cose andassero per il meglio. La gatta, Emilia, e' molto educata e tranquilla. L'appartamento è comodo e pulito, proprio sopra una stazione della metropolitana, con supermarket e ristoranti nei pressi, in una zona tranquilla da cui si raggiunge midtown in circa mezz'ora. Se tornassimo a NY sarebbe sicuramente la nostra prima scelta.
reviews[24].comments: Natalia's place is great.  Very clean and everything you need is right there.  Subway is one block away (A train) and it's two blocks from my new grandson!  The parks around are beautiful.  Great coffee shop across the street and terrrific restaurants.  We will stay there every time we come to NYC is it's available.
reviews[25].comments: Staying at Natalia's place was really awesome! Natalia was very friendly and caring and gave us lots of tips of what we could do in NY and made sure that we would find our way from the JFK airport to her place.  I loved her apartment! Her cat and turtle were so cute and it was fun to have them there during our stay! I think it was nice to stay a bit outside the most central parts of NY and get to know the northern parts of Manhattan! :)
reviews[26].comments: My stay at Natalia's apartment was awesome! \r\nMichael was there to great me when I arrived and gave me a tour of the apartment, which is very clean, spacious and cozy, few steps from the subway! \r\nThanks Natalia and Michael for this great stay.
reviews[27].comments:
My wife and I had a great stay in Inwood! We used it as a quiet retreat for our Manhattan @ boroughs explorations, and were very happy with the apartment. It was clean and quiet, and the neighbourhood felt welcoming and safe. The apartment is large, and the bed is very comfortable. Everything was in working order, and the cat was very happy to be cuddled with in the evenings. We emptied her cat litter before leaving in the mornings, and were otherwise not much bothered by her presence.

We ate our breakfasts at the absolutely great cafe just across the street called Darling Coffee, and then took the A-train into town. It's a half hour ride on the express, so you have time to read your guidebook or observe the local New Yorkers on the train. We would absolutely recommend this apartment if you don't have to live on Time Square, the subway service is frequent and can be found almost anywhere you go. The upside is that you get away from the hustle and bustle of the big city when you want to sleep and relax. 

Unfortunately we never got to explore the forest, but that's for next time I guess :)
reviews[28].comments: This location is convenient and was the perfect landing pad for my visit to NYC to attend a baby shower in the same neighborhood. I wholeheartedly recommend Natalia's to anyone who is looking for a comfy, cozy and relaxed place to land in Inwood. Natalia is a lovely host and gave me all the information I needed to get around and check in without stress. She also provided towels and linens (of course). The building is also really nice with some lovely art deco features.
reviews[29].comments: Great experience!  Super friendly host and convenient amenities.  I highly recommend this one!
reviews[30].comments:
Natalia's apartment is very well located, with the A train right on the corner and the 1 train not far away.  There is a great coffee shop across the street, along with a decent Thai place and an upscale bar/cafe.  It's also close to Inwood Hill Park which is a beautiful and safe park to enjoy. 

Natalia met me on arrival and explained the apartment and the pet care responsibilities to me and communicated very well during my stay.  The pets are certainly easy to care for, but the sea turtle's extreme eagerness to either play or get out of his huge aquarium made me a bit uncomfortable.   

I would say this is a fairly typical New York studio apartment for a young person.  It's clean but a bit cluttered.  The building is clean and safe looking and has an elevator.  There is also an elevator to/from the subway on the corner so you won't have to lug your bags upstairs on arrival.  

If you're comfortable with pet care and the NYC subways, this is a good place to hang out for a few days.
reviews[31].comments: What an easy trip. Worked with us on check in/out times. Close to subway ( 75 ft) a real Great neighborhood. Had $20 dollar lobster and steak within walking distance. Yara made it so easy as this was our first time using airb&b. Absolutely no problems. Uptown was great location to see the tourists spots while also getting a feel for living in a real Nyc neighborhood. We were out front of the building smoking at all hours of the day/night and felt safe at all times. Told Yara if I knew anyone going to Nyc I would send them her way and I mean it. Thanks again for everything. Tell Pedro and the cat hello.  Josh and Jamie
reviews[32].comments: This was my first visit to USA. Natalia greatly contributed towards first positive experience. She made sure that I will have all the necessary information before arrival and accessibility needed for a great holiday. It was nice to meet Natalia at the arrival. She showed a lot of positive energy and flexibility. The apartment is sunny and comfortable placed in a quiet neighbourhood. It was nice to come back to a lively apartment and to Emilia after a long day of site seeing (instead of a grey hotel room). I think this is a right way to see NY.
reviews[33].comments: Very conveniently located; especially if visiting in Inwood vicinity. There is little choice for lodging in area.
reviews[34].comments: My friends and I stayed at Yara's apartment and had a great time. It was very last minute, as my friends missed their flight back to Arizona and needed a place to stay. I didn't have room for them so they suggested this thing called Airbnb. We were lucky enough to find Yara's place, which isn't too far from me, and were able to rent it last minute. We had a fun time for our girls’ slumber party. Her pets Pedro and Emelia and really cute and friendly. Her apartment was clean and comfortable, and we liked all the quirky decor, especially the horror stuff as we all love scary movies! The big Cleopatra Jones poster in the bathroom is AMAZING!! Yara herself is really cool too. Friendly and ultra-knowledgeable about the area, I even learned a few new places to go. Glad I found this chick, as now I have a new friend in Inwood!!  : )
reviews[35].comments: I enjoyed my stay here. The apartment was clean and quiet, and the subway access was perfect. Host was very responsive. Recommended...
reviews[36].comments: Terrific stay! Excellent experienced host: Yara was very easy to work with, her communication with us was perfect (including checking in on how we were doing). Excellent accommodations: studio with full kitchen, in well-kept safe-feeling building. Excellent location: we were visiting family who live in the neighborhood, but even if you are focused on farther downtown, the location is great - the A train stop is 1/2 block away, 1 train not much farther, coffee shops, restaurants and ATMs right on the block, even a farmer's market on Saturday mornings 1.5 blocks away. The cat and turtle were a nice addition. We couldn't have asked for a better stay. Thanks, Yara!
reviews[37].comments: Yara was a good host who was able to accommodate us on very short notice. The place: While you get a good deal on a spacious apartment (New York standards), you will also have to be comfortable living with a cat and turtle. I personally would have preferred a minimalistic interior, but others may enjoy the retro collection and artsy side of this place. A real New York experience.
reviews[38].comments: I thoroughly loved Yara's place! It's neat, clean and inhabited by a lovely Cat. Her place is very close to a subway station and has some great bars and restaurants nearby. Both Yara and her partner are more than welcoming and so helpful with all manner of questions you have about NYC. Top hosts! You'll love the place.
reviews[39].comments: My brother and I stayed at Yara's apartment for four nights and we don't really have any complaints. The only thing was she has Incense sticks and my brother doesn't like the smell of them and even though they weren't on, my brother could still  smell it ( he's sensitive lol) but all we did was moved it to the other room and moved it back before we left. And it was fine. Other then that everything was good. We felt very safe. We got a little lost at 3am and never felt like we were in danger or anything like that. Her pets are super low maintenance. I didn't really mind caring for them since I have cats of my own. If anything it made me feel at home. Yara's cat is pretty funny actually. Train was less then a minute walk away. Yara was very accommodating to our check in hours since we had an early flight. So we were able to check in as soon as we got to NY.
reviews[40].comments: There aren't enough words to say how safe and confortable I was at this home. Yara and her partner Mike are some of the nicest people I could have ever met.The pets were fun and I felt right at home with them.Yaras home was so clean and the decore was fun and lively just like her. Not only will I stay again but I feel I have made a new friend. Inwood is an amazing place a real gem in the city. I cann't tell you enough how pleased I'm with my stay Yaras home.
reviews[41].comments: Both the host and her boyfriend made us feel incredibly welcome and at home! Super nice and attentive to any questions we might have had. And hangin with a turtle and the friendliest cat I've ever had the pleasure of meeting was the cherry on top!
reviews[42].comments: I had a wonderful experience staying in Yara's Airbnb. Her and Mike are very welcoming and  genuinely nice people. The Airbnb was cozy and artsy with lots of taste and style and has a bunch of great classic movies to choose from, along with Netflix,  A Roku, and cable. As well as an iPad incase you need to get on the Internet.  The studio is located on the 5th floor with a view from the bed that is soothing and beautiful to watch in the morning with a cup of tea when the sun rises. Yara and mike even offerd me there personal bikes to get around the city. They have a very friendly cat who loves to get in bed and snuggle with you. the neighborhood is very safe and conveniently located next to Cafes, restaurants and a subway station on the same block. at the last minute, I asked Yara if I could stay for 2 extra days and she told me that it was fine which I thought was very nice considering the last minute change. I ended up having to leave early so I didn't stay the extra days but the next time I'm in NYC Yaras studio is the place I want to stay! (also very very affordable) I think she should also  pursue a career in interior designing! haha but thanks Yara and Mike!
reviews[43].comments: By far the best airbnb experience I've had to date! Natalia was a very friendly and gracious host. I came into New York really late and by the time I got to her house, it was passed midnight. But Natalia was very welcoming! We had great communication with each other from the minute I booked her place.\nThe place was so clean, homey and comfy. It is literally steps from 207th street on the A train. You can't get better than that! Plus it's in the middle of great restaurants of all kinds and shopping. Staying at Natalia's studio was like heaven!!!\nBest of all, she has a lovely cat, Emelia and a pet turtle, Pedro
reviews[44].comments: Great apartment in a beautiful and vibrant part of NYC, close to amenities and public transportation. Natalia and Mike were responsive and helpful during our stay and made good suggestions for my parents' stay. Thanks! Will be staying here again!
reviews[45].comments: Yara was absolutely nice and did anything to help.\r\nThe apartment is great
reviews[46].comments: Yara was a great host, she was very responsive, kind, and provided my friends and I places to go while we were there for our stay. The place is next to public transit which makes it very convenient to go anywhere easily. Would definitely come back on my next visit to NY.
reviews[47].comments: Such a cool place! Yara was a very gracious host with a cute cat and turtle. I wish I could have stayed longer!

reviews[63].comments: Our stay in New York was a lot of fun. Gina's place in Chelsea was a cute, stylish little studio. The photos gave us a clear expectation of the space. The hot water was immediate with the shower, and there were multiple shower toiletries available if needed. There was also a washer available with detergent and stain remover (which I did need at one point and was grateful for). The property is on the first floor, so the property has very easy access when bringing in luggage. There are several restaurants within a five minute walk (including a delicious bagel place around the corner where we had breakfast every day). The neighbors were also very quiet, we never heard anyone besides ourselves. And overall the property was very clean when were arrived. We never actually met or talked with Gina since she has efficiently set up check in to not require meeting anyone.\n\nThere were a few things that were not ideal. Sleeping was not very comfortable. You could feel the bars of the metal platform bed through the mattress, and the mattress was sinking in between the bars. The window also provides very little protection from the elements. We visited in February, and the city was very cold at night. There is a sheet of plastic and a towel taped against the window to try and block off the elements, but there was still a consistent breeze from outside that was most noticeable at night if you were unlucky enough to be the person sleeping on the window side of the bed. host.host_about: Hi, I'm Carlyn! I moved to New York City in 2011 for graduate school (I got my masters in international affairs) and am now working in public policy in the amazing city of New York.  I've been lucky enough to have traveled and lived all around the world, and am always ready for my next adventure to a new place.  I love cooking, baking, eating food in general, hiking and outdoor adventuring and enjoying the unlimited and varied activities that New York has to offer. \r\n\r\nFrom my travels, I know that where you stay makes a big impact on your overall trip experience, and even how you view the city. Because of this, I aim to provide guests with a comfortable and relaxing stay with easy access to all the city's offerings, in hopes that you will enjoy your time in New York City as much as I do.  I am happy to help you navigate the city, figure out what to do and how to get there, and provide any other assistance I can offer.  I love hosting people (I hope to eventually open my own B&B), and meeting people from all around the world.  My roommates are amazing people that share the same outlook.  We look forward to hosting you!
