Me asesoraron y aconsejaron sobre lugares para visitar. La vista de la habitación y del balcón es increíble. La descripción y las fotos son iguales a la publicación. El sector de uso compartido es muy cómodo. Un plus extra, importante para mi es qué también hablan español. Cuando vuelva a NY vuelvo a rentar la habitación de Ana y Kathie.
reviews[75].comments: Ana and Kathi are the best Airbnb hosts I've ever had. Both were so accommodating in sharing their space with me for a month. The apartment was super warm during the winter, had a very functional kitchen and laundry in the building (which we all know is a luxury in New York!) It's a 7 minute walk to the East Broadway F line, which allowed easy access to midtown, where I was attending design school. Thank you so much, Ana and Kathi!
reviews[76].comments: Great place, great views, very clean, description very precise, great hosts, very relaxed: just a great experience!!
reviews[77].comments:
I was apprehensive about booking a private room for the first time as opposed to an entire apartment, but Ana was an amazing host and the apartment was very clean. She was kind, welcoming, and even allowed us an early check-in because we had an early arrival into Newark. I appreciated her recommendations to visit certain spots. She was always happy to answer any questions regarding transportation and different neighborhoods.

The apartment was very clean and the bed was comfy. The view of the two bridges was spectacular and great to wake up to before heading out.

The location is as advertised LES with quick access to the F.
reviews[78].comments: The apartment is big by Manhattan standard. Clean. Bed is comfortable. Especially if you're a side sleeper. View from balcony (yes there's a balcony) was absolutely breath taking. Location is near Deli variety stores, as well as the best restaurant meal we had (thanks to Kathy & Anna's recommendations). We were comfortable using washroom, kitchen, and dining area. Hosts were easily reachable through (Hidden by Airbnb) or Airbnb, which is especially convenient because we did not have US Cell phones lines, but could still reach them through street Wifi. Hosts were typically working or out, so gave us more privacy than we expected given it was shared apartment. But we had our room anyway. Location was near subway, but we realized that anywhere in Manhattan was. The neighborhood was not posh by any means, and the people on the streets were nice and we felt safe walking at night at any time.
reviews[79].comments: This apartment is literally perfect. Super clean, great location, and very spacious.
reviews[80].comments: Ana & Kathie have been fantastic in every aspect. Never met two hosts like this before. Great sense of humor and always helpful with great NYC recommendations. Thank you for making me feel at home!
reviews[81].comments: Tal cual.
reviews[82].comments: Anna was such a warm and friendly host. The apartment is cozy and clean. The view is incredible too, I truly enjoyed my stay!
reviews[83].comments: Idéalement placé avec une vue sur Manhattan Bridge, à 30 minutes de marche de Soho et du financial district, métro à 5 min
reviews[84].comments: Heel erg fijn appartement. Gieie locatie, heel dicht bij een metro station van de F train. \nAna en Kathie zijn super aardig en maken graag een praatje. Alles was netjes. I raad de plek zeker aan!
reviews[85].comments:
I stayed at Ana and Kathies apartment for three months. I can highly recommend this place especially for longer stays because you'll feel like staying at home. Ana and Kathie were always friendly and answered me all my questions. They are probably the best Airbnb hosts in New York.
The apartement was always clean. The room is very huge related to the standards in New York and the bed is very comfy and soft.
The Lower East Side is one of the best neighborhoods in Manhattan and I always felt safe there. 
I would choose Ana and Kathies Airbnb again.
reviews[86].comments: 老实说房间外面有一条快速路,即使关上窗户也还是有点点噪音,如果是睡眠不好的人可能会有影响,但是对于我来讲完全不是问题｡而且我很喜欢Ana和她的朋友,她们真是非常棒的房东!跟她们聊天很开心,她们也非常认真地跟我介绍厨房里的东西怎么用,还专门为我洗了个热水壶出来烧热水喝,哈哈｡Ana推荐的餐馆也很好,带我走捷径过去｡告诉我附近的便利店在哪里｡晚上我要出去跑步,还专门推荐我去附近的Williamsburg Bridge跑,说那里跑步的人多,灯光明亮,感觉真的很好｡\nAna家附近地铁步行大概6-7分钟可以到,去地铁的路上就会路过大小超市便利店,我总是顺便买个泡面回家,哈哈｡总之地理位置对我而言很棒,去South Ferry很近,去布鲁克林也方便｡\n我很喜欢房间的布置,面积并不小哦,床也很舒服,卫生间超级干净｡啊｡｡｡｡总之,在曼哈顿选择住Ana家很棒,我还愿意去,一起喝咖啡,蹭煎饺子吃,跟她们再聊聊天｡
reviews[87].comments: I stayed here for 2 months and found it a fantastic place to base my stay in New York.  Great location near good restaurants, bars, stores and excellent transport connections.  The apartment is well fitted out and the room is spacious and has fantastic views (as does the living room and balcony).  Ana and Kathie are lovely (Hidden by Airbnb) , always friendly and on hand with tips for exploring the city, but as a longer term stay it also felt like you had your own space.  Superb place to stay!
reviews[88].comments: Amazing hospitality!!! If all my other AirBNBs could model after this host, I wouldn’t even consider hotels anymore.
reviews[89].comments: Ana and Kathy are incredible hosts! Their apartment is a gem by the East River in a very hip part of town. My stay with them made for a wonderful "New York experience"!
reviews[90].comments:
The stay with Ana and Kathie was very satisfying. First I got to say that the location of the apartment is absolutely outstanding. You have literally everything and anything around that I could imagine needing. Ana and Kathie both were very helpful when needed and could give some nice local insider hints to start out. 

The place is as described and exactly as seen in the pictures. People live there, but it is always clean, the room easy fits two if you don’t need a lot of space. I basically have nothing to complain about. 

Only thing is that their management seems to be a bit difficult at times - I would call it a guarded building basically. There is someone downstairs checking who comes and leaves, so be prepared there might be complications. Ana was always helpful getting everything to work, however this makes me give 4 stars. Nothing really personal, but it’s just a matter of fact. 

The Rooftop is, and I can’t emphasize this enough, amazing. Really not kidding, you won’t find better in Lower East if you are not willing to spend triple the buck. 

I enjoyed some quick conversations all the time. Apart from a dinner where Ana cooked for me (make her show you her Impanadad, they are awesome) we didn’t hang out too much. Not because it wouldn’t have worked out but simply because we both just had enough to do I guess. They both are very nice persons. 

Safe clean friendly environment, nothing you could want more ;) Thanks!
reviews[91].comments: Ana and Kathie’s place is like ‘your home away from home’.  Info before and during my visit was very helpful and prompt replies. Both Ana and Kathie are wonderful hosts and I would strongly recommend their home. \n\nThe apartment is in a great location for lower Manhattan and Brooklyn. Their outdoor balcony is a great luxury feature, I particularly enjoyed having breakfast and evening drinks overlooking the East River, Manhattan and Brooklyn bridges. Area is very safe to be around at night with bars and restaurants only 10 mins away in Chinatown.
reviews[92].comments: This is a super good house, and super good house host. Ana and Kathie are so nice people. They are super friendly. The house is an apartment, and very close to Subway Station. It’s a convenient area , you can find everything you need. Also, there are many good restaurants and bars. The house is very clean and comfortable. I’m very happy can stay in this house with Ana and Kathie. I definitely will come back again when I come back to NYC.

access: Dear Guest,      We want your stay to be  comfortable and relaxing. You are welcome to use all of the following areas and amenities in our home. interaction: Peter and I are available most any time to answer your questions. Peter has lived in New York for over 35 years and a great source of information about the city. Florence travels to Europe and is not always in New York. If we are working at home, our office is in the back just off the garden.    Jolie and Duval are our pets, a beautiful Bengal cat and lovely old pug. Both are unobtrusive, charming and easy going. They'll be of no bother or disturbance to you. Relax, enjoy our home and your stay in New York.

host.host_about:
About Florence.
I am a French communication consultant, traveling between Paris and Harlem. 

About my husband, Peter.
I am a restaurateur, designer and artist working primarily in New York City. I've lived here for the past 30 years and have always considered this great city my home.
When you can't find us  in Manhattan we're either on Vieques or in upstate New York, where we a lovely historic Dutch stone house.

Life is about paying attention and how you choose to experience every moment, one day at a time.

reviews[2].comments: Everything was wonderful - the district is legendary Harlem with a jazz atmosphere and nice people, the apartment is stylish place with cute vintage furniture, and fantastic owners - Florence and Peter! The best place - small and cheerful portal to real New York. Recommend it to all people with good taste:)
reviews[3].comments: Wonderful hosts!  a NYC native and a Frenchwoman made for a home-like long term stay for me.  They allowed me to keep to myself and took care of every concern at a moment's notice.  they made a tough, competitive summer internship a little easier.
reviews[4].comments: Felt very  welcomed and at ease in their home. They were great hosts, made sure we were settled and had everything we needed! \r\nAmenities were also very good. Very accurately described and represented in photos.
reviews[5].comments: The hosts were flexible with my reservation when I decided to leave early. We had some misunderstanding about the layout of the space, and now they have updated their description to clarify it. \n\nThe neighborhood is great and the apartment was nicely designed and clean.
reviews[6].comments: Peter and Florence are great hosts. This was my first trip to NYC, and because of their welcoming hospitality, it will not be my last. Because we felt at home, my husband and I had a great time getting to know Harlem in celebration of our wedding anniversary.
reviews[7].comments: Florence and Peter are excellent hosts. The room was better than what I expected. It was super quiet and very spacious. A real gem in NYC. reviews[8].comments: Totalmente a gusto con mi estancia, Peter es súper amigable y su departamento es muy lindo, buena ubicación y el vecindario tiene mucha onda. Lo recomiendo ampliamente.

reviews[11].comments: Florence and Peter are amazing people, they were very helpful and friendly. The place was spot on and cozy, we had a five stars trip  and we can not wait to go back.
reviews[12].comments: El departamento tiene mucho estilo, Peter y florence som excelentes anfitriones, siempre están atentos . Es muy seguro llegar a cualquier hora. Ampliamente recomendable.
reviews[13].comments: O lugar é bem no centro do Harlem, perto do metrô, bem acessível e com todo tipo de comércio por perto. A casa é uma graça, o quarto bem bacana (no segundo piso, e o banheiro privativo no primeiro, há uma escada). E Florence e Peter são simpáticos e gentis.
reviews[14].comments: Florence and Peter are excellent hosts. They will make you feel like their home is your home. Both make appropriate recommendations for things to do and where to get things around the neighborhood. They check-in with you, but are also very respectful of your privacy -- Their home helped get through a very intense summer school session. They have to pets a dog and a cat. reviews[18].comments: A great space with a comfortable bed and good hanging space. The private bathroom was terrific and the shared area, very comfortable. I visited New York for four days with a friend mid-August. We only met Anthony briefly as he showed us the apartment and handed off the key, and we really did not see that much of anyone else in the apartment during our stay. The apartment was nicely located, and we were both very pleased with our stay, especially considering the low price. 

The bathroom could probably have been more thouroughly cleaned, but other than that our bedroom was clean and it was spacious with plenty of room for two people.
reviews[1].comments: Great location
reviews[2].comments: Anthony is friendly, easygoing and you can come and go as you please. The building seems older but the room was big and bathroom was clean. It is in older shape but the price is inexpensive and if you are traveling by yourself or as a couple, this place can be recommended. The view was nice, AC little noisy but during summer keeping the window open is fine. Subway close by or you can literally walk to anywhere.
reviews[3].comments:
Staying at Anthony's was just wonderful.

The area is ideal with convenience stores and chemists right down the street. The neighborhood is quintessentially NYC which is what anyone would want. So many restaurants in the area for any foodies like me out there. Also there are always an abundance of cabs in the area which made my transportation easy. And if you don't want to cab around, the subway is a 4-5 minute walk away which is nothing in the city. 

The room was spacious and the bed was comfy. The air conditioning in the room was great especially since it was quite warm during the week we stayed. The addition of the small fridge was an awesome plus too. The closet in the room was great, and the dresser had more than enough room for all of our clothes. The room also gets awesome sun during the day, and at night,the lights from midtown buildings light up the sky and are visible if you open up the blinds. 

Anthony was a great host. The communication was fluid and any question we had, Anthony had an answer for. 

Definitely had an amazing stay.
Thank you Anthony for everything!
reviews[4].comments: Anthony was very accommodating even though we had to change our arrival time a few times. The room is clean and the bed is super comfortable! The apt is in a good location and we will def stay here the next time we're in NYC!
reviews[5].comments: I stayed with Anthony for a little over 2 weeks. Anthony came out to meet us and show us around the apartment. The apartment is lovely, and the room is quite spacious! Anthony is friendly, however we did not interact much as I was mostly out of the apartment during the day. The apartment is inhabited by Anthony and other tenants, however we rarely saw them at all so it felt very much as though there was no one home a lot of the time. The location is also great, just a short walk from the subway and around 10 minute walk from the UN. A great place, I would certainly recommend this to other travelers looking to see NYC!
reviews[6].comments: I stayed at Anthony's place for 4days w/ my sister. It is located in a quite town and not that far from Times Square area. Room was exactly same with photos and clean and comfy.\nAnthony was really nice and kindly gave me enough information when I asked various things.\nI would stay here again if I visit in New York.
reviews[7].comments:
Anthony was very nice. We arrived very early and we asked him what we should do with our luggage because we wanted to go sightseeing till we were able to go to our room. He offered to take care of them and leave them in his car. When we arrived our suitcases were already up in our room. We didn't see much of Anthony but he told us to take the train to Newark Airport because it's much cheaper.
The room was big (for New York) and very clean. The sheets were  very neat. Some of the towels had stains on them but they were washed and cleaned.
There even was a little fridge which we didn't use. There were lots of channels on the TV. The wifi was awesome.

neighborhood_overview: I used to live in a 50 story high rise in Midtown next to Times Square and thought it was mad awesome until ... I found the Lower East Side.  This area is still free from large flashy signs and has a lot of amazing restaurants and bars to offer. The BEST in the country! You've even got chic clothing boutiques, hip coffee shops, and parks in case you want to take a jog. Don't know where to find the boutiques? I'll circle them on the map for you. THIS IS STILL A VERY "LOCAL" NEW YORK SPOT. In fact, you can see the transition taking place right now. Is it safe? YES. There's a primary school across the street. You'll hear the kids playing when you're outside when school is in session. There's also a police department a few blocks south east. In general, New York is pretty safe. The movie depictions are pre-1990's The Williamsburg bridge is right nearby for a relaxing walk over the water! Gorgeous view from the rooftop :) More photos to come!
notes: *DO NOT knock on other people's doors or ask residents where I live. They do not know and can get spooked that strangers with suitcases are roaming around the building. PLEASE read the instructions and follow them exactly*  Airbnb is *not* illegal in New York but residents may not share our sense of adventure :). ***I've recently installed home cameras facing the two entrances for our safety and the safety of the guests.*** ***The sofa bed is not available for two person bookings. To use it, you must ask if you are in a situation where you need it before booking, otherwise the strict cancellation policy still applies.*** ***If the first person that arrives is not the same person that booked, it will be your responsibility to pass on any information, manuals, directions, or otherwise.*** This apartment is on the first floor and the room is downstairs, yes there is an elevator. Like most New York apartments that *are not highrises* there is indirect sunlight. Most guests that book are us
transit: In the reservation email there will be a super detailed document that shows you how to get around and how to enter the apartment.  PLEASE LOOK FOR THIS. The F/M/J/Z trains are two blocks away from my apartment and lead you all over Manhattan.  The F/M will take you uptown towards  *** North *SoHo (Shopping!) 15 min *West Village (Brunch places) 20 min *Korea Town/Herald Square (Macy's) 30 min *Times Square 30 min *Rockefeller Center (Empire State) 30 min *Central Park (Bergdorf, FAO Schwarz, Apple Store) 35 min *** South *DUMBO 15 min *Red Hook 20 min *Atlantic Ave 30 min The J/Z will take you to  ***West *China Town 10 min *Financial District 10 min ***East *Williamsburg 15 min There's a transfer point at Broadway-Lafayette for the 6 train which runs along the east part of Manhattan going through  *** North *Astor Place/NYU 20 min *Union Square (Sunday Farmer's Market, Forever 21, Barnes & Noble, Best Buy, Regal Cinemas, Panera, impromptu dance battles) 25 min *Flatiron/Gramercy/Madis
access: The sofa bed is NOT available for only a two person booking If members of your group arrive before you, you are responsible for their expectations and providing them any directions or document sent. interaction: If you want your privacy I totally get it but I know what it's like to travel on your own so if you want someone to chat with or need advice on your fancy outfit for your night out on the town I'm here to help!  Phone calls, sms, or (Hidden by Airbnb) is okay, but I communicate mostly through the Airbnb app during normal hours (9AM-5PM please!) I'm multilingual! reviews[31].comments:
This was my very first Airbnb experience, and it went reasonably well!
The first thing we received was a long list of instructions on how to get into and use the apartment, which was really helpful. It was good to have these things (like door codes) on hand at any moment. 
The apartment itself was minimal, smallish, and clean. The building seemed nice, and the neighborhood had plenty of things in the area to see and shop at, especially with regards to food/coffee/groceries. 
Biggest pluses: the room was private and sparse, even if on the small side. We stayed in Room 01, which we learned was the smallest choice (it was a first come first served style, with three or four rooms available). The apartment was cleaned virtually every day. It was quiet indoors, and we were almost never bothered by anyone else. There were two shared bathrooms, which was nice when needed.
Biggest cons: The room is at ground level, and everyone walking by can be heard up and down the street. The room was SMALL but the other three rooms looked to be about twice the size (so choose them!). The living room space had a tiny couch and no chairs, so it wasn't really comfortable. The two bathrooms seemed less generous when there were six people in the apartment all at once. 
The toilets were specifically marked to not have ANY paper waste be deposited into them, which was annoying and gross. We were asked not to flush things like tampons and pads (a reasonable request) but also to throw out used toilet paper in the trash (which was not so great).

Overall, it was a nice place with a weird rule or two. Choose the bigger room, and you probably won't meet anyone else staying there.

First off, there is NO free parking on the premises. He is referring to the street parking outside his apartment. You do not learn about that until after you book and it is too late.
Secondly, the instructions the host sent us after booking were very long, poorly articulated, and left us with the impression that he wasn't suppose to be renting his place out as an airBnB. Additionally, the space is not as nice as it appears in the pictures. The common space is messy, very dark, and NOT air conditioned. Not comfortable to be in. The room we booked was astonishingly smaller than the pictures. The only thing that I will say is the bathrooms are very nice and the only redeeming quality.
Last of all, the space is shared by many people, not including the host (which we never even saw by the way). There were at least three other people in the apartment in addition to my boyfriend and I. This became problematic in the morning when trying to get ready on a time crunch, even with the two beautiful bathrooms. It was quite frustrating.

I love Budakann and all the restaurants in the neighborhood too. It's also fun to see the designer shops off 14th and 10th ave like Jeffery's and more. Love the sushi in Chelsea Market too!

You can paint in the room and Olan has an easel for you along with art supplies and canvas should you wish to express yourself.

Also a gift basket for every guest and a stocked fridge with water, orange juice and other snacks. Guests share the bathroom. Artist Olan works' lives in the main living area of the apartment with his dog Big Al and Tuxie the cat.

Since websites are not allowed on AIRBNB feel free to do a web search about Olan Art/Actor & check out my acting work on IMDB to find out more about me my art and photography.
reviews[0].comments: my girlfriend and I had an a amazing stay at Olan's place, we spent 1 month there out of a 3 month stay in NY, and by far we had the best time there out of our whole trip. Olan is a great guy (and a great cook!) and will make you feel very comfortable and welcome during your stay! its a very cool room with a lot of cool art and a great vibe. will being going back there for sure next time!!! ... if available ;)
reviews[1].comments: The reservation was canceled 5 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
reviews[2].comments: Where to begin? Olan is an amazing host!! He is very kind and did not treat me as a tenant but as a friend. He is definitely one of a kind. The room is very nice, clean, bright, and decorated with art, some of it created by Olan himself. The whole aparent is very comfortable and clean. \r\nThe neighborhood is great. Walking distance to Chelsea market, high line and the subway.\r\nWhen I go back to NY I would live to stay at Olan's again, if the room is available of course!
reviews[3].comments: Olan was the most generous host. I was so spoilt. He made breakfast in the mornings and was always offering delicious dinners. The room was great. Very artsy space with a comfy bed and lots of nooks and crannys to hang about. The location is right in the centre of all the action! It's an opportunity not to be missed!
reviews[4].comments:
Great host & always cooked for me... I love it & it was totally unexpected. 
Truly a great host & a unique space. 
The neighborhood is awesome - I've always loved Chelsea; and Olan is able to give directions anywhere when needed. 
So cool - I highly recommend.
reviews[5].comments: It was a great pleasure to stay at Olan's apartment. The room is really spacious and full of amazing artwork. The location of the apartment is incredible, right in the heart of Chelsea near the Chelsea Market and 14th St A,C, E subway stop. Olan was very welcoming when I first arrive and throughout my whole stay. He would often cook me meals and was very easy going about my crazy work schedule. A+++
reviews[6].comments:
I found this to be a great place to stay, for three reasons:
1. The room is large, with a desk, fridge, tv, and plent of space to sprawl out. It is also decorated with lots of cool art. Further it is surprisingly quiet for a Manhattan apartment. 
2. Olan and his dog were great. Olan showed me around the area, offered food, and made it a nice place to be. 
3. Chelsea is a great place to stay in Manhattan which made walking home a lot shorter after heading out at night. further this apartment is close to a station covering the A, C, E & L lines so it is easy to get north/south Manhattan and across to Brooklyn very easily.
reviews[7].comments:
Fantastic location within reach of all the great things Chelsea has to offer. We enjoyed the stay with Olan and his two pets. The quirky room is filled with lots of artwork and is well equipped. Olan loves to cook and we got spoilt with cooked breakfasts. He is very accommodating, good company and has got a good sense of humor. 

Hopefully we will return one day!
reviews[8].comments: Olan was really hospitable and caring! Often cooked breakfast for me and helped me with my living in New York. The room is pretty too, a great sense of art. I had a cat with me and Olan was always helpful. I enjoyed my stay :)
reviews[9].comments: I had a great time at Chelsea with Olan. Friendly talks, a funky bedroom with art everywhere, the most protein rich breakfasts I had in a long time. No wonder he is getting that good reviews! Recommended.
reviews[10].comments:
What a FABULOUS host.  Olan met me when I first arrived and showed me everything in the apartment and made me feel very welcome.  The next morning he was kind enough to make me a delicious breakfast.

I would have no hesitation in recommending this room to you, the room is just like it looks in the photos.  The artwork is quirky & fantastic and really makes it a great place to stay.  The desk was a bonus for me as I had some work to do when I was not "doing" New York.

The location was perfect.  Right by the E line at 14th St/8th Av and easy walking distance to Union Square as well as all the great bars & restaurants of Chelsea, Meatpacking DIstrict & West Village.  Make sure you take a walk along the Highline as well.
reviews[11].comments: It's totally different to a stay in a hotel but so much better and more interesting. Lovely host who gaves you great suggestions. The flat is very funny, a bit small for 3 people but I'm sure it will be perfect for 2.
reviews[12].comments: An artist's paradise! Olan is himself an artist with southern hospitality, delicious breakfasts and snacks (the room was stocked full of snacks, fruit, and water), and a SUPER comfortable bed. I ended having to work quite a bit from the room while there and Olan (and his animals) offered me the right mix of privacy and conversation breaks. Plus, the location is perfect with Chelsea Market, The High Line park, hip restaurants, and convenient subway access. Highly recommend!
reviews[13].comments: Indeed a very WHITE SUNNY ARTISTS room. But also clean, nice and located perfectly nearly next to the Chelsey Market in the center of Meatpacking District. Olan is a great host, superfriendly. He seemed to really enjoy showing us around and meeting new guests.\r\nWe felt very welcome. If we ever visit NYC again, we hope we can stay here again.\r\n
reviews[14].comments: I stayed at Olan's place for 10 days and it was an amazing experience! The room is beautiful and looks just like the photos. Olan is a great host; he cooked breakfast for me, with different menu each day! He is accommodating and gives great tips about the city. Al the dog and Tuxie the cat like to visit the room and I love them. However if you don't like pets in the room you can always keep them out. The apartment is well-located for exploring the city. This is my first experience with airbnb and I couldn't be happier! Thank you, Olan. Looking forward to visit again in the future. Anastasia
reviews[15].comments: Location is great, Olan is a nice host, but the appartment is not very clean.
reviews[16].comments:
I couldn't have had a better stay in NY than I did with Olan. The room is perfect, and exactly as described. Olan is an excellent host, and welcomed me into his home. He even cooked breakfast every day.

It's a great location, too, very close to subway stops that can take you to all parts of the city, and Chelsea is a lovely location itself, with so much to see and do.

If I'm ever in New York again, I'll be sure to stay with Olan.
reviews[17].comments:
Every minute at Olan's apartment is a gift! 
You get much more than you see in the picture.
Perfect location to travel anywhere. Meat Packing district is very hip and artistic area, tons of good restaurants and interesting fashion boutique.

If you want to be inspired and get tons of good energy, this is the place to be. Olan is such a wonderful host, he is very intelligent and interesting person. While I was there, he made me a breakfast (very nice presentation and yummy!) and a fridge full of juices, water and yogurts. Also you have a microwave to yourself.

The bed is very cozy and clean. This place really makes me feel home. I am also an animal lover. Tuxy (cat) and Al (dog) will be your best friends, they are wonderful to be around :)
reviews[18].comments: We had a wonderful experience staying with Olan.  His place was exactly as pictured/described, and was clean and bright with easy access to the subway.  The shower was hot, and the bed was super comfortable.  Olan was a great host.  He was generous, helpful, and made us breakfast.  This was our first experience with Airbnb and it was a great one.  Thanks, Olan!
reviews[19].comments:
Olan is a great host - I mean, he makes you breakfast in bed!
The room is great, you have more than enough space, snacks, TV, a desk and the bed is super comfortable!
Just bear in mind that there is no elevator (luckily the housemate helped me with my suitcase - so it wasn't really a biggie for me) and it definitely is an artsy apartment, so if you are expecting a sleek, modern and smooth surfaced apartment, this is probably not the place for you. Finally, the area is amazing, heart of meatpacking with the Chelsea market on your doorstep. 
I'd recommend it any day.
reviews[20].comments: I felt truly lucky to have found such a great space in one of the best parts of NYC and to stay with someone who is as gracious, kind and fun to spend time around as Olan. The location couldn't be better (1/2 block to  Chelsea Market and major subway lines), the room is quiet and like a private little studio all to yourself, and Olan is the best! I highly recommend his place and look forward to visiting NYC again.
reviews[21].comments: Hi everyone! Ive been at Olan place for 30 days. The white room was quite big and comfy. It has fridge, microwave, TV and coffe maker, all you may need for a pleasant and privacy stay. Although I had to share the bathroom, always was free for me!. I have to thank Olan for the nice breakfast that some days he prepared for me as well as fresh chicken soup in those cold days. It was very kind of him. Also Herald helped me a lot with the suitcase and laundry. Thanks!. However, without doubt the best of this private room is the location. 15th street, just a couple of minutes  walking to chelsea market and subways. A very nice and cool area to enjoy your stay in Manhattan. Very close of everything and well communicated. I highly recommend it!
reviews[22].comments: It was the best Christmas experience! We spent a week at Olan's place! Olan fixed delicious breakfast for us everyday, I really appreciate for his kindness! The room was cozy and comfy, has everything such as snacks and fresh towels! I felt like home there! The Chelsea neiborhood is very nice, it has all the things I need. The location is great, I went to a lot of art galleries and restaurants by walking. I hope I could stay longer here, with Olan and his two cute pets! I recommend this place to all the people who are looking for an artistic and private space to stay in Manhattan!
reviews[23].comments:
Wow! Even after all of the rave reviews, I was blown away by Olan's caring, generous hosting. He could not have been kinder, more generous or more considerate.  He made us breakfasts, provided snacks and even quality DVDs for when it got just too cold outside!

The room is just like the picture, the bed comfy, with luxurious sheets.   There is a lovely sense of light in the room and the sunshine comes in.  By Manhattan standards the room is large. 

The location is fabulous, with a subway station about a block away, the Chelsea markets less than a block away and the Highline about the same. 

Olan has effectively converted the lounge room into another bedroom (which he has). This means there isn't a lounge room, only bedrooms and a computer nook connected by hallways.  There is also the reality of a small space with dog + cat. Ie, the cat's food bowl is on the bench and there is a pee mat for Al the dog, in the kitchen (old dogs need concessions). If you can manage with those realities, I highly recommend. 

The apartment was clean and delightfully arty,  our room squeaky clean, and Olan as a host was simply knock your socks off, 5 star.
reviews[24].comments:
Olan is a superhero of Airbnb for his hospitality, wonderful personality and beautiful apartment suite. The sunny art room was a great place for me to rest, think and work for a month. I loved the small mini-kitchen area where Olan stocked water, snacks and delicious chocolate for me, as well as the desk where I found myself amazingly productive and inspired. 

Olan cooked breakfast for me, which I loved, and we bonded over Game of Thrones weekly since Olan has HBO. Al the dog and Tuxie the cat were lovely creatures and it was great to have pets for a month! The location is convenient to the subway, Chelsea Market, restaurants and two organic juice bars, which made me very happy. 

I feel that not only did I find a place to stay, I also made a friend. Thank you, Olan!
reviews[25].comments: I had a great stay in Olan's Art Room.  Olan is a generous and interesting host, very kind, and makes great breakfasts!  The room is very comfortable, and I was greeted with fresh fruit, chocolates, and a small fridge stuffed with complementary snacks, juices and water.  There is a coffee maker, cereal, and other amenities, all most considerately supplied.  The bed is very comfortable, and I made steady use of the writing desk.  Internet service was updated while I was there, and was fast and convenient.  Olan is very sensitive to allowing one privacy, but also warm and open to conversation.  \r\n\r\nIn all, I was very comfortable and relaxed in this room, and very much enjoyed my time there.  The location is fantastic for the Village and the west side.
reviews[26].comments: Olan is a fantastic host! His home is a perfect sanctuary for us young students that find ourselves traveling to the city on internships. He is caring, thoughtful, and always concerned with the wellbeing of his guests, but also leaves you as much space as you desire. I would definitely come back!
reviews[27].comments: Staying with Olan was such an incredibly way to experience NYC. I spent 28 days with him in July 2014 and wish it was longer. He is not only one of the nicest people I have ever met, but his apartment is also very bohemian and cool.  I would recommend to anyone going to NYC to stay with Olan in Chelsea!
reviews[28].comments:
I do not know where to start, actually. I arrived in New York City as a stranger in hope to find a place to get to know the city and to relax - and that is exactly what Olan has provided me with. Not only is the apartment cozy, welcoming and granted with an unique atmosphere, it is also the home of a wonderful host and his two companions Tuxie and Al ( a cat and a dog ). 
That being said, Olan made me feel like I was at home from the very right beginning. The spacious art room is equipped with everything you need - and even more. Even though the location is in the middle of everything, it is completely quiet and you will eventually sleep like a baby. 
Also, Olan was extremely helpful. He gave me great advice, which helped to find a solution for any question/issue I had on my way.
It was extremely easy to get along with Olan and somehow the feeling of being a stranger in such a big city as New York suddenly fell flat after I entered Olan's warmhearted hospitality.
I was really sad when it was time for me to leave - even though it was just a week, I made a new friend, who will probably last for a long time.
I highly recommend Olan's place - whether you want company or time for yourself - this is the place to be ! No doubt about that !
reviews[29].comments: Olan is a wonderful host. He made us feel right at home and was extremely accommodating. His apartment is filled with art, fun, colorful, and very tidy. The bed is comfy and the towels are soft. His location is superb. We walked to everything. And he served us an amazing breakfast each morning. I enjoyed every minute. I will be back!
reviews[30].comments: Olan was most welcoming and I immediately felt comfortable staying in his apartment. He was generous with his time and gave great advice on activities in NYC. \r\nThe position of the apartment was fantastic; close to the subway, Chelsea market and lots of galleries, restaurants and things to do. I highly recommend staying with Olan for a genuine NY experience- much more fun than an impersonal hotel.
reviews[31].comments: Olan was very welcoming and really made us feel right at home from the minute we stepped into his apartment. He is a very warm and giving person that will help you make sure your stay is problem free. Every morning he would get up and make us breakfast which was a great way to start the day. The apartment is very cozy and has the perfect location, situated just one block away from Chelsea Market and Meatpacking. We will definitely stay with Olan the next time we are back in NYC and we can strongly recommend his place to anybody who considers staying in NYC.
reviews[32].comments: Nous avons passé une semaine merveilleuse à New York. L'appartement et l'accueil d'Olan y ont grandement contribué. Nous avons découvert non seulement un quartier joli et animé, mais également une personne attachante soucieuse de notre bien-être et de notre tranquillité. Ses petits déjeuners sont incroyables ! La chambre est un petit appartement à elle toute seule, avec son canapé, son lit en mezzanine, son frigo et son garde-manger bien garni ! Plusieurs stations de métro très proches nous emmenaient dans la plupart des quartiers, dont Brooklyn. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement et son propriétaire !
reviews[33].comments: Olan was a great host! He is very welcoming and caring. His place is very clean, cosy and the art makes it really unique. His pets are just adorable too and if you don't like them it's ok cause they won't be entering your space anyways unless upon your permission\r\nLocation of the apartment is perfect. Walking distance to very nice restaurants, shopping and high line.
reviews[34].comments: Olan is a wonderfully happy host. He set me at ease with speedy email responses. He shared loads of info on his neighborhood and as soon as I got in we walked the handsome Big Al, jack russell terrier, which gave me the lay of the land. Olan cooked me the most colorful, amazing breakfasts! I stayed alone the first few days and it's valuable to know that I felt very safe. The studio is very bohemian artsy with enough room for two adults. My boyfriend Frank arrived midway through the week and loved the cat Tuxie, Big Al and Olan. With the way the studio is set up Frank and I felt like we had enough privacy, felt lucky we had enough snacks and water yet wanted to leave the door open to share our experiences with Olan. We will definitely stay with Olan again and recommend his studio to others!
reviews[35].comments: Olan was a fantastic host and the art room was the perfect set up for my time in the city! He was very welcoming and warm and cannot imagine a better host and location.  I had a great experience in the city and left with a new friendship on top of it!
reviews[36].comments: We left Olans house 2 hours ago and already miss him! New York can be a crazy place and it was such a comfort knowing we had someone who had our back. We felt right at home in our cozy yet spacious room. We loved the puppy Al and sometimes the kitty too. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone and would stay here again myself .
reviews[37].comments: I had a great time staying with Olan, he's a caring, sweet and cheerful host. He would make me breakfast to cheer me up and always offer to clean the towels and sheets. He has an eye for art, and I loved the photos he took! It's worth mentioning his dog and cat, Al and Tuxie. I miss them all!
reviews[38].comments: I had a great time staying with Olan! He has the kindest heart and goes out of his way to make sure that your stay is comfortable. He and Al (very loving dog) make a great team. The room is beautiful, very comfortable, and has everything you could possibly need during your stay—including chocolate! Olan's art is fantastic and lines the walls of the apartment. The apartment is located in a great area and right next to the Subway. I loved walking to and along the Hudson River and through Greenwich Village to Washington Square Park. Lots of great places to eat and very comfortable area.
reviews[39].comments: Olan is a lovely person and a great host. My experience in New York wouldn't have been the same without him and without Tuxie and Mr.Al. Every morning, no matter the time, he fixed delicious breakfasts. I am vegetarian, and Olan found yummy ways to make my morning meal different and tasty. The room is cozy and sunny, a nice space to relax, and move your legs if you need to. Clean sheets and towels are provided every week. \r\nNo matter the rush of the city, no matter the weather, at Olan's apt. you will feel at home, and never alone. Also you will be right in the middle of Chelsea and Meatpacking district, which are safe and amazing areas where to walk, do shopping, having brunch and experience the real vibe of the city!
reviews[40].comments: Olan是一位貼心又友好的房東, 特別在適當的時間準備早餐和宵夜給房客, 此外在生活所需的盥洗用品皆一應俱全, 床墊和環境也相當適合旅途疲憊後的休息和放鬆｡下次有機會來紐約, 希望能夠再次來到Olan的家｡\r\n
reviews[41].comments: First of all, Olan is such an attentive and generous host and we loved staying with him for our time in New York! He is a super host for a very good reason. He was very kind to us with Check In and Check Out times, which was hugely helpful and greatly appreciated. Our every need was catered for with breakfast in the mornings and a mini fridge with snacks and drinks. He was always full of good information for the area and tips and tricks for the city. Getting around was a breeze  - his place is in an amazing location, you're walking distance to all the best spots in the downtown area. It's also incredibly close to the Subway line, which has express and local trains running every 5-10 minutes. We are so glad to have stayed with him and will definitely be coming back again! You can really tell the love and attention he puts into each guest coming to stay and we highly recommend him to anyone
reviews[42].comments:
Since I couldn't find reviews written in Japanese, I'll be writing!

今回年末から年始にかけて8日間程滞在したのですが､とても良い部屋でした!部屋は彼の書いたｱｰﾄで溢れていてとてもおしゃれで､ﾎｽﾄのｵﾗﾝも優しく､彼は犬と猫を1匹ずつ飼っているのですが2匹とも可愛いかったです｡ただｱﾚﾙｷﾞｰの方は気を付けて下さいね｡

Great hospitality, proper courtesy, and comfortable mood! I love it!
reviews[43].comments: I stayed at Olan's apartment for much of February and March, and I totally recommend the apartment and experience. Olan is friendly, accommodating and warm, and a true friend and great host. He provides hand picked welcome packs to guests, and even made me breakfast on several occasions! He has a friendly dog and a cute cat, and the apartment is in a great location in West Village/ Greenwich Village (close to cafes, bars, great shopping etc). The room itself is clean, large and private, with a desk and couch that enable you to work from home when you need to :) Olan is also a great host because he lives  that WV/ GV lifestyle, with his roles and active life in theatre, film and TV, as well as his work in fashion and photography. So particularly for people new to New York, he is happy to share his experiences and provide a window into those cultures. Olan is a great host and friend and I would enthusiastically recommend his home to anyone. I would also be happy to stay there again in the future!
reviews[44].comments: Without a doubt my finest AirBnb experience to date. Olan was a great host - he was polite, welcoming, fun to talk to, and made delicious surprise breakfasts. He went out of his way to make sure I was comfortable. The location is also superb - it's less than one block to the subway station and less than one block to Chelsea Market. I will be staying with Olan the next time I visit New York.
reviews[45].comments: I had a lovely time at this apartment. Olan is a fantastic and welcoming host. He was helpful and polite and always provided a great breakfast. The neighbourhood is a great mix of cool, hip places to eat and drink and the location is just right.
reviews[46].comments:
Olan's accom very conveniently located - for anything really. So much to see and do around Chelsea, Greenwich and the Meatpacking District, with easy access to the subway and buses.
Olan was very welcoming and helpful all of the time. A very interesting host who was kept busy himself with his art projects. Healthy breakfast served each morning was delicious. 
I had a great time as Olan was always up for an interesting chat. I would stay with Olan again and 
definitely recommend him and his for a very iconic stay in the Big Apple.
reviews[47].comments:
We just came back from our phantastic holiday in New York and a very lovely stay at Olan's place. 

Olan was an awesome, fun and friendly host. We really had the best time there and always felt very easy and welcome. He just did everything to make us happy and comfort us. Especially the breakfast was beyond any expectations (pancakes, quiche, eggs, fresh juices, coffee or yogurth with fruits).

The room ist just perfect in size and the bed was so comfy. You can hang your clothes, eat/study/write at the desk, watch tv/videos or relax on the couch.  Olan prepared lots of fresh fruits, drinks and  we could also make our own tea or coffee. 

The location in West Village/Greenwich Village is absolutely perfect. You have so many good and also famous/hip restaurants, brand shops, Chelsea market, the Whitney Museum, subway, bike rentals and the Hudson river within a few minutes walk. 

We also got along very well with the little dog and cat. They were fun and friendly and made us even more feel like home. 

Olan is a great, fun and very interesting guy. Working on Little films, doing fashionshoots, acting and his paintings are really nice. You can always have a great, fun and interesting talk with him. We are still laughing about some of the stories. And he really can tell you interesting things about the City or where to go. 

This was such a great AirBnB experience and we fully recommend Olan an his lovely, artistic place. 

Thank you soo much. We would love to stay there again.
reviews[48].comments: I don't know where to start...... My stay in NYC with Olan has been the most incredible experience. The apartment is super cool, artsy, yet homely. Olan looked after me as if I was family and surprised me every morning with the most amazing breakfasts. He was always available to help and advise with any questions I had about the city. The location is just perfect, close to very cool shops, restaurants, Chelsea Market and the subway. Olan is a very talented artist and actor and I was lucky enough to have been involved in his work whilst I was there. His dog and cat are gorgeous and they truly adore him. He was flexible with check in and check out times as my flight was delayed. The only problem with check out was that I was devastated to be leaving. In summary it was just perfect. I can't thank Olan enough.
reviews[49].comments: Olan's room is seriously amazing, and you will NOT find a listing this high-quality for the price, especially considering the location. Super close to the A/C/E, 1/2/3, and L subway lines, and a short walk from the High Line and Chelsea Market. The room itself has great decorations, a comfy sofa AND loft bed, plus ample space. Lots of snacks and amenities provided too! The high-powered AC was a big plus for me (seeing as I visited during a late-summer heat wave). Also Olan himself is really nice and provides useful tips (and his cat and dog are very friendly). Highly recommended overall, I had a great experience.
reviews[50].comments: Room, location, and host were exactly as described and exceedingly pleasant!
reviews[51].comments: Super nice and accommodating guy with adorable pets. Follow his simple and reasonable rules, and he goes out of his way to make your stay super easy. He'd get 6 stars for Amenities if that was an option.
reviews[52].comments:
Olan is an exceptionally welcoming host who greets you warmly and goes above and beyond to ensure your stay is enjoyable. The room is clean, tidy and has a small fridge, couch and loft bed with television.  Olan provides a wide variety of complementary snacks and drinks including a Kurieg coffee machine and fruit bowl. Olan is mindful of any dietary restrictions you may have. There is a window with view of the city street and while I stayed there was no noise assuring a restful night.  Olan has decorated the home with furnishings, rugs and amnesties that give it a homely feel and his artwork certainly livens up the space. It is important to note that access to the room requires passing through Olan's living area space that he shares with his cat and small dog, separated by a hanging sheet. This includes when visiting the restroom and is not a problem as Olan respects your privacy and space. Just be careful not to trample his friendly pets during the night.  Pets will not enter your room so long as you keep your door closed. The listing does state that the  bathroom and kitchen are shared. In the bathroom is a variety of liquid soaps, shampoos and other products that can be used. 

The room features soft and comfortable bedding with many pillows and plentiful thick towels. There's a hanging space for your clothing near the window and several touch activated lamps in the room to create the desired ambience. 

The location is superb with a gourmet local market nearby and a subway entry that is less than 10 minutes to times square and Broadway. The apartment is one flight of stairs up with two security doors for entry to the complex. I felt that my valuables were perfectly safe being stored while I was out during the day.

Olan makes a superb breakfast in the morning and is happy to have a chat if you so wish. I highly recommend this property as a place to stay whether it's your first time in Manhattan or returning. I certainly will be looking to stay here again if I'm fortunate to visit from Australia again in the near future. A fantastic AirBnB location.
reviews[53].comments:
Olan's place became our New York home for a week. The location was perfect at such a lovely corner of Meatpacker and Chelsea, just tucked away from the bustle, but no more than 3 minutes walk from Chelsea market. Just across the street is the stairs down to the subway, which was so simple to use and became valuable as we explored the rest of Manhattan. Next to the apartment building is also a great coffee shop! Because its location you had the pick of the best restaurants/bars this area has to offer.

Olan went above and beyond as host. He gave us great tips of what to see and when to visit certain locations to avoid the crowds. He also makes excellent breakfasts! We did not want for anything during our stay, our fridge was stocked up, there was great snacks, fresh towels, bathrobes and even use of fresh toiletries. We felt very well taken cared of. 

The loft itself is so very comfortable with lots of space and looks onto the street. It's bright and airy and big enough for two people to relax in without being on top of each other. We made friends with Big Al (cute dog!) and Tuxie (aloof but affectionate cat) and they weren't an issue at all. 

I am so glad that we were able to book and stay with Olan and recommend this room and him as host if you ever decide to stay in this part of Manhattan.
reviews[54].comments: I had a really happy and relaxed time at Olan's. He, Big Al and Tuxie became like room buddies and it was like staying with a friend, who I could chat to and completely be myself with. It sure helps to love animals to stay here! I also loved hearing about the range of Olan's fascinating creative projects, it felt I was in the middle of the scene!\r\nI loved my cosy room with its hideaway snug loft bed, and all the details like touch lighting, a generously stocked fridge, masses of fruit, coffee machine and plentiful linens. Olan brings a fabulous breakfast in every morning, with healthy juice, fruit and yoghurt plus a cooked component with tomatoes and avocados. You won't go hungry staying here! \r\nAll in all I'd recommend Olan's to those with an open mind and creative spirit. He is an extremely generous host.
reviews[55].comments: I stayed at Olans and had a wonderful experience. I felt like I could be at ease in his home in fact it felt like I was visiting a old (not literally)Familiar friend .The location was perfect for my needs it was a great time.
reviews[56].comments: Olan is such a great host! The area was perfect, the room was perfect, the amenities provided perfect. Definitely a place where I wanna stay again the next time I visit NYC.
reviews[57].comments: Olan is an actor and had a gig on the day I arrived, but he communicated that via emails and his friend Betty met me at the door with the keys.  The location is wonderful.  It's only 1/2 a block away from the Chelsea Market with Metro stops near by.  Olan is an amazing host and person.  He made me breakfast one morning (which was delicious) and stocked the fridge in my room to the brim with snacks and drinks.  A plate of fresh fruits and a Keurig machine (with pods) were also in my room.  The bed was very comfortable and clean towels were alway available.  Olan is also an artist and the rooms are stocked with his amazing work.  A very nice stay.
reviews[58].comments: Olan is adorable and I had the BEST time staying with him at his apartment.  I actually chose Olan's place because there was a dog and cat living there.  This always adds something special for me and of course I totally fell in love with Big Al and Tuxie the cat.  \nThe apartment itself is perfectly situated.  You are minutes away from everything, and the interior is a wonderful hot potch of paintings and textiles.  I loved my room - it had everything I needed, and when I arrived Olan had filled my fridge with veggie snacks, and had really taken time to think about what I would like.  Most days he brought me beautiful breakfast on a tray and was always around to give advice or a helping hand.  In fact he even went out on New Year's Day and got me provisions for my self induced hangover.  Just the kindest loveliest man.  I adored staying here, but if you're an animal lover and love art and artists this is the only place in Manhattan you should ever stay.
reviews[59].comments: Olan's apartment is in a quiet neighborhood but it is also a great location to go anywhere. You can walk to subway stations and chelsea market in a few minutes. The room is private and clean. Olan is very friendly and his animal friends are very cute.
reviews[60].comments: I stayed in Olan's place for 4 months and I really enjoyed my time there. Olan prepared food in my fridge before my arrival and the room also had a coffee machine. The room is quiet, clean, private and artistic. I really like his paintings on the wall. The apartment is in a great location: Chelsea market is in a minute walking distance; there are multiple subways and many restaurants in the neighborhood. Olan is really friendly and warm-hearted. His dog AL and cat Tuxie are adorable and friendly. I would like to stay in Olan's place next time when I visit NYC and I would recommend Olan's place to anyone who hopes to have a great experience in NYC!
reviews[61].comments:
LOVED IT!!!
We stayed in the larger of the two rooms available at Olan's place and I cannot express how in love I fell with the room. It is everything I would ever want in my own NYC apartment if I ever decided to move there. It really made me feel like I was getting the full NY experience rather than staying in a hotel.  The bed was extremely comfortable. I love pillows and this room had so many fluffy pillows. Our mini fridge was fully stocked with waters and other beverages. He was also kind enough to set out numerous snacks for us to enjoy during our stay. In our room were also robes, slippers, mouthwash, lotions. There was no detail that Olan didn't think of. I would definitely stay again.

I loved how friendly and welcoming Olan was. He was always available for any questions that we had. But if I'm being honest Big Al (dog) and Tuxie (cat) stole were the icing on the cake! They are the cutest little pair and I loved how they greeted us every morning before we left for the day and every night when we came back. They are so friendly and it made our stay with Olan that much better.
reviews[62].comments: My stay with Olan was amazing - if I could give 6 stars, I would. He anticipated every need, included me in his life when I wanted to, and respected privacy otherwise. In addition, I had the privilege to get a glimpse of a pre-gentrification New York, which is a rare treat these days. I've stayed in NYC a couple of times, and this stay was my favorite.
reviews[63].comments: I loved my stay at Olan's place. The location is perfect and Olan is a very caring, kind and helpful host. Our plane was delayed and Olan very kindly stayed up to welcome us. He cooked my friend and I lovely welcome breakfast and provided a wonderful range of snacks and a fridge full of bottled water. Olan's apartment is full of creativity and artistic flare. His pets are lovely and fun to have around. I very much enjoyed hanging out with Olan and enjoyed our chats. Olan also went out of his way to post a pair of jeans to my home address. I'd ordered them from a local shop and they didn't arrive before I left Olan's. Now I'm home miss Olan calling out 'welcome home' when I came back from a long day sightseeing.
reviews[64].comments: If you want to stay in a cosy bohemian artist's apartment with a cat and a dog, you'll love this place. I had a great time here.  Olan is very friendly, excentric, super easy going, even though he sleeps in the common area you can come and go as you please without disturbing him. The room is big for one person, you sleep on a mezzanine, which is really nice, you have your comfy space away from the streets.....I loved watching movies and drawing up there. The neighborhood is amazing, it's safe to walk here anytime of the night. All in all I can only recommend this place, it's funky and I felt right at home living among three sweet boys :) thanks for the great stay guys.\n\n* I get eczema from cat and dog hair so I just didn't let them in the room, it was not an issue. They are also not allowed in the bathroom. But if you don't like animals, this might not be the best place for you ~
reviews[65].comments: What a perfect stay! Of course the location/room/apartment are absolutely incredible (see all the other reviews!) but Olan himself is what made our stay so special. We always felt completely at home and very well looked after - when I arrived with a bad cough Olan plied me with vitamins, homemade chicken soup, and other treats (and it worked - I got better in a few days!). Could not recommend his place highly enough. We had an amazing trip, Olan and the pets are wonderful company, and we’re looking forward to going back one day!
reviews[66].comments: I had a really great time with Olan! The room was very cozy, comfortable and quite big for one person. I had everything I needed, a fridge with beverages, fresh fruit and even the possibility to make coffee or tea. Olan himself was a perfect host, always up to chat but I also had my privacy whenever I wanted to. \nI loved living around the dogs and the cat, they‘re fun and friendly, just good company.\nNext time I would definitely stay with Olan again!
reviews[67].comments: This is a great place to stay if you're coming to Chelsea or anywhere on Manhattan.  Great location, cozy room, and the snacks can really save the day if you don't feel like buying lunch at Manhattan prices.
reviews[68].comments: An amazing place as the photos suggest. We enjoyed our stay immensely. From the warm welcome we received from Olan, very nice host. He was available and very friendly any time we had any questions, the communication had been perfect. He was extremely kind  and a very attentive host who goes the extra mile to ensure you enjoy your stay. He let us stay as long as we wanted on the day of our checking out. Very comfortable bed and very quiet. We would definitely book again if we ever go back to NewYork - which I hope we do as it is lovely!
reviews[69].comments: Ok guys, we literally cannot rave about this place, and Olan, enough. We’ll start with the loft - the space is super cute, trendy, and spotless. The location is AMAZING! So close to everything, all the trendy neighbourhoods, Greenwich, Chelsea and Soho to name a few, are walking distance away including all the fantastic places to eat around the place - too many for us to get through! The subway is at the corner and only one or two stops away from the big attractions. And now, Olan. Ah we love this guy. He made us feel so at home. So friendly and always went out of his way no matter what. Stayed up for us to welcome us when we arrived in 3 hours late, prepared us a home cooked breakfast the morning after we arrived (which was deliscious by the way), got up at 4am to see us off (who does that!?) and always had insider tips, tricks and recommendations for anything and everything if we ever needed some guidance. Honestly, we couldn’t ever thank him enough. We had the best time here. If you’re looking for a spot in NYC, this is it. You won’t regret it :)
reviews[70].comments: Olan is a very friendly and accommodating host. He made sure that the place meet my needs and pleasantly greeted me as I arrived and left throughout my stay. He made some helpful suggestions about things to do, places to eat, and even how to get to the airport.  He has some friendly pets which were very delightful. Overall, my time in NYC was greatly enhanced due to being at Olan's place.
reviews[71].comments: Olan was very kind and welcoming. He was so accommodating and made sure I had everything I needed and more.
reviews[72].comments:
Living with Olan was a unique experience that I really enjoyed. Olan is an
artist and film-maker who has lived in the area for many years. He's also really
friendly and a genuinely great host who cares about making sure you're
comfortable and properly taken care of. The location can't be beaten if you're
working at (Hidden by Airbnb) (it's a 30 second walk to the 8th ave entrance). There are
many amenities in the apartment, including a fridge and AC. The bed is really
comfortable, and Olan has a bunch of good pillows. The AC unit is quite good
and managed to keep the room cool even on the hottest summer days. The room
itself is really pretty and full of interesting art that makes it charming. Olan
also has two wonderful pets, Mr. Al (a Jack Russell / Corgi) and Tuxie (a cat).
Both are quite friendly and easy to get along with. The bathroom is also very
clean, and there's a shower and many soaps/shampoos to use. Olan lives in the
apartment, so you're staying at an actual home that has been properly taken care
of and has all of the amenities you would expect. This made living here feel
more like being Olan's roommate, which was a great part of the experience.

Overall I really enjoyed my stay with Olan and strongly recommend his apartment
to anyone staying in New York.
reviews[73].comments: Olan is amazing!
reviews[74].comments:
Im not sure which was better, Olan (Mr Al and Tuxe) or the location!! 

The location is just perfect-right by Chelsea market, lots of places to shop/eat, subway station on the street - perfect location!!

Now Olan... an incredibly kind hearted, thoughtful host. When I wasn't well he got ready to go out and get me ginger and lemon. He had my fridge stocked with things he knew I would like and made me the best guacamole I've ever had! He knows when to engage and when to let you have your space - and is truly wanting his guests to have the best best possible time during their stay.

I very much hope to see him in London or New York again soon :)

Nam
reviews[75].comments: Olan is a very kind, educated, sensitive and caring person. From the first moment he gets the needs of his guests and make them feel at home. The location is amazing (50 mt from subway) and - if like to walk - in 15/30 minutes you can reach time square or Soho. I would choose again his place and - considering the overall experience - I would say that the price is very fair. And, last but not least, his pets give a touch of extra coziness to the place. Thank you, Olan for everything

reviews[0].comments: Great stay.  Laura is an excellent host.  Check-in was very smooth, and the apartment was lovely.
reviews[1].comments: Nice and central place to stay. Very nice hosts
reviews[2].comments: Me and my friend stayed here 11days. It was great! Hosts were very kind and especially cat was really cute! He was really friendly. The location was nice you can go anywhere within 15mins by subway! It was awesome:)
reviews[3].comments: Lilly and Laura has an incredible apartment located very close to China Town and Little Italy. The room is quite small, but really cozy and pleasant. Lilly was really thoughtful and helpful, I wish we could stay with her for longer!
reviews[4].comments: Great location, perfect for exploring the city. Lilly was an awesome host
reviews[5].comments: Nice neirhborood. The location is really good, next to Subway, restaurant, bars. Its on the 4th floor (there is no elevator so if you have a heavy luggage like me its a trouble). Room little, there is no place for 2 big luggage. Noisy but I had earplug, good bedding so I sleep really well.
reviews[6].comments: This was a great apartment and Lilly was a wonderful host. The location is fantastic, and the apartment is cozy. It was a bit noisy at night but that is to be expected in that neighborhood and in Manhattan in general.
reviews[7].comments: Great host very friendly the place it's in great location I well recommend for travelers
reviews[8].comments: Lots of amazing things to eat, drink and do close by. You can hear New York buzzing around you at night, which is a good thing if you, like me, sleep heavily and enjoy waking up in new places. If however you are a light sleeper bring the earplugs.
reviews[9].comments: This place was perfectly centered around some really cool parts of NYC. Lively atmosphere, though it can keep a bit loud on a Saturday night. Laura was a great hostess and I really appreciated my time here
reviews[10].comments: Great experience. The neighborhood is unbeatable and the price is reasonable. Close to many great bars, Chinatown, canal st, and the subway stop is right outside the door. The building and unit are humble. Fourth floor with no elevator, which can be an inconvenience if you have a lot of luggage, but it was fine for me. It's probably a good idea of what the average person would be able to afford in Manhattan unless you're an investment banker. I never actually ran into the host, but the key handoff was smooth from a local business just downstairs. I would stay there again.
reviews[11].comments: Great position, great host ! A little noisy due to the traffic but if you are tired of your walking day, it will be good ;)\n
reviews[12].comments: Very good
reviews[13].comments: We really enjoyed our stay here, amazing location - you can't beat it!
reviews[14].comments: I arrived pretty late at night at Lily's place but she was so welcoming and helped carrying my luggages. I was very touched :) Such a cute and cozy place, perfect for a quick getaway trip!
reviews[15].comments: Lilly's apartment is perfect for a trip in New York. It is closed to some subways and to a lot of places where you can eat and drink everything you want. It is a bit of noisy because of the traffic but if you are tired you will sleep very well. Lilly is a great host: she answers to all your questions, she is nice and available with the check in! Recommended!
reviews[16].comments: This room, albeit small, is perfect for any individual or couple who isn't planning on spending that much time in room anyway. When we were around, this place was within a walkable distance to many different types of eateries and bars. Would recommend!
reviews[17].comments: Laura was a very sweet host who kindly accommodated a late check out. I am very thankful! The place is a 4th floor walk up next to Little Italy and Chinatown. It was pretty noisy at night but the apartment itself was fine for a few nights stay.
reviews[18].comments: Buen acceso al transporte público, llegas donde quieras rápido. Para las personas que no les gusta dormir con mucho ruido, este no es el lugar recomendado :(. Pero por lo demás el alojamiento estaba muy bueno.
reviews[19].comments: We loved our stay at Lilly's place, it is a really cozy apartment. We would gladly stay here again if we come back to NYC. Lilly was so kind and sweet, she offered to help us if we needed anything. She even left a NYC guide and a subway map for us to use, and when we woke up the first morning after a very long trip, she had left us some snacks with a note on the table. Great host! You feel like at home at Lilly's place.
reviews[20].comments: Nice room with good bed and AC. Lilly is great, very responsive and helpful. The bathroom/shower is a bit cramped, but otherwise ok.
reviews[21].comments: Great location. Very small, so good for if you plan to be out and about all day. Lilly is very nice!
reviews[22].comments: This is a great and homey place to stay at. It is in the middle of Little Italy and Chinatown, also close to many public transportation locations. Lilly is super nice and accommodating! It's a great place to stay when you're basically out and about throughout the day. Very cozy place! \n\nMr. Glee (their cat) is also very welcoming too!
reviews[23].comments: The location is great.
reviews[24].comments: Great location and easy check in/out. Would definitely stay here again.
reviews[25].comments: I had a great stay at this apartment! The location is fantastic and is very close to multiple public transportation options. The room is small, but is great option for a single traveler or a couple that doesn't mind coziness. I would definitely stay here again.
reviews[26].comments: Lilly was a great host. Check-in was smooth.\nHer place is close to public transit and restaurants. Very convenient location.\nHighly recommended!
reviews[27].comments: Staying at Lilly's was great! Place was exactly as described and location very convenient. Check in/out was super easy. Highly recommend!
reviews[28].comments:
Thank you Lilly. We had an awesome time in NY thanks to the fact that your apartment was so close to everything!! 
We were glad to meet you and be able to talk to you a little. :)
The room was perfect and extremely clean. Great surprise! I've never had an airbnb for a couple days like this so clean and welcoming. 
Thanks again !!
reviews[29].comments: I had this kind of crazy 36 hours in NYC, but Laura's place made it feel really convenient and comfortable. Thanks to the great location I had so much more time to see and do things than I really expected that I left overjoyed. The place is really clean and nice. The communication with Laura is easy and you'll get all the information you could hope for. I'd recommend her any time!
reviews[30].comments: Lilly´s place is as advertised. The room is not big and the area is quite noisy but its clean,neat and cosy and a excellent base to explore New York for a few days. Its probably best suited for single travellers but for a short stay also for two persons. The communication with Lilly was very good, key pick-up was well organized .
reviews[31].comments: Great host and location. Would stay again!
reviews[32].comments: Nice little place. The main problem is the street noise. It's way too high for what we are accustom too.  Needed ear plug for the first time in order to go to sleep. Lilly/Host is very nice and made our stay as comfortable as possible.
reviews[33].comments:
The stay at Laura/Lilly's was fantastic. Although we never got to meet, she made sure our comfort needs were taken care of. From the bed, to the temperature to the little things, all was well. 
Ladies and gentlemen, its New York. Get ready for cozy small house living. It's really all you need, and will get. 
Luckily, you're right next to the subway, close to Little Italy and Chinatown, access to a lot of restaurants, and of course safe. 
Enjoy your stay with a great host!
P.S. The cat is a beast. He has a little cute budah-belly
reviews[34].comments: nice place to stay
reviews[35].comments: I had a great Stay in her Flat. The Location at Bowery is perfect to discover New York.
reviews[36].comments: My NYC weekend stay at Lilly's was a good one. My friends and I decided to meet up and spend the weekend together. Excellent location and, aside from the traffic noise at night, an enjoyable, tranquil space. The bedroom is quite small and the bed fine, but why stay indoors when you are visiting any city? Estuvo bien y agradable.
reviews[37].comments: We had already read about the noise of the traffic, but it was worse than we had expected. Even with earplugs. But the disgusting surprise came when we opened the bed. The sheets weren't fresh. There were a lot of human hairs, wavy, some long but another not so long. And there was also a big oily spot in the middle of the bottom sheet. I was disgusting. But I suppose she don't care at all because she already has the money. And the toilet seat was grubby. At least the bedroom was good heated and the best thing about the apartment is Mr. Green. La tapa del váter estaba mugrienta, si le pasabas un papel, éste salía negro. Al menos hacía calor en la habitación y el gato era extremandamente cariñoso, lo único bueno del piso.
reviews[38].comments: Great place! Great host!
reviews[39].comments: Lily was very hospitable and the place was very comfy to stay in, would definitely book again in the future
reviews[40].comments: Lilly is a great host. She's always making sure that we were comfortable with our living space. She's really willing to help us out and made sure we had a great time in New York. Her cat is also awesome and super friendly. Location is great; there's two subway stations within a 3-5 minute walk that can get you to almost anywhere in Manhattan. I would definitely stay here again.
reviews[41].comments: Thank you for the hospitality Lily. I really enjoyed staying at your place.
reviews[42].comments: Le logement correspond exactement a la description, emplacement super pour découvrir la ville, c est en effet bruyant car tres vivant! \nLilly est tres sympathique et l appartement petit mais cosy!
reviews[43].comments: All was perfect and the welcoming warm
reviews[44].comments: Great location, very kind host. It is a small space, but has every thing you need
reviews[45].comments: Very nice stay. Lily is a great host and the place is just as advertised. It does get a bit loud at night (honking on the street) but ear plugs are thoughtfully provided.
reviews[46].comments: I needed a place to crash during a weekend trip to New York, and that's what Lilly's apartment provided. The place is definitely cozy, but has everything you need to recharge after a day exploring the city. The bed was comfortable, the room had plenty of storage for clothes and other items, and her cat was really friendly!
