reviews[1].comments:
I had the pleasure of staying at Eli's airbnb for five days for a conference in New York. Here are my comments below on the apartment and the host. 

The apartment: The apartment was located at a very convenient location, close to groceries and transit. The first thing I noticed about the apartment was how accurate the pictures were. When booking online airbnbs, there can sometimes be a discrepancy between what is advertised and what apartment you walk into. However, Eli's apartment was absolutely true to the quality of the pictures; simply spacious, clean and beautiful. While I stayed at the apartment for less than a week, the place was also equipped with almost everything I could think of. The apartment had various kitchen utensils, first aid kit, fresh towels, and an iron to iron your clothes. 

The host: Eli was very attentive and communicative both before and during my stay. He contacted me in advance to confirm when my flight would land. When my flight was delayed, he checked in with me to make sure that I was okay. I felt that he was a caring host, and a well-mannered person in general.
reviews[2].comments: While, the location and the place was overall good we did have communication issues. We got there the fist night and we're disappointed to see that the tv was not working. We asked for assistance that fist night as well as the next night and no assistance was given. It did not ruin our trip but it was unfortunate.
reviews[3].comments: Eli was a very attentive host. The apartment is beautiful! There are parking garages for rent walking distance from the apartment. Loved the location made for a fun, stress free stay!
reviews[4].comments: Awesome apartment in an awesome location! So much better than a hotel! Loved it!
reviews[5].comments: Eli's place is exactly as it appears in the ad. The location is really great, super close to grand central, pretty quiet for Manhattan, and comfortable. We have used airbnb a lot, and have come to expect things to run smoothly, and they did. Eli was easy to communicate with, she was prompt and always easy to get a hold of when we needed something. She checked in with us half way through just to be sure things were good. And she was willing to fix anything if asked. Airbnb lists the location of the apartment incorrectly, making check in a little confusing, and for some reason I did not get Eli's messages with specific info on how to get in (although I am sure she sent them, my email is sometimes tricky that way). The tv wasn't working, but we never needed or wanted it. Eli offered to have it fixed while we were at the apartment, but we declined. But you might want to check with her ahead of time if tv is important to your stay. The beds were more like doubles than queen sized beds, but the apartment was airy and the bedding was comfortable.

Purtroppo la mia esperienza, rispetto a moltre altre, non è stata positiva.
Arrivati all'alloggio prenotato (accesso sia allo stabile che all'appartamento con codice) non ci è stato possibile accedere allo stesso in quanto risultava già occupato. Prima che si riuscisse a rintracciare l'host e questa rintracciasse gli occupanti perchè si trasferissero ad altro appartamento è passata più di un'ora e capite bene che, dopo 9 ore di volo, il trasferimento dall'areoporto, il fuso orario, la stanchezza, avremmo preferito evitare anche questa seccatura. Oltretutto abbiamo avuto a disposizione un appartamento che, da occupato, non poteva considerarsi pulito e senza considerare che i precedenti occupanti, persone sulle quali non abbiamo dubbi sulla loro integrità, erano comunque in possesso del codice per entrare in quello che era il nostro appartamento. Ci aspettavamo anche la presenza fisica dell'host che, per correttezza, avrebbe dovuto darci migliori spiegazioni sull'accaduto, scusandosi, cosa che non è avvenuta. If you are a small family with young kids or a group of friends, looking for a great place to stay while discovering New York City, look no further! 

We (my wife, our adult son and I) just made the long journey from Australia to stay in NYC for a month and immerse ourselves in all the wonderful things this amazing city has to offer. 
   
We arrived at Eli’s place late at night, after 24+ hours on the way and knowing this, Eli had prepared the place so we could just get right in to bed. The place was immaculately clean, coz and warm, not just within the huge studio but also the public areas are always sparkling, smell good and warm. 

The next day, we were ready to set out and only then realised how perfect the position is. This part of Midtown East has great amenities literally on your doorstep. Great pizza, fresh salad bar, the most delicious bakery (where most days everything’s $2), fresh fruit, veggies and groceries and wonderful espresso coffee literally across the way. Also, a fantastic laundry across the road and my wife loved the hairdresser two short blocks away and the nail bars and beauticians in abundance on Second.

Grand Central Station is an easy 10 minute walk away and Broadway, Times Square, the museums, galleries, shops and restaurants a pleasant 20 minute stroll. Everything is literally a short walk or subway ride away. 

We will be back to NYC and would book Eli’s place again without a moment’s hesitation!

name: Room w/pvt bathroom on Central Park
summary: A beautiful guest bedroom with private black marble bathroom in my renovated 3BR apartment on the Upper West Side of Manhattan; right on Central Park West in a classic turn-of-the century (pre-war) building, right near subway, buses, museums & more!
space: Hello! I have a dedicated, beautiful guest bedroom with a private black marble bathroom, in my apartment in Manhattan on the Upper West Side. This classic New York building is turn-of-the century (pre-war / c. 1912), on the corner of Central Park West and 100th street... across the street is Central Park! It was renovated before I moved in (2004) and just had it re-painted in early July 2018.  The apartment is conveniently located near subway and buses... within walking distance to over a dozen museums, and you can get almost anywhere in Manhattan within 20-40 minutes, door-to door! * Since the question comes up a lot, I am only renting this bedroom, not the entire apartment (I live in 3rd bedroom!). If you need another room, I rent out the other room in this apartment, please check out my other listing. Also, please do not rent the room because of the piano... this is not a practice studio or a concert instrument. Guests may use the piano occasionally but its not for hours of practice

neighborhood_overview: The Upper West Side is a residential area of Manhattan next to Central Park. Its wonderful to be in Manhattan but not directly in the heart of the hustle n bustle of midtown (though you can be there in about 20 min!)
notes: This is an older building so it has quirks that older buildings tend to have. Its charming an beautiful, but its not a modern building with all the amenities! Also this is a 4th floor walkup, no elevator. Any questions please ask :-)
transit: Subway and busses are just a couple blocks away on 96th St. Can get anywhere in the city in about 20-40 min by public transportation. For people unfamiliar with the subway and bus system I recommend using (SENSITIVE CONTENTS HIDDEN) Maps to get detailed travel directions. Also if you are here for more then a few days, get a weekly metro card for unlimited rides!
access: Guests have access to the room they rent, and the living room/kitchen.
interaction: I work from home, so I am in my room a lot during the daytime, and often out in the evenings. I try to be home during guest checkins, but sometimes is not possible. Lets be in contact a day or two before you travel to arrange for checkin time. If not home, I can easily leave the keys in a lockbox outside the building door.
house_rules: No Smoking or drugs. Food and booze in apartment belongs to myself and roommates, but you are more then welcome to bring your own.  Considerate, clean and quiet guests only... no party animals please :-) Please do not eat in the bedroom or leave food open. Food must be put away into the cabinets or fridge... this is still NYC, and we don't want an "unwelcome guests"! Please be aware that this building is a 4th floor walk up.  If you were to need any assistance with your luggage just let me know I'll be glad to help.  Please do not rent the room because of the piano... this is not a practice studio or a concert instrument. Guests may use the piano occasionally but its not for hours of practice a day. No events, parties, or photoshoots allowed.  The apartment is in a pre-war (old early 1900's) building. It has some quirks, but the apartment itself is newly renovated. I will do whatever I can to accommodate any reasonable guest requests. Any questions - please feel free to ask!

reviews[12].comments: Meme si nous ne nous sommes pas rencontrés, tout a été très simple pour trouver l'appart, recuperer les clés et communiquer avec Patrick. L'appart est idéalement situé. Nous vous le conseillons.\r\nCharlene
reviews[13].comments: Although I didn't actually get to meet Patrick, he was very responsive and conscientious in his communications.  Very nice apartment - spacious with zero clutter. reviews[14].comments: Unfortunately, staying at Patrick's apartment was a total nightmare, unlike everybody else's review. Although I am definitely not a clean freak, his place was not clean by our basic standard. It was even a health hazard. READ ON... TO THE END!!! The toilet in the room with private bathroom was flushing when it felt like it (50% of the time). We were advised by Patrick to use the other toilet, which was also flushing half the time! A plumber was called only days later. There was a huge hole in the ceiling above the bathtub in the room. I was afraid of what would fall from it while showering. The walls, door knobs and fixtures in the bedroom (and everywhere) were very dirty. After being advised by airbnb to talk with Patrick about cleanliness, he said this was not a hotel! But, Patrick did somehow clean the room a bit after telling us only if we were out of the apartment! The stove was not functioning very well. He told us about the stove right away after we arrived, but did nothing about fixing it until 2 or 3 days later. Cooking on the stove was out. We were in NY during a heat wave, and because the air conditioning machines were on at the same time, the power went out for a while, so we were in the dark! The second night we were there, we saw mice in the kitchen and lots of unsafe droppings. Patrick replied to my messages after a while and came home to clean. That is when he told us he had caught a mouse in his kitchen a few days prior to our arrival!!! He did call the exterminator, but we did not feel like eating there anymore, or continue to stay there for that matter. We were on edge the entire time because we had no other place to stay. We wasted 4 days looking for another place to stay, and of course, all the other places we had in mind were no longer available! Plus, the first night we arrived in the building, we saw cockroaches in the stairway. I asked Patrick right away about cockroaches and he told us there were none in his apartment, but ... we did see them in the living room but he denied it being a cockroach. We saw another one in the room we rented, we caught in on camera. We left right away. Airbnb was responsive, thank you. We provided them with all the pictures and videos to prove all these. The other concerns I have is with the location of his apartment. Despite what he told me, it is NOT a safe area for a woman, nor for teenager (my son was with me). We were afraid to walk after dark. Even during the day, the area is quite sketchy! Patrick, although I am sure you are a nice person, we are unable to recommend your apartment to anyone.0 star...

reviews[123].comments: Patrick made us feel very welcome and was very helpful providing advice on getting to places. Apartment was very close to subway which made navigating NYC easy.
reviews[124].comments: As a first time Airbnb user, Patrick was a fantastic first experience. The room was great; private bathroom attached to the room, towels and other basics provided. He gave us the space we wanted so we could come and go as we pleased. The apartment itself was very nice, not too big or small. Enough space to not feel like you have to be quiet or disturb anyone. Patrick was very helpful in providing us with an app to help us navigate the city. Also, he was very accommodating to our schedule allowing us to check-in early.
reviews[125].comments:
Patrick's flat was perfect place  for our visit.  He was very wonderful host. His place is just as described and is in a nice neighborhood ,very closely to the central park . It was clean and spacious enough for the two of us in the (Website hidden by Airbnb) bathroom was a very comfortable and private. The Patrick's recommendations about the city was a interesting , and gave a wonderful complement  our itinerary.

 I would highly recommend staying with him and will definitely do so if I go back to NYC.
reviews[126].comments: Patrick was very nice and always available to give infortmation and tips for NYC. The apartment is 2 blocks far from a subway station, so it is very useful. On the other side the room is cold and dusty and the bathroom has a leak in the ceiling, above the bath tub.
reviews[127].comments: My fiance and I had such a great experience. Patrick was very welcoming and sweet. I appreciated how helpful he was whenever we had any questions about the city. The recommendations given to us were awesome. The room was quaint and clean. My favourite part was that it comes with its own bathroom. We will definitely be staying here when we come back to NY!
reviews[128].comments: The listing was accurate as the pictures showed.\r\nPros: Good, clean, cozy apartment. Many restaurants nearby. Friendly host.\r\nCons: The lighting was dim, the bed creaked a lot and the shower faucet was difficult to control.
reviews[129].comments: I had a very quick stay, but the room was comfortable and Patrick was very welcoming and accommodating. It was great having a private bathroom, though a pipe burst in the building so I never got to use the shower. The location is super convenient. All around, a nice oasis in the city.
reviews[130].comments: It's a very nice clean room with a bathroom, and I spent a happy weekend there with my friend:)
reviews[131].comments: Patrick was a great host. He is responsive, courteous and pleasant. His place is as described.
reviews[132].comments:
Everything was as promised- the bed was especially comfortable and despite our weekend stay in this busy neighborhood/building, the nights were quiet and restful.
Patrick made getting into the apartment easy, we felt free to come and go and had plenty of private space.
Loved the little bathroom that was ours alone.
Patrick makes great suggestions for nearby food ( we enjoyed Tom's Restaurant) and the subway is crazy close for exploring the rest of the city.
reviews[133].comments:
très bon accueil, chambre et SDB  propre, bon couchage et appartement calme, (nous avons dormis comme des bébés ;-)
confort simple
merci Patrick pour votre accueil, il a fortement contribué à l'excellent séjour que nous avons passé à NY
reviews[134].comments: We stayed with Patrick for three nights.  The description is accurate, but it cannot describe what a gracious host he is.  He was available when questions needed answering or recommendations needed and was quick to respond to guests' requests.  This is in addition to being  a talented composer working from home. Great uptown location that we would visit again while in NYC.
reviews[135].comments:
Patrick fue un buen anfitrión. Nos sentimos cómodos en el departamento, con la libertad de ir y volver cuando queríamos.
El departamento cuenta con buena calefacción, los vecinos son tranquilos y queda a dos cuadras del metro.
Los espacios del departamento son un poco más pequeños de lo que parecen en las fotos. El WiFi no funcionó bien durante la estadía, trataron de arreglarlo pero de igual manera la velocidad, algunos días, sólo sirvió para chatear.
El día que nos íbamos Patrick nos permitió dejar nuestras maletas en el living para volver a buscarlas más tarde de la hora del check out
reviews[136].comments:
Hello Patrick,
Thanks again for your welcome. We loved your house. It was great to be close to central Park where we took all our breakfast. It was a quiet place with very good situation.
Our trip was wonderful!
We will come back and for sure we will try to rent your home again.

See you soon ! 
Florie & Oliver
reviews[137].comments: Listing was completely accurate, apartment terrifc. Clean, attractive and easy to find. Due to our getting there late, did not meet Patrick in person, but he was very clear about how to get in, and supplied the information immediately when we needed it.
reviews[138].comments: Patrick was great!  The apartment was quiet and right on Central Park.  The subway was close by and I felt safe getting back during the day or evening.
reviews[139].comments:
We are seasoned travellers and stayed in the room with a bathroom for 8 nights. The best thing about the apartment was its location  - just across the road from Central Park and close to the subway.
Our host was not able to meet us in person but made arrangements  for us to collect the key to the apartment and let ourselves in and find our own room. Our room was smaller than what we had expected from the photos and info provided. The bathroom was small but well appointed except for a loose toilet seat.
We did not meet our host face to face until day 3 of our stay but had emailed him on 
arrival to say we had got in but also to ask if he could exchange flanalette sheets with cotton because of the heat (in spite of the air conditioner). We also  informed him that there had been no room in the fridge for us to put our provisions and that I had moved things from a shelf to make (Website hidden by Airbnb) received an email response that evening telling us that this was an old building, we needed to lower our expectations and have due regard for the needs of other guests who had left provisions. At this point we were the only ones in the apartment and were unaware that there were other guests at this time.
 The sheets issue was never addressed but we met the other guests the next morning and introduced ourselves. We were surprised that there were no locks on the doors of the rented rooms.
We would describe this as more of a share house arrangement rather than hosted accommodation and this was disappointing.
reviews[140].comments: Just returned from an 8 day stay at Patrick's and had the most amazing time! Location was great as it was close to a number of subway lines and the apartment itself was exactly like in the photos. Patrick was always really helpful with recommendations and advice on where's good to go. I was a bit hesitant at first as I've never done Air BnB before however would definitely stay again and recommend strongly to others to check it out!
reviews[141].comments: Patrick oli erittäin ystävällinen ja aina valmis auttamaan ja tarjoamaan apuaan, jos oli jotain kysyttävää. Huone vastasi sitä, mitä kuvaus ja valokuvat lupasivat. Sijainti oli erittäin hyvä. Liikkuminen julkisilla kulkuvälineillä oli helppoa ja sujuvaa. Kaikin puolin positiivinen kokemus.
reviews[142].comments: Patrick is kind and available. The space is nice.\r\n
reviews[143].comments: Patrick's place on Central Park is nice and tidy, and located in one of the most beautiful and tranquil parts of the city. You will definitely get some good exercise climbing the stairs each day and have a quiet place to unwind. We did not have a chance to meet Patrick, but he was very communicative before and throughout our stay. Thanks, Patrick!
reviews[144].comments: This apartment is in an excellent spot near the subway and Central Park yet relatively quiet. The bedroom is small but adequate, and the private bathroom makes sharing the quarters very comfortable. The kitchen and fridge space are well-organized. The piano was a bonus for my teenaged daughter, who enjoys playing. Patrick was away during our visit. Others came and went, but were quiet and neat. All in all, a fine place to stay in NYC on a budget.
reviews[145].comments:
Patrick was a very hospitable and helpful host, and more than happy to recommend places to eat and visit. The apartment was in a great location, in a safe neighbourhood just a few blocks from 96th St metro (for those new to NY make sure you get the local stopping train to get off for Patrick's, otherwise you'll end up at 125th - we found out the hard way!). The Whole Foods round the block was great for grabbing food to/from downtown!

The room itself was clean and a welcome respite after a long days exploring. The air con in the room made a big difference,p particularly at night.

Overall, a really great experience and we definitely hope to return.

Thanks Patrick!
reviews[146].comments: Patrick war sehr gastfreundlich und hat uns Tipps gegeben, wo man frische Bio Lebensmittel bekommt. Im Kühlschrank hatten wir einen Platz für unsere Lebensmittel. Die gesamte Wohnung war sauber und ordentlich gehalten. Das Zimmer mit angrenzendem Bad ist zwar klein aber zum Schlafen total ausreichend. Es war alles da was man braucht. Es gibt noch ein weiteres Zimmer in dem auch Gäste untergebracht waren. Patrick haben wir nur zwei mal kurz angetroffen und die anderen Gäste haben wir gar nicht gesehen oder gehört.
reviews[147].comments: Patrick was great from the moment I first contacted him about the listing. He was very kind and quick to reply to messages. He helped us figure out the best route to the apartment, gave us great recommendations for restaurants in the area and things to do. The apartment itself was lovely, the room and bed were very comfortable and clean, Wifi worked well, and we had everything we needed at hand. The location was excellent, a few blocks from the subway and numerous shops and restaurants. Overall, our experience was excellent and Patrick is an excellent host.
reviews[148].comments: Great location close to metro and nice organic supermarket. Patrick was very helpful upon our arrival and helped out with metro, where to buy groceries etc. We would love to stay there again.
reviews[149].comments: Great location and apartment, very clean and spacious. Patrick was clear and accommodating! Would stay here again next trip!
reviews[150].comments: Wir haben Patrick, da er auf einer Geschäftsreise war nicht persönlich getroffen. Er hat sich aber per Mail oft gemeldet und gefragt ob alles gut bei uns ist. Das zweite Zimmer war auch vermietet, aber wir haben nur Spät am Abend die anderen Gäste mal gehört, gesehen eigentlich nie. Man ist eh den ganzen Tag unterwegs. Das Zimmer mit dem Bad on Suite ist zwar klein aber ausreichhend. Ok für mich mit 1,98m war das Bett zu kurz, aber gibt schlimmeres. Die Lage ist Top, zum Einkaufen geht man zwar 10 Minuten aber gegenüber ist direkt der Central Park und die U Bahn Station.
reviews[151].comments: We absolutely LOVED staying in Patrick's place! Not only is Patrick's listing and description accurate, but he is a super host who made us feel totally at ease. He was incredibly kind to accommodate our earlier-than-planned arrival and made it easy to come and go as we needed. This room is a total gem and the ensuite bathroom is the cherry on the top. The only problem was that we had a flight back home and could not stay longer! Thanks for a great stay, Patrick!
reviews[152].comments: I really enjoyed Patrick's place. It was a great location in a really nice space. The room and bathroom were clean, and being right next to Central Park was great. Patrick was easy to communicate with, and considering our shared musical background it's too bad we didn't get to talk more. However I would certainly stay there again if I could.
reviews[153].comments:
Patrick me recibió en un espacio tal cual lo describe, es una excelente locación. La habitación es confortable, la cama es cómoda y hay espacio de guardado. Cómo nota sumo que la puerta de la habitación debería tener llave puesto que uno de los otros huéspedes entró a mi habitación por accidente y fue muy incómodo. El barrio es muy tranquilo y tiene supermercados y starbucks a muy corta distancia. A 2 cuadras está el metro y pasan varias líneas de bus. 
Definitivamente volvería a quedarme en su casa.

Gracias Patrick! Thanks a lot Patrick!
reviews[154].comments: Had a great stay! Clean place and a friendly host in a great location!
reviews[155].comments: Alojamiento muy acogedor, espacioso, bien ubicado y en un lugar tranquilo de la ciudad. \r\nNos sentimos muy cómodos y bien atendidos por Patrick.
reviews[156].comments:
Excellent stay: No surprises. Patrick’s description of the accommodations is complete and accurate and he is a responsive and accommodating host.  

Location: Convenient to public transit and an Avis mid-town location.  Lovely 15-min walk across Central Park to Mt. Sinai, which was the reason for our visit.

Accommodation: The space was very clean and the bedroom provides ample and efficient storage for clothes and outlets for recharging devices.  The bed is comfortable and the room is really well noise-insulated allowing for a great night’s sleep.  The private shower/tub is very nice and an assortment of personal care products are provided.

Temperature Note:  I especially appreciated the window fan and aircon unit.  I found the space warm even in early November, which was likely a combination of me being post menopause and also an older building / 4th floor.  The window unit kept me very comfortable, but from an energy conservation perspective I felt guilty and in hindsight would have packed shorts and t-shirt.

Host:  Patrick was very responsive and accommodating.

Great stay – recommend with no hesitations.
reviews[157].comments: Patrick's apartment was exactly as described and impeccably clean. Private bath is in the bedroom which gave us complete privacy.  Patrick was very accommodating and a perfect host.
reviews[159].comments: 快適に過ごすことができました｡築100年を超えたｱﾊﾟｰﾄですが､十分綺麗だと思います｡家主のPatrickもいい人でした｡
reviews[160].comments:
This was my first time staying in someone's home--usually we take a whole apartment.  Patrick was a great host.  He made me feel welcome and seems sincerely interested in people. This was a solo trip for me, and my ensuite room was perfect in every way--clean, quiet, with a bed, chair, night table, open shelving and clothes rod.  Great location in an interesting neighborhood.  3-min walk to the subway.

Patrick is great about access, too--he is on,top of communication and arranging initial entry, and lets guests leave luggage if their flight is well after check-out.

The room was tee-shirt warm for my visit.  Bring a personal reading light if you read in bed.  As mentioned in the listing, there may be other guests staying in Patrick's other room.
reviews[161].comments:
The neighborhood was great! There were many shops and restaurants nearby.  For groceries, there was a Whole Foods as well as a locally owned natural foods store. There was a Wash and Fold on our block, and a laundromat about a 10 minute walk away. It was really nice to be directly next to Central Park, and we didn't have any trouble with transportation or getting around.

The apartment was as described, and had an urban, Spartan feel. As a musician who booked this apartment primarily because it has a piano, I was disappointed at the very limited availability of time due to Patrick working from home most days, as well as his concern about disturbing the neighbors. The piano was also not in great shape, and had problems with sticking dampers.

Patrick was cultured and metropolitan, accommodating when we requested extra towels and a later check out time, and was available when we needed anything. We enjoyed our time staying here. Thank you, Patrick!
reviews[162].comments: Patrick ist ein wirklich netter und gelassener junger Mann. Wir haben uns  wie daheim gefühlt. Das Zimmer ist wie beschrieben, geräumig und perfekt für einen Städtetrip. Die einzigen Mängel sind, dass es keinen Aufzug gibt und das Apartment im 4. Stock liegt. Das Bett war nicht ganz so bequem, aber das ist meckern auf hohem Niveau!! Patrick hat auch eine Liste mit Empfehlungen für New York und die Gegend da gelassen, was uns schon zu dem einen oder anderen netten Restaurant geführt hat. Auch so war er immer ansprechbar. Rundum hatten wir einen tollen Aufenthalt und sind sehr zufrieden.
reviews[163].comments: The apartment is located right next to Central Park and about a 3 min walk to the closest subway. Patrick was flexible with our check in, which helped us settle down quickly and he was also very helpful throughout our stay.
reviews[164].comments: Très bon séjour chez Patrick, le logement correspond exactement aux photos, il est bien desservi par le métro, 5 minutes à pieds de la bouche de métro. Nous avons pu en une semaine, parcourir New York.
reviews[165].comments: Great location, easy to access Central Park. Close to whole foods for quick meals on the go... Close to subway to get you into the city. Nice and clean apartment
reviews[166].comments:
The place is just as shown on the site. No surprises. The room is quite wide with plenty of space to unpack and make oneself comfortable. The bathroom seems new (or at least is very well kept). The place was pretty clean and very neat. Super cozy and warm during cold days.
The area is very nice to walk around, there are some shops nearby and is really close to subways access.
Although Patrick had some inconvenience on the last minute and couldn't be there for our arrival he was very willing to help us and solve any trouble that came up quickly.
reviews[167].comments: Appartement très bien situé avec toutes les commodités et transports publics à proximité. Cependant, la propreté est très limite et Patrick a été arrangeant pour l'entrée dans les lieux mais a tout de même failli nous oublier (communication seulement par mail, nous ne l'avons pas vu), le prix reste néanmoins très intéressant pour un séjour à New York, les photos sont fidèles à la réalité.
reviews[168].comments:
Patrick's apartment on W 100th street was fabulous! His directions for getting into and up into the apartment were flawless and his apartment is impeccable. Very clean, comfortable, and inviting. We stayed in the room with a private bathroom which was just lovely! We only saw Patrick once during our stay because of our busy schedules but when we met him, he was friendly and nice to chat with before we left for the day. We had clean towels and sheets and plenty of blankets. The shelves in the room were nice for unpacking! 

The location of the apartment was stellar. Close to coffee shops, drug stores, and supermarkets. Very convenient to the subway and Central Park is right at your doorstep.

Overall, I give this place a 10/10! We will definitely recommend Patrick's apartment and probably book again in the future! It was perfection.
reviews[169].comments: Patrick was an amazing host. We arrived in New York before the check in time and he let us drop off are bags witch was very nice of him. The apartment is really nice and clean. The location is really good pretty close to everything and right in front of Central Park. Would highly recommend staying here!!!!
reviews[170].comments: Patrick was very welcoming and provided a helpful guide to the apartment and points of interest in New York that the normal tourist may not have known about. Just a short walk to the subway to get you anywhere you need to be. Or if you are feeling active taking a stroll through Central Park is just as enjoyable right across the road. The kitchen and private bathroom made our stay that much more comfortable. Would definitely recommend this apartment to people searching for a quiet location that isn't to far away from the rush of the city.
reviews[171].comments: Great place! This place is the perfect quiet apartment from a long day exploring the city.
reviews[172].comments: Sehr günstig gelegen, ruhig (Hinterhof). Steile Treppe zum 4. Stockwerk. Nicht gepflegte Einrichtung. Nur kleiner Esstisch für 2 Personen. Zimmer und Bad eng.
reviews[173].comments: We stayed with Patrick for 2 days and overall it was a good stay. Check-in was very easy and he provided us with a list of close restaurants that delivered as well as invited us to an event he was putting on at a local club. The decor was very nice with hardwood floors and many items related to the arts were on display. There was coffee and tea provided for the morning and the top shelf of the refrigerator was available for our leftovers. There is a market downstairs that we used to purchase water and alcohol that was convenient. Unfortunately, one of the chairs was broken in the main area making it difficult for us to both sit and eat our take-out. While the bathroom was clean, the shower pressure was low. There was also a decent amount of noise from the neighbors though the AC did a good job of drowning it out. The bed was comfortable. Our location was 4 blocks from the subway and across the street from Central Park. There were many restaurants within walking distance (10 minutes) including a French bakery with great pastries and fruit tarts. Overall it was a pleasant experience.
reviews[174].comments: Patrick was a great host; accommodating and helpful. His place has the cool vibe you'd expect from someone with his creative nature. We loved the location; across from Central Park, easy access to the subway, great coffee and a Whole Foods around the corner. Patrick made us feel welcome and did a great job of giving us our space while being available for conversation or ideas on the what, where and how of New York.
reviews[175].comments: Well-located apartment in a nice neighbourhood, close to shops, underground and Central Park. Confortable bed. The apartment and the whole building could be cleaner. As it is shared with other guests it can be noisy sometimes.
reviews[176].comments:
Great location across from the northern part of Central Park. It allowed us to explore over a week the entire park, plus part of Harlem and along 5th and Lexington Avenues. Lots of amenities nearby: small grocery store, convenience store, Starbucks, huge Whole Foods and its wine store. Columbus Ave. is a treat to walk along, with great delis.

Subway stop is two blocks down Central Park West. Zip to Times Square in 15 minutes. However, cabs are cheap and ubiquitous.

Patrick's place is quiet with a roomy common area. We had the room with private bathroom which was convenient. Plenty of space for staring some basic groceries. We didn't buy much but nice to have some breakfast before heading out for the day.

Patrick was good at communication, both in the time leading up to our trip and when we arrived in NYC. He sent a text with an explanation and photos on how to access the keys since he was out for the evening. Very efficient. Check out was a breeze.

Finally, this was a great area to stay because it was away from the craziness in Mid-town. It's also safe and very pretty with the park and architecture.
reviews[177].comments: awsone location, just next to the central park, and 2 minutes to subway.
reviews[178].comments: Communication was easy and Patrick responded quickly.  The apartment was close to the subway.  We enjoyed our stay.
reviews[179].comments: The best is the location, next to a subway station, Central Park, restaurants, supermarket. Patrick was very nice making us feel free to use the apartment and he also was very flexible with our check out. A wonderful stay in New York.\n
reviews[180].comments: The room at Patrick's place and neat and clean and check in was easy with his detailed instructions. However when I arrived the room was 90 degrees, the air conditioner had to be tinkered with to get it working, and the host did not respond to my inquiry about it until the following morning. Fortunately I got it working well enough to avoid a very sweaty night! I left the apartment early for work both mornings, so never ran into the host or other guests.
reviews[181].comments: Patrick is an incredibly welcoming host. The apartment is very homely and we felt at ease. Great location too. Thank you Patrick!
reviews[182].comments: Great location, right next to central park. Friendly host. Nice to have bathroom attached to the bedroom.
reviews[183].comments: Patrick's apartment is conveniently located to transport and beautiful Central Park. It is also very close to an excellent supermarket should you wish to eat fresh, healthy food.
reviews[184].comments: Great host. Flexible. Very close to the MTA B and C line! Comfortable room, attached bathroom is definitely and advantage.
reviews[185].comments: Our staying was very pleasant, and Patrick appears to be an excellent conversationalist. However, rusty fournitures in the bathroom and VERY dusty window frames took away some of the magic...
reviews[186].comments: My daughter and I had a great stay-- Patrick's place is charming and quiet, and it's easily accessible in a safe neighborhood. I'd definitely book with him again!
reviews[187].comments: Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt im Zimmer und in der Wohnküche. Die Lage am schönen Central Park hat uns gefallen. Die Metro ist auch nicht weit entfernt.
reviews[188].comments:
The place is walking distance to a subway and right across central park. The room is small and good for 2 people who does not really plan on staying much in the room. 

Also, just note that the apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator in case you have issues with climbing up and down the stairs especially with luggages.

Patrick is a good host and very responsive to messages and questions.
reviews[189].comments: This apartment was just as described...only 10 minutes on sub way to town....would definitely recommend  this place. ..just a note though. .this place would not be suited to older people as there is no lift and the apartment is on the 4th floor.....thanks patrick for sharing your home
reviews[190].comments: Patrick is a nice host, always ready to give information and help.The apartment has such a great location, we could jog in Central Park every morning. Also walk through the park to The MET. Nice stay in upside west.
reviews[191].comments: Patrick’s location was amazing. Very nice location, close to subway, just across CPW from the park. Patrick’s helpful tips of the city during checking were great and made out trip that much better! Very centrally located to all things we were interested in doing! Highly recommended.
reviews[192].comments: The photos look  better than the place in reality. The broken and rusted toilet seat cover, dust on the bedroom shelving, dirty microwave all reminded us of a college dorm. We would also expect a decent blanket that covers the entire bed for the price we paid. We ended up leaving early and found a nice hotel room for not much more per day.\nOther guests in the next room woke us up after we were asleep. Walls are thin! \nOn the plus side, the location next to Central Park and the subway, was convenient. Patrick seems like a nice guy. Check-in and pre arrival communication was thorough and timely.
reviews[193].comments: Patrick’s place is exactly as he describes it. This was our first time using Airbnb in NY and we were pleased. We used the kitchen for breakfast, and loved being right next to Central Park. Transportation was a bit tricky at night do to train maintenance, but during regular hours everything went great, we took the subway from JFK and had no trouble getting there. I would definitely recommend his place. By the way his place is in a third floor, we have no problem going up and down stairs, but it good to know.
reviews[194].comments: I lived on the UWS in college and right after and decades later still have relatives and friends in the neighborhood. It was great pretending to live there again. It is a GREAT location. Steps from the park, a block or two to coffee shops, a large Whole Foods, and near subway lines, loads of restaurants, shops and museums. Patrick is a great host -- responsive to our requests and questions and (drumroll!) he carried our suitcases up and down the 4 flights of stairs.  \n\nThe bedroom and (private) bathroom are small and dark. If you have a lot of stuff or expect to spend a lot of time in the apt, you should talk with him and find out if it works for you.
reviews[195].comments: The perfect location for central park and the subway. Loved meeting the other international guests that were also visiting NY. So fun we didn't head out one evening!
reviews[196].comments: Patrick is an amazing host! He is quick to respond to messages and provides such helpful tips about the area. The room isn’t the biggest, but it was still comfortable for two people. Patrick was very flexible when it came to check-in and check-out— allowing us to store our suitcases in the apartment before and after our scheduled times. The location of the apartment is also really nice! I would absolutely recommend staying here.
reviews[197].comments: Patrick's home is warm, accessible to transportation, food and Central Park. His description of his home meet every expectation I had. My experience at his home was lovely.
reviews[198].comments: We had a great stay. Patrick is a very kind host and is incredibly accommodating. The room is comfortable, stylish, and exactly as described. Super close to Central Park and subway lines.
reviews[200].comments: Terrific host, and a clean cozy room with a private bath.
reviews[201].comments: Patrick was a great host! Place was a steal for the great location and amenities. Quick response and easy to organize with. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews[202].comments: Patrick à été réactif à toutes nos questions. Il nous a mis à l'aise et partagé son appartement avec amabilité et simplicité. L'immeuble est ancien et pourrait être rénové mais présente du charme et un bon emplacement.
reviews[203].comments: Patrick’s place is absolutely beautiful and he’s a very kind and caring host. Supermarkets are super close, transit system is right next door, and everything in walking distance. Patrick also gives you a good idea of where to go and what to see. Would recommend and stay again :)
reviews[204].comments: Tivemos pouco contato, mas o Patrick sempre estava disponível quando precisamos. Além disso, ele gentilmente se ofereceu para me ajudar a carregas as malas, tanto na chegada quanto na partida. Recomendo a acomodação do Patrick. O local é de fácil acesso e tem muitas lojas úteis por perto, como um mercadinho 24h, uma Starbucks, TJ-Max e um WholeFoods.
reviews[205].comments: Tolle, ruhige Unterkunft, um NYC zu erkunden
reviews[206].comments:
I was very much looking forward to meet Patrick and stay in his flat. 
Unfortunately I had to leave after my first night, having spent less than 10 hours in the room due to complete lack of hygiene. 
Patrick and I communicated well since the moment I booked but I was shocked and disappointed that he would think it is acceptable to rent his room in such a state. The floor had been swept and linens and towels were clean, the rest was a disgrace. 
It is such a shame because this is a prime location in Manhattan and the flat for what I could see has a HUGE potential.
reviews[207].comments: Although we couldn’t meet Patrick, everything was perfectly arranged by him. The location is two blocks away from the C line in the heart of the Upper West. Typical NY building and apartment, we felt like locals! The room was spotless clean and really quiet by night. The private bath is a big plus. Keep in mind that is 3-stairs flight to the room with no elevator in the building. We’d definitely come back to Patrick’s again! 10/10
reviews[208].comments: We had a great start with Patrick, who was super friendly and helpful. He gave us great tips on the best places to visit in the city and important treansportation info. Room was clean and organized with fresh sheets and towels.
reviews[209].comments: Perfect location next to central park, quick metro ride to times square, friendly host
reviews[210].comments: Just back from 5 nights at Patrick's place. A really good experience overall. The apartment was in a great location. Got a great night's sleep every night on the comfy bed, and the aircon was a life saver during the hot weather. Patrick was very friendly and went beyond as a host for us. He recommended some great places like Whole foods (my new favourite place), and a place to get discounted broadway tickets! The wifi was great for streaming Netflix too :)
reviews[211].comments: Good value and a good base for the city.

The laundried clothes are usually just thrown into my clean cloth basket except for those that have to be hanged dry. But here in New York, they can pick up/delivery at your door. All for a very reasonable price.

Overall 11/10. Would definitely return if ever getting a chance to revisit NYC.

reviews[5].comments:

reviews[12].comments: It’s in a quieter part of town, great studio in NY. Maia had everything we needed. reviews[14].comments: You get what you spend.
reviews[15].comments: Great stay! Maia’s appartement is very well located and well furnished.
reviews[16].comments: Everything in Maia’s apartment is very nice. It’s bigger than on the pictures and the subway is very close (F train).\nMaia was very helpful and check in was easy. Would definitely recommend.
reviews[17].comments: This is a great apartment to explore the city from. The neighbourhood is such that you have lots of cheap delicious food all around you and beautiful views of the bridge. reviews[18].comments:

reviews[19].comments: Maia was a great host! Would definitely stay here again :)
reviews[20].comments: I have had an amazing time in Maia's appartment. It was a little bit bigger than expected, but further everything was similar to the pictures on Airbnb. reviews[21].comments: Great space, close to subway and great location in Chinatown. Would highly recommend it
reviews[22].comments: We enjoyed our stay at Maia's place. The flat is charming, comfortable and you will find everything you need in it. reviews[23].comments: Very spacious, clean and comfortable place. Quiet neighborhood, and Maia was a very friendly and helpful host!
reviews[24].comments: Appartement spacieux et bien agencé situé dans quartier typique de Chinatown

One thing that I totally disliked was that it didn’t not say on the description that this studio is located on the fourth floor and there is no elevator. reviews[6].comments: For how incredibly affordable Murilo's place is, it can't be beat. You're in a beautiful area of the Upper West Side. There is a shared bathroom but it was never a problem. Not once did I find the other person who uses it using it when I wanted to. And while the amenities in the bathroom are old, I found them to be quite clean. Otherwise, the bed is comfy and the table area large enough to do laptop work. The building itself has a (very cheap) laundry room in the basement should you need it. Murilo makes every effort to make sure you're doing well, and even will have a cup of coffee with you if you're so inclined to have him show you the city a bit. My only complaint would be that the WiFi is a bit slow, but that's really it. I felt safe and secure in this cozy studio. Would recommend to anyone looking for a great deal.
reviews[7].comments: The host was very easy to communicate with and the apartment is in a wonderful area, HOWEVER, if you're sensitive to cigarette smoke or smell DO NOT stay here. The entire floor smells like years of cigarettes and really made the stay less enjoyable.  I hardly wanted to use the communal bathroom because it smells so potently.  Murilo is a good host and it's a good place to rest your head in a pinch, but I would not recommend for long-term stay.
reviews[8].comments:
Murilo had excellent communication. He gave me a lot of useful information upfront and checked on me throughout my trip to ensure everything was going well.

This listing had a shared bathroom which was clearly posted in the listing i must have just missed it. The bathroom was clean and i never ran into issues with it being occupied. I did not like the shared bathroom situation though. It was a tad uncomfortable having to leave the apartment to use the restroom. I felt like i needed to lock up the apartment everytime i used the bathroom just in case. Not only was my stuff in the apartment but Murilos as well. Again, this was clearly posted in the listing so this was not Murilos fault. 

I didn't bother using the elevator after the first day. There is only one covering the whole building and its very slow so i just took the stairs. The common hallway area smelled really bad like food and cigarettes at all times. Murilos apartment smells just fine so no worries there!!

The best part about this unit is the location!!! You are walking distance to anything you may need (market, dining, shopping, Central Park, etc). Its a short walk to Central Park which is amazing and its also walking distance to Midtown. There is a subway station right next to the unit so you can take the subway as well. 

Overall i enjoyed my experience at Murilos. The only thing keeping me from booking again is the bathroom.
reviews[9].comments: O espaço é excelente, limpo, organizado e bem localizado. O Murilo deu toda assistência, para eu aproveitasse ao maximo a minha estadia em NY.

i appareciated this trip a lot.
reviews[15].comments: Muy buen lugar quedarse, por la ubicación y porque todo es como lo describe. Marcelo es muy atento y está disponible para atender cualquier consulta.

It was a little bit stressful! He was annoying in wanting to know the exact time I wanted to check in and check out. The building is old and smelly but Marcelo’s room doesn’t smell. It was neat! reviews[33].comments: I had a very nice stay at Marcelo’s place which happens to be my old neighborhood (actually the same street).  He was very easy to communicate with and made me feel comfortable in his home. Great value in a wonderful part of Manhattan.
reviews[34].comments: First, the listing is incorrect, either its Airbnb fault or the host's fault, the bathroom is shared, and when it is that way I'm not sure how Airbnb shows this apartment under 'Entire home'  category.\n\nSecond, the host insists on communicating via (Hidden by Airbnb) , and just keeps on messaging all the time, I had to block my notifications so that he doesn't bugs me. reviews[39].comments: The location is great and Marcelo is very quick and detailed in his responses. I didn’t have problem with sharing the bathroom and it was open every time I needed it. This place is great for a weekend trip to the city!

Für einen Trip nach New York genau das, was man braucht. Das Badezimmer befindet sich auf dem Gang. Bis auf ein paar kleine Ausnahmen war es immer sauber. Für den Preis würde ich immer wieder diese kleine Wohnung buchen. Mikrowelle, Kaffeemaschine... alles vorhanden.

reviews[14].comments:

reviews[23].comments:
I would not recommend this place be rented out until it is repaired and cleaned properly.  There is significant water damage, especially in the bathroom.  The ceiling in the bathroom is caving in from it and looks like there is mold damage.  The shower does not drain and has mold all over the caulking.  The toilet had hair from previous tenants.  There was dust that was caked on the shower and walls from lack of cleaning and then condensation from the shower use.  There was more water damage throughout the place.  The brick fireplace was very dusty.  The apartment also smelled of smoke which may have been from a neighbor or previous tenants.  I could not tell.  We used candles to help hide that.  Also, the comforter pictured was not the one listed.  It was a cheap tiger blanket that looks like it could have been purchased at the swap meet.  We took plenty of pictures to document the problems.

As for service, that was strange from the beginning.  It was clear the owner did not meet us because he could not point out the apartment.  Once in, I looked for an iron and found a board.  There was no iron and I texted the owner who said there should be one.  When I let him know it was not there, he said it was not part of the ad and I would either need to buy one or get my clothes pressed.  Luckily I had a sweater nice enough to wear to a meeting.  As someone who deals with people on a daily basis, you never say that.  It is the equivalent to saying "Sorry that is our policy."  He could have said, "I am sorry.  I am out of town right now.  I wish I could help more."  That is less of a put off than what I got.  When I did contact the owner about the physical issues, he said he has been having issues with cleaners for a while.  With the owner being out of the country, I would think a professional property manager should be in place to ensure the place isn’t in bad shape.
  
On our part, we should have contacted airbnb from the beginning and just left.  Since it was our first experience, I was not sure what to do.  I contacted airbnb afterward and have been working with them since.  This experience is clearly not the norm since we stayed at a nice place in Philadelphia afterward from airbnb.

Some positives...  The kitchen seemed to be pretty clean, but we did not use it.  It had reliable WiFi and a nice TV.  The location is the best thing about it.  You can walk to a lot of good restaurants, bars and shops.  I also felt pretty safe at any time walking around.  These do not make up for the physical problems with this place and an owner that doesn’t seem too concerned with meeting his tenants needs.

reviews[45].comments:
This is a small studio apartment, approximately 25-30 m2 (the photographs make it look bigger than it is). Located in a good neighbourhood, lots of fun restaurants and close to a subway stop and two parks.  It has a separate bathroom, no separate bedroom. It fits two people fine, but for three people it really is too small. It's quiet, functional, not very cosy, a little cluttered (with cables and boxes), and, unfortunately, not very clean. When we arrived, we had to ask for clean sheets (the sheets on the beds hadn't been cleaned and had hair and stains on them) and also for someone to clean the apartment the next day, because it hadn't been cleaned.
We were met by a friend of the owners, who was really friendly and kind enough to wait for us to arrive in the evening, even though we were an hour late because our plane was delayed. He was available at all tines, which was lovely - he eve came back at night with the clean sheets. He tried to help with the cleaning, but after he came in the next day, most of the apartment was still really grubby, especially the bathroom. I noticed one of the other guests commenting on this, but didn't pay much attention to it at the time. However, we travel a lot, and this is the first time we were a little disgusted by our surroundings. 
The apartment basically contains everything you need though (tv, microwave, stove, cutlery, dishware, cooking oil, paper towels, matches, candles, condiments), and has an excellent shower (we didn't use the bath because it was too grubby). No hair dryer of kitchen towels, so you will have to bring these yourselves. The bed had a soft foam mattress, we slept very well on it. They were also very flexible on check in and check out, we arrived at ten thirty at night and checked out around two o'clock in the afternoon.
All in all, we had a great stay in NY, but I don't think I would rent this apartment again. For what we paid for it, it just didn't offer enough value, eventhough the neighbourhood was great. Plus we paid 31 dollars in cleaning costs and ended up cleaning the essentials ourselves.

reviews[0].comments: Prearrival she informed me that her friend would have key. They were both excellent at communication. I locked key in dooor and immediate reply and solution was in process. I would stay again.
reviews[1].comments: Our text communications were mostly polite.
reviews[2].comments: The location was convenient, but I found the apartment too small and felt very confined.
reviews[3].comments: Place is clean and quiet. Relatively small. Yang was very responsive and very easy to work with. Would definitely stay again
reviews[4].comments: Had a great stay, very convenient location as described yet very quite apartment, appearance as posted.  Yang was easy to communicate with and very accommodating.  No complaints
reviews[5].comments: Host was welcoming and communicative. Two room apartment had one room unavailable (baby grand piano), main room contains double bed, kitchenette, 1 chair, tiny table, covered storage allowing 2 1/2 foot wide corridor from kitchenette to bath. Host made almost no accommodation for guests.  Double bed had 1 sheet, 1 cover, but extremely uncomfortable mattress that prevented sleep. Bathroom had tiny soap bars (from motels), shower curtain had a rip. Very low value for the price.
reviews[6].comments: Yang's place is a great value--it's not big, but well kept up & the location is excellent; less than 10 minutes from subway & Lincoln Center.
reviews[7].comments: Yang's place was very quiet and academic, its location is perfect too, I stayed with my family there and we wanted to go to Lincoln Center to watch a show, and it was only a 2-minute walk! I was a little worried about the mattress because of the previous review, but I decided to give it a try, it turns out that the mattress was comfortable enough to have a sound sleep, so I would definitely come back again!
reviews[8].comments: Yang's apartment was wonderful! It was in a great location, we felt safe, and it was quiet. We highly recommend people to stay here. She was great at communicating with us and made she everything was fine. The next time we come here, we'll definitely stay at her place again!
reviews[9].comments: Great place for a single traveler for a quick night or two. Location is good. Typical NYC apartment.
reviews[10].comments: I had a fantastic stay at Yang's place.  It's as described, and fit all my needs for a quick business trip.  Great wi-fi, clean, and equipped with all the basic necessities.  Yang is a terrific host as well, very communicative and helpful with check-in/check-out.  Will definitely stay there again! Thank you Yang!
reviews[11].comments: Very convenient place to stay for tourists as a 1st time visiting Manhattan. Also the C/P is high
reviews[12].comments: Yang was very accommodating and answered questions quickly.  About a ten minute walk away from the nearest subway station.  The photos are very accurate and illustrate how small New York apartments are, no surprises here.
reviews[13].comments: Very nice host. Well-located place if your looking for a quick bed (someone else’s bed) to crash on. Felt safe.
reviews[14].comments: Great location, very helpful host.
reviews[15].comments: Yang was an excellent host. Despite my luggage got damaged at the airport and we made the check in 1 hour later than disgussed, Yang's mother has taken care of us, helped and gave us a warm welcome. We hightly recommend her nice place for safety stay in NYC.
reviews[16].comments: L'appartamento è piccolo ma molto confortevole e dotato di tutti i servizi necessari per una bella vacanza. L'ubicazione è perfetta, la metro è vicina, si può tranquillamaente arrivare a piedi a Time Square.\nYang è stata molto disponibile ed i tempi di risposta alle nostre domande sono stati quasi immediati, ci è venuta incontro anche nell'orario di check out, perfetta!
reviews[17].comments: Yang's place was awesome! It's conveniently located and has all the things you need to make your stay comfortable! She was quick to respond, and even accommodated a slightly early check-in to drop off bags! We even had the pleasure of meeting her mom, who was so sweet and welcoming! \n\nThe apartment is just as it says, cozy and convenient! It was exactly what I expected, and made for an amazing home base for my first trip to NYC! I would definitely recommend it!
reviews[18].comments: Yang´s apartment has a great location and she is really fact answering to any question or issue you may have.
reviews[19].comments: I really enjoyed my stay at Yang’s place. The place is well located and clean. Yang responded really quickly to all my messages. She was really flexible with my check-out time, since I had a late flight and did not want to wait at the airport for a too long time. I would definitely stay here again. Thanks Yang!
reviews[20].comments: What a bargain! The location is perfect, central to great restaurants and activities, close to the subway and walkable to so many other areas. One thing we appreciated was the neighborhood was pretty quiet, which is wonderful after a long day of sightseeing. The apartment is cozy as stated, but for a trip when you are out for the day it’s just right. It has everything you need. Communication with Yang is so prompt! We really appreciated that. Yang’s mother was delightful as we checked in and out. I would highly recommend and would stay here again.
reviews[21].comments: El departamento tiene una ubicación fascinante, tranquilo, cerca del subway, markets, etc. Muy buen servicio el que otorgan, todo siempre limpio. Totalmente recomendable!
reviews[22].comments: We had a great time staying at Yang's. It's a great location - very close to Central Park, subway stations, and Lincoln Center (and not too far from Times Square/Broadway theaters). Well-kept cozy apartment, the a/c worked well, and Yang was very responsive and friendly in email interactions.
reviews[23].comments: 非常愉悦的曼哈顿之行,交通生活非常便捷
reviews[24].comments: Lovely place. A little bit bigger than a hotel room. Very clean apartment and quiet neighborhood. Bed in the living room could have been a little more comfortable. Everything looked the same as the pictures. There are some wonderful grocery stores near by. Not too far from the subway or bus if you don’t mind walking about 10 minutes. Yang was always quick to respond and very helpful. Her mother made check in really easy. An all around great place to stay in NYC!
reviews[25].comments: My girlfriend and I stayed in New York for a 7 day vacation. Yang was extremely accomodating to us. It is in a great location with about a 15 minute walk to time square and other sites and attractions. If I was to book another trip there, I would message Yang again and book her place as it had everything we needed. The picutres also dont do the appartment justice. It is actually much bigger and can comfortably fit 3 people no problem! All-in-all... 5 stars!
reviews[26].comments: We had a great stay in Yang’s place - it’s convenient to get to many places in town and it was perfect for a weekend’s vacation. Thanks!
reviews[27].comments: Yang's place was really nice! A bit of a walk from the subway but clean and nice. It's very hard to find a place in Manhattan as cheap as Yang's, and the Midtown location is nice and central.
reviews[28].comments: This place is a great place to stay enjoyed my Labor Day weekend here .
